Job Opening: Executive Administrator
Location: South Africa (Remote – US Hours)

Type: Full-Time, Work from Home

Hours: Monday to Friday: 9am- 5pm (US Hours)
Pay: Monthly Salary

Overview:
The Executive Administrator provides high-level administrative and operational support to senior leadership, ensuring seamless coordination, communication, and execution of executive priorities. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and stakeholders with professionalism and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and liaison between executives, internal teams, and external partners.
  • Manage complex calendars, coordinate meetings, and arrange domestic and international travel itineraries.
  • Prepare and review correspondence, reports, presentations, and other confidential documents.
  • Oversee administrative operations including expense tracking, procurement, and vendor management.
  • Maintain accurate and organized digital filing systems for contracts, communications, and key records.
  • Assist with special projects, board materials, and strategic initiatives as assigned.
  • Handle sensitive information with discretion and maintain strict confidentiality.
  • Anticipate executive needs and proactively address potential scheduling or operational conflicts.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, or related field (preferred).
  • 5+ years of experience in executive or senior administrative support roles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and productivity tools (e.g., Google Workspace, project management platforms).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent time management, problem-solving, and multitasking abilities.
  • Professional demeanor, adaptability, and strong sense of ownership.

Job type: Part-Time (15-20hrs/week)

Location: Remote in US

Intended Start Date: As soon as possible

Pay Range: $20-$25/hr

Who we are:

Think Academy US (), a 100% owned subsidiary of TAL Education Group(NYSE: TAL), is recently established education technology (Ed-Tech) company to provide K-12 extra-curricular learning services through science and technology. At Think Academy, we provide full cycle service to foster local children’s ability to think critically, to strengthen their logic skills, and to help them fulfill their goals through innovative teaching techniques. We believe Love and Technology can make education better. Each week, more than 6 million students are enrolled in TAL's online and offline education platform.

Whom we are looking for:

Think Academy is expanding its competition math programs for students in North America. We are currently looking for Remote Math Competition Tutors to teach and support students preparing for AMC 8 and AMC 10 mathematics competitions. Our program focuses on developing students’ problem-solving abilities, mathematical reasoning, and competition strategies to help them succeed in national math contests.

What You Will Do:

  • Deliver online one-on-one math lessons focused on AMC 8 and AMC 10 competition preparation.
  • Teach in English using interactive and problem-solving based methods to help students develop strong analytical and logical thinking skills.
  • Guide students through competition-style problems and explain key concepts and strategies used in math competitions.
  • Help students build systematic approaches to common competition math topics such as number theory, algebra, counting, probability, and geometry.
  • Support students in developing confidence and effective test-taking strategies for math competitions.
  • Provide timely feedback and targeted guidance to support student understanding and continuous improvement

How You Can Be Qualified:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above; majors in Math, Economics, Finance, or related fields are preferred
  • Experience in math competitions or relevant competition teaching/tutoring experience is highly preferred
  • Strong math foundation; familiarity with competitions such as AMC, AIME, or MathCounts is preferred
  • Available to work during weekday evenings and weekends
  • Bilingual proficiency in Mandarin is preferred

Pay:

Pay starts from $20–25/hr, with opportunities for promotion and salary increases twice a year.

  • Think Academy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

raw.title: Superannuation Operations Specialist - Complaints
raw.excerpt: About Future Group Future Group is not your traditional financial services company – we're a collective of super funds and services committed to changing our planet now for a better tomorrow.
raw.description:
About Future Group
Future Group is not your traditional financial services company – we're a collective of super funds and services committed to changing our planet now for a better tomorrow. When you join us, you’ll become part of a team united by a clear and important mission: to lead the investment movement by advocating and campaigning for a future worth retiring into.
We are looking for someone to join our purpose-led high-growth scale-up as a Superannuation Operations Specialist – Complaints.

You’ll support the management of member complaints and help ensure fair, compliant and timely outcomes. You’ll work closely with senior Operations colleagues, administrators, insurers and internal stakeholders to review complaints, support responses, identify issues and contribute to improvements in member experience and complaints management.

You may already be working in a superannuation Trustee office, or you may be joining us from a superannuation administrator and looking to broaden your experience into governance, oversight and Trustee responsibilities. And the best bit, you’ll get to work with some fantastic work mates!
Future Group values diverse lived experience and identities, and we strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander backgrounds, those with caring responsibilities, from culturally and racially marginalised groups, with disabilities, who experience ageism, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and those who face social exclusion due to their social class.

We recognise that the recruitment journey may present unique challenges for trans and gender diverse folk, and we are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all. We will happily make any reasonable adjustments to accommodate diverse needs, so if there is anything we can do to support you at any stage of your application, please let us know. For more information about DEIB at Future Group, please contact us at

The Role As our Superannuation Operations Specialist – Complaints, you’ll be responsible for reviewing and supporting the management of complaints across internal dispute resolution and, where required, external dispute resolution processes.
You’ll help review complaint information, investigate member concerns, review and coordinate responses and ensure matters are accurately recorded and progressed within required timeframes. You’ll work with administrators, insurers and internal teams to gather information, clarify issues and support fair and well-reasoned outcomes for members.
You’ll also contribute to complaints reporting and insights by identifying recurring issues, process gaps and potential systemic concerns. Your work will help improve complaint handling, member communications, operational processes and outcomes.

You'll love this job if

  • You care about listening to members and helping resolve their concerns fairly.
  • You’re confident reviewing information, asking questions and identifying what needs to happen next.
  • You have strong written communication skills.
  • You have sound judgement and attention to detail.
  • You enjoy working with different stakeholders to resolve issues within clear timeframes.
  • You’re comfortable handling sensitive or difficult matters in a calm and professional way.
  • You’re interested in using complaints insights to improve processes and member experiences.

We're looking for someone who

  • Has 2+ years experience in superannuation administration, particularly complaints, or dispute resolution.
  • Has experience investigating member concerns, coordinating information from different teams and preparing or supporting complaint responses.
  • Has an understanding of internal dispute resolution and the importance of fair, accurate and timely outcomes.
  • Ideally has experience working in a superannuation Trustee office, or has worked closely with a Trustee, RSE licensee or service provider.
  • Can assess information, prepare clear written responses and maintain accurate complaint records.
  • Has strong organisational, stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Can manage multiple complaints and competing deadlines while maintaining quality.
  • Has RG146 or is willing to undertake the relevant training where required for the role.
  • Believes in Future Group’s mission and has a passion for moving Australia’s money out of fossil fuels and into renewable energy.
  • Believes in using the power of money to build a sustainable and equitable world.
Some nice-to-haves but are not essential are:
  • Experience handling complex or sensitive member complaints.
  • Experience supporting AFCA matters or systemic issue investigations.

Why would you enjoy working at Future Group?

  • A purpose-driven organisation - spend your days working on making this world a better place! The more we grow, the bigger the impact we are making on climate change and inequality
  • A B Corp organisation that cares about how it behaves inside and out
  • AFR's Best Place to Work 2026! Proud winners of TWO awards: Best Medium Organisation, and our industry category of Banking, Superannuation and Financial Services (an award we also won in 2022!)
  • Flexibility to fit work into your life (not your life around our work). School drop-offs/pick-ups and lunch-time gym sessions are a thing here
  • The choice to work from home, from one of our co-working spaces, from anywhere within Australia or even from overseas (for a short period of time)
  • The potential to own a piece of the Future Group pie with our unique Employee Share Ownership Program (with some fineprint)
  • Fun company-wide events
  • Progressive, people-focused policies and benefits including Menstrual and Menopausal Leave, Public holidays swaps, Cultural Leave, Self Care Leave and Gender Affirmation Guidelines and Leave
  • We offer employee network groups for people from diverse backgrounds: SuperGenders for cisgender women, trans men and women and non-binary folks; SuperGlobal for culturally diverse folks; and SuperPride for LGBTQIA+ folks. The groups are a safe, supportive space for people to share experiences and ideas
  • An inclusive parental leave package, with 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents of all genders
  • A laptop you can use to work remotely plus an allowance to make your working from home setup comfortable
  • Other perks such as access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), the ability to purchase leave, novated leasing arrangements for electric vehicles, and a few more to find out!

Job Title: Senior Manager, Practice Operations
Location: remote (work from home eligible)
Travel: Ability to travel to client sites (domestic and(or) international) as required and defined per project requirements
Salary: $160,000-$180,000 DOE

Company Overview: Celerity is a consulting firm specializing in utilities and energy sectors. We empower organizations by converting complex data into actionable intelligence to mitigate risk, optimize assets, and maximize project outcomes. Our background and expertise enable us to drive and deliver transformation and operational excellence for our clients.
Practice Overview: The Business Integration Services (BIS) practice is a high-growth technology consulting practice delivering enterprise-scale integration, digital transformation, and solution design engagements for complex, multi-stakeholder clients. The practice is in its third year of a structured build and scale phase, expanding from a founding team to a full-capability organization spanning four pillars: Project Management (PMO), Business/Technical Analysis, Solution Architecture, and Engineering.
The practice operates at the intersection of business strategy and technology execution, working closely with technology partners and vendors to deliver outcomes that are both architecturally sound and commercially meaningful. It is entering a pivotal phase of maturity, transitioning from practice-leads delivery to a structured operating model with defined build paths, methodology standards, and delivery governance.
Position Overview: The Senior Manager role is newly created role designed to build and run the operational backbone of the BIS practice. This person is also a people manager while owning the internal operating infrastructure that allows the practice to scale without losing delivery quality or team cohesion. The Senior Manager is an experienced professional including consulting background with over 10 years of hands-on experience driving and building delivery excellence, can build and sustain a high-performing team culture, and has the operational discipline to manage experienced professionals through a period of rapid growth.
This role demands strong operational leadership, industry knowledge, and technical fluency to drive results in complex client environments.
Key Responsibilities:
Practice Operations & Delivery Coordination:

  • Own the weekly resource coordination sync and alignment across multiple projects — aligning deployment to project demand, managing capacity constraints, and ensuring no engagement is under-resourced
  • Maintain a real-time view of utilization across all active engagements; proactively identify over-allocation, burnout risk, or skill mismatches and resolve before they affect delivery.
  • Build and maintain the practice's operational cadences: team meetings, delivery check-ins, onboarding sequences, and inter-pillar coordination mechanisms.
  • Escalate delivery risks that require leadership action; translate ground-level team intelligence into clear, actionable executive signals without filtering out critical information
  • Ensure the project teams have the tools, templates, methodologies, and standards they need to deliver consistently across different engagement types and client environments
Capability Building:
  • Partner with the project teams to define and maintain the practice's methodology: discovery frameworks, requirements standards, stakeholder engagement approaches, and deliverable quality benchmarks
  • Build a learning and development calendar for the team that reflects real engagement needs — not generic training — including cross-pillar exposure across all pillars.
  • Create and maintain a competency framework that provides clear, credible criteria for performance evaluation and career progression, recognizing that most team members are already highly experienced
  • Drive/support the development of BIS delivery playbooks, templates, and standards for discovery, change management, testing, cutover, and post-implementation support.
  • Identify patterns across engagements where capability gaps surface and systematically address them through targeted development rather than reactive support
  • Use insights from the quarterly coach roundtable to shape new hire onboarding for incoming cohorts, ensuring lessons from active delivery are embedded into how new team members learn the practice
People Leadership & Team Development
  • Lead structured onboarding for incoming new hires, ensuring they integrate into the practice culture and reach delivery readiness within 60-90 days.
  • Serve as a direct people manager for the reporting team that includes senior business analysis professionals with process, data, business/technical requirements and systems/product implementation skillsets.
  • Hold a quarterly coaching roundtable with cross-pillar coaches to aggregate team development signals and translate them into management action
  • Retain and support a team of experienced senior practitioners— understanding the difference between craft recognition and career progression for high-expertise individual contributors
Practice Strategy & Governance
  • Contribute to capacity planning working with leadership to project capacity needs against pipeline and growth targets
  • Partner with leadership on the design of the coaching model, cross-pillar development programs, and any structural adjustments as the practice scales
  • Maintain the operating model documentation: org structure, role definitions, operating norms, and governance processes that align with the team structure on implementation projects.
Continuous Improvement & Quality Assurance
  • Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned, feedback loops, and project retrospectives.
  • Ensure project deliverables meet established quality standards, conduct quality audits and reviews, and implement quality improvement processes.
Educational Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Management, or a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced degree (MBA or Master’s) is preferred.
Required Skills and Experience:
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in technology consulting, professional services, or a related discipline, with demonstrated experience leading or managing teams of senior practitioners.
  • Proven track record as a people manager — comfortable owning performance reviews, difficult conversations, retention risk, and career development for experienced individual contributors
  • Experience working with Agile and Waterfall methodologies in SaaS companies or with system integrators.
  • Strong working knowledge of the four pillars as a discipline: what excellent discovery looks like and how requirements mature through an engagement
  • Experience managing resource deployment and capacity planning in a project-based or consulting environment
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust with experienced peers and direct reports who have strong professional identities and do not require or respond well to directive management styles
  • Comfort operating in a high-growth, structurally evolving environment where processes are being built while delivery is ongoing
  • Strong understanding of utility operations, asset management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Demonstrated experience in team building and leadership, with the ability to inspire and develop talent.
  • Excellent project management skills, including proficiency in project planning, execution, and risk management.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage clients and stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage with clients effectively, collaborate with internal teams, and interact with management.
  • Ability to travel domestically and(or) internationally if required.
Preferred Skills:
  • Prior experience in practice operations, delivery management, or capability development role within a consulting firm or technology services organization
  • Familiarity with the cross-functional dynamics between PMO, BA, solution architecture, and engineering in integrated delivery engagements
  • Experience with coaching models, structured mentoring programs, or formal learning and development initiatives in a consulting context
  • Exposure to Big 4 or top-tier consulting operating models — particularly how those firms separate craft leadership from people management at scale
  • Experience hiring and onboarding senior practitioners in a compressed timeline.
  • Certifications: PMP/PMI-ACP, Prosci/Change Management, ITIL, SAFe/Agile or relevant certifications.

The salary range for this position is provided in good faith and is subject to variation based on geographic location, candidate experience, and market conditions. Final compensation will be determined after a comprehensive evaluation of the candidate’s qualifications and alignment with the role.

In accordance with applicable pay transparency laws—including but not limited to those in California, Colorado, New York, Washington, and other jurisdictions—we disclose salary ranges to promote equity and transparency. Where required by law, compensation and benefits information will be included in job postings or made available upon request.

This job description outlines the primary responsibilities and standards of the position but is not exhaustive. Employees may be asked to perform additional duties that are reasonably related to their role and consistent with company policies and applicable labor laws.

raw.description:
Stellenbeschreibung:

Unsere Herausforderung: Über 8.000 Stunden pro Jahr. So lange sitzt der Durchschnittsmensch - mit Folgen wie Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen, Diabetes und nachlassender mentaler Gesundheit. Obwohl das vielen bewusst ist, fällt es den meisten schwer, Bewegung in ihren vollen Alltag zu integrieren.

Bei Moovv, gegründet 2024, ändern wir das. Wir entwickeln innovative Laufbänder, die Bewegung nahtlos in den Alltag integrieren - zu Hause, im Büro oder irgendwo dazwischen.

Unsere Mission ist klar: Gesundheit und Bewegung für alle zugänglich machen - denn selbst die beschäftigsten Menschen verdienen ein gesundes Leben.Der Beweis liegt in den Zahlen: Unsere Kundinnen und Kunden bewerten uns auf Trustpilot mit 4,6 ⭐.

Wer wir sind: Wir sind ein junges, motiviertes Team mit einer gemeinsamen Mission: mehr Gesundheit und Bewegung in das Leben der Menschen zu bringen. Wir arbeiten kollaborativ, handeln pragmatisch und leben, was wir predigen.

Deine Chance: Während wir schnell in den Niederlanden, Belgien und Deutschland skalieren, bauen wir das Kernteam auf, das unseren Erfolg prägen wird. Als unser Community Manager wirst du Moovv zu mehr als nur einer Marke machen - zu einem Ort, an dem Menschen dazugehören möchten. Du verbindest Menschen, inspirierst kreative Initiativen und verwandelst WhatsApp und Instagram in lebendige Zentren voller Energie und Engagement.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Beziehungsaufbau: Du bist die herzliche, vertrauenswürdige Ansprechperson für unsere Ambassadors und Creator. Du baust Vertrauen auf, hörst aufmerksam zu und sorgst dafür, dass sich Menschen wirklich gesehen fühlen.

  • Community-Aktivierung: Du bringst unsere WhatsApp-Community täglich zum Leben - mit kreativen Challenges, spannenden Formaten und echten Gesprächen.

  • Instagram-Engagement: Du beantwortest DMs, Kommentare und Erwähnungen und gehst proaktiv auf Kund:innen und Ambassadors zu, um bedeutungsvolle Gespräche zu starten.

  • Kreative Aktionen: Ob Laufclubs, Creator-Kooperationen oder große Community-Events - du planst und setzt Initiativen um, die Menschen zusammenbringen.

  • Wachstum & Bindung: Du überlegst strategisch, wie du neue Creator, Kund:innen und Partner:innen für unsere Community gewinnst, aktivierst und langfristig bindest.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Community-First-Mindset: Du hast nachweisliche Erfahrung im Aufbau und Management engagierter Communities - idealerweise auf WhatsApp und Instagram.

  • Vernetzer/in mit Kreativfunken: Du entwickelst neue Ideen, um Menschen online und offline zusammenzubringen, und schaffst dabei unvergessliche Erlebnisse.

  • Menschliche Energie: Du förderst auf natürliche Weise Wertschätzung, Positivität und echte zwischenmenschliche Verbindung.

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst an, bewegst Dinge schnell und wartest nicht auf perfekte Bedingungen.

  • Bonus: Erfahrung mit Sport-Communities, Creator-Management oder Eventplanung.

  • Sprachen: Fließend in Englisch und Deutsch.

Bereit, mit uns die Welt in Bewegung zu bringen?
Bewirb dich jetzt auf Indeed oder per Mail an:

Ich freue mich auf dich!

Our mission is to bring innovation to clinical trial execution through passion, transparency, co-active communication, and integrity, to facilitate the successful development of life-changing medicines and therapies.

We are experts in clinical trial operations with a focus on Clinical Trial Management, CRO/Vendor Oversight, Trial Master File Management, Clinical Monitoring, Quality Assurance, Data Management and Study Startup. As a small company, we are highly adaptable, flexible, and transparent. Our unwavering integrity forms the foundation for our strong relationships both internally and as a partner to our Sponsor clients. Beginning with study development, we bring a “white glove service” approach to clinical trials. Our flexible approach and ongoing process development ensure efficiency and adequate resourcing, allowing us to respond rapidly to our clients’ needs as they evolve.

Our talented team is driven by passion and purpose, which has afforded us the opportunity to successfully lead clinical programs for pharmaceutical, medical device and biotechnology companies of all sizes in a variety of therapeutic areas. Our mission is to conduct clinical trials with outstanding quality on behalf of our clients to bring new drugs to market with the utmost integrity and confidence in the results.

Position Overview:

Reporting to the Director, Clinical Monitoring, primarily responsible for the management of clinical sites and monitoring of clinical data at assigned sites. The Senior Clinical Research Associate (Sr. CRA) will independently execute monitoring responsibilities for clinical trials in Phases 1, 2, and 3, in accordance with ICH/GCP guidelines and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Prepares for and conducts site qualification, site initiation, interim, and closeout monitoring visits.
  • Main point of contact between assigned sites and Sponsor.
  • Conducts all monitoring with a strong focus on data integrity and patient safety, adhering to GCP protocol and sponsor requirements.
  • Delivers high quality and timely reports following each monitoring visit.
  • Completes and submits monitoring-related expense reports in accordance with the company and/or Client’s travel & expense guidelines.
  • Works with the Clinical Operations Manager to identify, escalate, and resolve issues at assigned clinical sites.
  • Maintains Trial Master File (TMF)/Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) for assigned sites.
  • Manages query resolution process with clinical sites and data management groups.
  • Travel of up to 75% may be required, including globally.
  • Quarterly travel to San Diego headquarters required, if not residing locally.
  • Other work-related duties, special projects, and/or other functions, as required.

Experience & Skills:

  • 5+ years of independent clinical monitoring experience preferred.
  • Self-motivation, flexibility, ability to establish and manage multiple priorities, and multi-task effectively to meet stated internal and external commitments.
  • Must exercise sound judgment and take initiative, be able to work independently with minimal supervision while producing accurate high quality and timely work.
  • Must be able to work effectively within a team environment (independently and collaboratively).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills including strong professional presentation skills (internal and external audiences).
  • Thorough knowledge and understanding of ICH/GCPs and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Solid computer skills, including working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel Outlook, etc.).
  • Understanding of current GCPs/ICH/FDA regulations and guidelines to assess compliance with applicable regulations and guidelines.

Education:

Bachelor of Science degree in a scientific discipline from an accredited college or university is strongly preferred. Other bachelor's degrees with relevant industry experience will be considered.

Applicants with foreign transcripts/degrees must provide a U.S. equivalency report evaluation that indicates the degree to which the foreign coursework is equivalent from one of these evaluation agencies: .

Compensation Range:

$120,000 - 145,000 annually + benefits package and annual performance bonus (Includes: health insurance, 401k retirement plan, and paid days off)

Vaccination requirements will depend on the client site requirements. Proof of vaccination may be required, in accordance with applicable laws.

Description

About Our Team

Our employees thrive in a culture that's fast-paced and ego-free, where innovation and collaboration are encouraged at every turn. We are an organization that provides federal agencies instant access to experienced and talented professionals who understand their unique challenges and know the most efficient ways to address them. We are continually investing in resources and talent, so we stay prepared with specialized teams in place who are experts in creating tailored technologies. Our solutions empower Federal organizations to grow, modernize, and succeed in a rapidly evolving landscape.

We value all voices and want to attract talent from all backgrounds. We're on the lookout for individuals who are passionate about technology and thrive in environments where problem-solving is approached with creativity and enthusiasm. If you're someone who enjoys continuously expanding your skill set while tackling real-world business problems, you'll feel right at home with us. Veterans and military spouses are especially encouraged to bring your unique and valuable experience to our team.

About the Role

Our team is seeking a Power Apps/Power BI Developer to join our fast-growing IT-project based consulting business. We need a team member who is ready to build and implement innovative Power Platform and business intelligence solutions to support the missions of our customers. We have several large projects, some established, some just getting started, at the Department of Veterans Affairs and we need smart team members to help us deliver.

The successful candidate will be an inquisitive problem solver who enjoys turning data and business processes into intuitive applications and actionable dashboards. In this fully remote role, you will build and enhance Power Apps interfaces, develop reporting that leadership uses to measure program performance and contractor accountability, and contribute creative solutions to our customers' challenges. Join our development team and help us positively impact the lives of millions of Veterans through innovative, data-driven, and user-centric solutions.

You will work and collaborate on a team of project managers, business analysts, developers/engineers, and QA staff within an Agile environment. As a crucial member of our team, you will also be expected to interface with client representatives, including product owners, business owners, and technical leads.

  • Build, enhance, and maintain Power Apps that serve as the user interface for a custom-developed, Azure-hosted enterprise system.
  • Develop Power BI reports and dashboards, including data models, DAX measures, and Power Query transformations.
  • Build local, regional, and national reporting using dashboards, charts, maps, and other visualization formats.
  • Integrate and transform data from Microsoft SQL Server, enterprise data warehouses, and external partner data sources that refresh daily.
  • Configure and maintain Power BI data gateway connections and scheduled refreshes.
  • Perform data quality analysis to identify trends, outliers, and issues requiring upstream remediation.

  • Participate in peer reviews of apps, reports, and data models.
  • Develop documentation throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC).

raw.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara Security is looking for a Senior Threat Detection Engineer. This is a hands-on engineering role: you will build and operate the signals, pipelines, and tooling that power how we discover threats against Samsara and our customers.

The Threat Detection team owns the detection platform end to end — the data pipelines that feed it, the detection content that runs on it, the CI/CD that ships it, and the AI-assisted tooling that scales what a small team can cover. You will write detections, and you will also build the machinery that makes the next detection faster to develop, safer to deploy, and measurable in production.

You will report to the Director of Threat Detection and Response and work closely with Security Operations, Application Security, and Enterprise Security, as well as engineering teams across the company.

We are looking for someone who takes projects from idea to proof-of-concept to production, who is comfortable being the first person to build something, and who is genuinely interested in what AI can and cannot do for detection engineering — including where it introduces risk rather than removing it.

This role is open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Build, deploy, and continuously improve MITRE ATT&CK–aligned detections across cloud, endpoint, identity, email, and application telemetry, with clear false-positive thresholds.
  • Own the full detection lifecycle—from hypothesis, data validation, and baselining through deployment, tuning, validation, and retirement.
  • Advance our detection-as-code platform through version control, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, and improved pipeline reliability and observability.
  • Identify emerging threat surfaces and build integrations that strengthen data ingestion, enrichment, and coverage across internal and third-party systems.
  • Evaluate AI-powered security capabilities, including secure MCP integrations, threat hunting, anomaly detection, and response automation.
  • Turn threat intelligence into actionable detection and retrospective scanning.
  • Partner closely with Security Operations during investigations, incidents, table top exercises, detection maintenance, and code pairing.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 6+ years in security engineering, detection engineering, or a related technology discipline.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience analyzing large datasets to build and validate detections.
  • Hands-on experience with detection-as-code, Git-based workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD deployment.
  • Deep experience with modern SIEM platforms, including data onboarding, advanced queries, dashboards, and threat intelligence enrichment.
  • Working knowledge of AWS, Linux, containers, and EDR.
  • Proven ability to build systems from scratch, lead projects independently, learn new technologies quickly, and communicate technical concepts clearly through documentation, RFCs, and presentations.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with data orchestration platforms such as Airflow or Databricks.
  • Applied experience with LLMs, agentic frameworks, and MCP integrations, including their security risks and failure modes.
  • Experience with behavioral analytics, anomaly detection, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
  • Familiarity with risk-based alerting, ChatOps, distributed alerting, and attack simulation.
  • Additional experience with Go, Terraform, malware analysis, digital forensics, or FedRAMP environments.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$157,675—$238,500 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

raw.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LMHC, LMFT, LICSW or Licensed Psychologists) in Washington State to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week
    • Attend a world-class training program developed by industry leaders.
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Have 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time for Member Sessions
    • Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding
    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • Washington: Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Mental Health Counselor, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate

Support building the Italian market for a global safety technology company

Forwood Safety is a global SaaS company on a mission to prevent fatalities and serious incidents in high-risk industries.

Our Critical Risk Management System helps some of the world’s largest organisations identify and manage the risks that can lead to serious incidents and fatalities. Now, we’re looking to expand our presence in Italy.

We’re looking for an experienced Account Executive to support our Italian enterprise sales growth. You’ll open doors, build relationships with senior decision-makers, develop a high-value pipeline and lead complex enterprise opportunities through to close.

You’ll help shape how Forwood approaches the Italian market, working closely with our global commercial team and regional partners.

What you’ll do:

  • Support building the Italian market by identifying target organisations, developing relationships and creating new enterprise sales opportunities.
  • Own the sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through to strategic account planning, proposals, negotiation and close.
  • Build and manage a high-value new-business pipeline, maintaining momentum through long and complex enterprise sales cycles.
  • Engage with senior executives and operational leaders to understand their business priorities, critical risks and strategic objectives.
  • Work closely with Forwood’s regional partners to identify opportunities, strengthen relationships and develop effective routes to market.
  • Help shape our Italian go-to-market strategy, using your understanding of the market, customers, competitors and partners to determine where we focus and how we win.
  • Clearly communicate the value of Forwood’s technology and position it as a strategic solution for organisations looking to prevent serious incidents and fatalities.

What we’re looking for:

We’re looking for a commercially strong enterprise sales professional who enjoys opening doors, navigating complex organisations and turning opportunities into large, strategic deals.

You’ll bring:

  • Proven success selling complex B2B SaaS or technology solutions to enterprise customers.
  • A strong track record of new-business acquisition and closing high-value deals.
  • Experience managing complex, consultative sales cycles and engaging confidently with senior executives.
  • Strong commercial judgement, negotiation, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
  • The ability to work independently, create structure and take ownership in a growing market.
  • Strong Italian communication skills and good written and spoken English to collaborate with our global team.
  • A genuine interest in understanding customers’ businesses and connecting their challenges to meaningful commercial solutions.

Experience in these areas would be highly regarded:

  • Mining, manufacturing, energy, utilities, construction, oil & gas or other high-risk industries.
  • Safety, risk management or critical risk environments.
  • Enterprise sales through channel or strategic partners.
  • Building or launching a new geographic market.
  • Existing relationships with senior decision-makers in relevant Italian industries.

You don’t need to have worked in safety technology to be successful here. What’s most important is your ability to sell complex enterprise solutions, build relationships at executive level and create new business.

Why Forwood?

This is an opportunity to join a global, remote-first SaaS company where your work has a clear purpose.

You’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Help shape the Italian market rather than simply inherit an established territory.
  • Work with major organisations operating in some of the world’s highest-risk environments.
  • Sell technology with a purpose beyond commercial outcomes - helping organisations prevent serious incidents and fatalities.
  • Work alongside a global team of specialists across commercial, product, engineering and operations.
  • Build relationships with senior leaders and influence how organisations approach critical risk.
  • Have the autonomy and ownership to make a meaningful impact as Forwood continues to grow internationally.

About Forwood

Forwood provides specialised SaaS technology designed to help organisations prevent serious incidents and fatalities.

Our solutions are used by major organisations operating in high-risk environments, helping them manage critical risks and strengthen the controls that protect their people.

We are a remote-first global team, working across countries and time zones with a shared focus on making high-risk work safer.

Interested?

If you’re an experienced enterprise sales professional who enjoys building new markets, winning complex deals and working with senior decision-makers, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Content LiveOps Manager
description: We've set the standard in kids entertainment.  Come help us raise it.

raw.title: Content LiveOps Manager
raw.excerpt: We've set the standard in kids entertainment.  Come help us raise it.
raw.description:
We've set the standard in kids entertainment.
Come help us raise it.

We're Lingokids, the #1 entertainment platform for young kids. Most kids content is designed to capture attention. We create experiences little ones genuinely love.

Everything we make is created in-house to be seriously fun, with the good stuff built in from the very beginning. We're KidSAFE certified, completely ad-free, and committed to giving families entertainment they can trust, with no compromise. Ever.

20 million kids come back to us every single month, and we’ve earned more than 50 awards along the way. Now we're going after something bigger: becoming the go-to entertainment destination for kids everywhere, and changing what content looks like for the generation growing up on it.

You in? Keep on reading.

What you’ll do

As a Content LiveOps Manager, you will build Content LiveOps from (almost) zero: there's limited live-ops cadence and an early playbook, so what you set up becomes the operating rhythm Lingokids ship from here on. There's a lot to unlock too. As we grow into the leading kids' entertainment platform for licensed IPs, every new IP adds another vein of live-ops potential (events, drops, tie-ins) nobody's tapped yet.

  • You’ll own and run a weekly content release cadence: new games, new IPs, new content going live on a predictable schedule.

  • Design, plan and run time-limited events as the program matures, eg: a themed weekend drop with its own promotional treatment, not just a content update.

  • Define what a release needs beyond the content itself: teaser moments, custom or animated icons, countdown treatments, in-app announcements, comms, and work with marketing, engineering and design to build what makes that possible.

  • Soft-launch new content and games, and own the process for how something moves from ready to live.

  • Partner with the Content Experimentation team to test the variables that matter (event length, timing, locking, positioning, packaging) and use the results to improve the next release.

  • Be accountable for whether releases actually land: on schedule, and with a measurable lift in engagement and retention.

What you’ll bring

  • Direct experience running a content release cadence, live-ops strategy, or live-events pipeline, done operationally.

  • Comfort with a weekly operating rhythm.

  • Strong cross-functional coordination skills: you'll be pulling in engineering, art, and design capacity shared across a broader team, not a dedicated build team of your own.

  • LiveOps and Performance Data literacy: you can look at a release's performance and know whether it worked, how to iterate, and why.

  • Background in games where "what's live changes constantly" is a normal part of the job.

Nice to have.

  • Experience specifically with time-limited or seasonal events (eg: a holiday tie-in, a licensed-IP drop, a themed weekend…)

  • Familiarity with subscription or content platforms for a young or family audience.

English is a must:We’re a multicultural team providing a service in English, so while certifications aren’t necessary, fluency is essential. As a fully remote company, clear and effective spoken and written communication—especially in asynchronous, long-form formats—is key to collaborating successfully.

Life at Lingokids

📚 Career Growth: Your growth drives our success! We invest in your development up to €2,000 per year for books and training; so you can keep learning and growing with us.

🏡 Remote in Spain & Relocation-Friendly Work from wherever you’re most productive, whether that’s your home anywhere in Spain or our vibrant hub in Madrid. Not currently in Spain? We’d love to have you here! We actively encourage relocation for those looking to make Spain their new home base.

📈 Stock Options: Your contribution matters! You'll receive stock options, giving you the opportunity to own part of the company and share in its success.

🖥 Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a €400 allowance for setup and €35/month for remote work expenses, because comfort fuels creativity!

🍲 Meal Allowances: Get €60/month on your Cobee card to enjoy meals at restaurants or food delivery, good food makes everything better!

💳 Flexible Compensation: Manage your meal, transport and childcare expenses easily with Cobee, integrating them directly into your payroll.

🩺 Health Insurance: Access private health coverage at exclusive rates through Adeslas, seamlessly deducted from your payroll, quality care made simple.

💬 Language Lessons: Learning never stops! Enjoy free language classes in Spanish and English, to sharpen your skills and stay connected in a global team.

🌍 Visa Sponsorship: If you need a visa to work in the EU, we’ll handle the process and cover the costs to make your transition seamless.

🎉 Company events: Yes! We’re a fully remote team spread across different countries, but we love getting together from time to time in different corners of Spain, for team gatherings and recharging at our amazing off-sites!

Passion matters more than perfection

Didn’t check every box for this role? No worries! We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who believe in our mission. If that sounds like you, we’d still love to hear from you!

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Lingokids, diversity isn’t just a checkbox—it’s at the heart of everything we do. Just like we teach kids to embrace differences, we celebrate them in our team, knowing that the best ideas come from unique perspectives. We’re all about creating a space where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to be their authentic selves. No matter your background, identity, or story, if you’re passionate about making a difference in education, we want you here.

raw.description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Integration Platform Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $130,000–$180,000 Annually
Experience Required:10+ Years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a highly experienced Integration Platform Developer with 10+ years of enterprise integration experience, including extensive expertise with the Dell Boomi AtomSphere Platform. The ideal candidate will design, develop, and manage enterprise-scale integration solutions while driving API strategy, event-driven architecture, governance, security, and platform modernization initiatives. This role requires a hands-on technical leader capable of delivering highly scalable, secure, and reusable integration solutions while collaborating with enterprise architects, application teams, and business stakeholders across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise integration solutions using the Dell Boomi AtomSphere Platform, including process development, connector configuration, and runtime optimization.
  • Architect scalable integration solutions utilizing API-led connectivity, event-driven architecture, and enterprise integration best practices.

raw.excerpt: Die Endo Health GmbH entwickelt digitale Gesundheitslösungen, um die Versorgung von Frauen nachhaltig zu verbessern.
raw.description:
Die Endo Health GmbH entwickelt digitale Gesundheitslösungen, um die Versorgung von Frauen nachhaltig zu verbessern. Unsere Vision ist eine Welt, in der jede Frau Zugang zu einer personalisierten, wirksamen und digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung hat.

Mit unseren Anwendungen unterstützen wir Betroffene dabei, ihre Gesundheit selbstbestimmt zu gestalten, und schließen gleichzeitig bestehende Versorgungslücken im Gesundheitssystem. So gestalten wir Frauengesundheit aktiv neu und stärken sie langfristig. Mit der Endo-App, der isi-App und der Vera-App begleiten wir Frauen bereits heute in unterschiedlichen Lebensphasen und bei unterschiedlichen gesundheitlichen Themen – und wir haben noch viel vor: Unser Produktportfolio wächst kontinuierlich weiter.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unsere Organic Social-Media-Accounts, gestaltest die Content-Strategie für Paid und Organic und entwickelst unsere KI-gestützten Content-Prozesse aktiv weiter. Carousels, Stories und UGC-Formate entstehen bei uns zunehmend in einer automatisierten KI-Pipeline – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du entscheidest, was guter Content ist, testest neue Ansätze und machst unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich besser. Dabei verbindest du strategisches Denken mit operativer Umsetzung und bringst Erfahrung im Aufbau KI-gestützter Content-Prozesse mit.

Du berichtest direkt an den Head of Marketing, übernimmst Verantwortung für einen Werkstudenten oder eine Werkstudentin und arbeitest eng mit unserer Performance-Marketing-Managerin sowie weiteren interdisziplinären Teams zusammen. Du bekommst dabei viel Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen, Dinge auszuprobieren und Themen wirklich voranzutreiben.

Strategische Verantwortung

  • Du gestaltest die Content- und Social-Media-Strategie für unsere verschiedenen Apps und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter
  • Du baust nachhaltig wachsende Social-Media-Kanäle und vertrauensvolle Communities auf und steigerst Reichweite, Engagement und relevanten Traffic kontinuierlich
  • Du entwickelst Kommunikationsmessages und Creatives für Organic und Paid weiter – mit einem guten Gespür dafür, was Menschen erreicht und was wirklich performt
  • Du steuerst Influencer- und Markenkooperationen mit Unterstützung eines Freelancers und entwickelst daraus neue Impulse für Community, Reichweite und Markenwachstum

KI & Marketing Automation

  • Du baust skalierbare, KI-gestützte Content-Prozesse auf und optimierst sie kontinuierlich – damit wir schneller und effizienter produzieren können, ohne Qualität, Kreativität oder Markenstimme zu verlieren
  • Du bringst deine KI-Expertise auch ins restliche Marketing-Team ein und hilfst dabei, weitere sinnvolle Automatisierungsprozesse aufzubauen

Operative Umsetzung

  • Du setzt unsere Still-Contentproduktion für Organic operativ mit Hilfe von KI-Prozessen um und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter
  • Du steuerst und gestaltest das UGC-Management für Paid & Organic gemeinsam mit einem Werkstudenten oder einer Werkstudentin
  • Du analysierst regelmäßig unsere Content- und Kanalperformance, leitest konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab und machst relevante KPIs für das Team verständlich und nutzbar

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

Social-Media- & Content-Kompetenz

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im Content-, Social Media- oder Digital Marketing
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge beim Aufbau und der Skalierung organischer Social-Media-Kanäle und Communities
  • Fundierte operative Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Produktion performanter Inhalte für Organic und Paid sowie ein gutes Verständnis von Performance Marketing
  • Breite Kenntnisse relevanter Social-Media-Plattformen – von Meta und TikTok über YouTube und Pinterest bis hin zu neuen Plattformen und Trends
  • Erfahrung im Healthcare-, Pharma- oder Digital-Health-Umfeld ist von Vorteil

KI-Expertise

  • Tiefgehende, nachweisliche Erfahrung im Einsatz von KI in der Content-Produktion, im Aufbau effizienter Content-Workflows und in der Marketing-Automatisierung
  • Routine mit KI im Alltag: Du nutzt KI-Tools für Text, Bild und Video täglich und selbstverständlich – z. B. Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Runway oder CapCut AI. Du weißt, was sie können und wo sie danebenliegen.
  • Verständnis dafür, wie KI-Systeme gesteuert werden: Du kannst Prompts und Anweisungen lesen und anpassen, Outputs systematisch bewerten und Anforderungen so formulieren, dass daraus etwas gebaut werden kann.

Wichtig: KI-Know-how ist für uns kein Add-on, sondern ein zentraler Bestandteil dieser Position. Deshalb freuen wir uns besonders auf Menschen, die bereits KI-gestützte Content-Prozesse aufgebaut und Content-Produktion damit messbar skaliert haben. Wenn du KI nicht nur nutzt, sondern richtig Lust hast, Prozesse damit neu zu denken, zu testen und immer weiterzuentwickeln, passt du sehr gut zu dieser Rolle.

Das zeichnet dich aus

  • Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, bringst Themen proaktiv voran und hast Freude daran, aus Ideen konkrete Lösungen zu machen.
  • Du denkst strategisch, packst gleichzeitig gerne selbst mit an und möchtest deine Ideen nicht nur diskutieren, sondern in die Umsetzung
  • Du bist begeistert von neuen KI-Tools und hast richtig Lust, immer wieder neue Ansätze zu entdecken, zu testen und damit unser Marketing besser zu machen.
  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für starke visuelle und kreative Umsetzung und erkennst schnell, was guten Content ausmacht.
  • Du bist analysestark
  • Du kommunizierst gerne, arbeitest im Team und freust dich auf einen offenen, direkten Austausch, in dem gute Ideen schnell umgesetzt werden können.

Benefits

Benefits

  • 100 % Remote-Arbeit – mit viel Flexibilität, Eigenverantwortung und echtem Teamspirit
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum, kurze Wege und echte Ownership – deine Ideen können bei uns schnell Wirkung entfalten
  • Regelmäßige Teamtreffen vor Ort (ca. 3× jährlich), bei denen wir auch persönlich zusammenkommen, Ideen teilen und gemeinsam Zeit verbringen
  • Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg durch VSOP
  • Weiterbildungs- und Coaching-Budget, damit du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln kannst
  • Ein engagiertes, interdisziplinäres Team mit einer klaren Mission: Gemeinsam wollen wir die Gesundheitsversorgung von Frauen nachhaltig verbessern – und dabei wirklich etwas bewegen.

Damit wir direkt einen Eindruck davon bekommen, wie du denkst und arbeitest, gehört eine kurze Probeaufgabe fest zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess. Bitte reiche sie direkt zusammen mit deiner Bewerbung ein. Uns geht es dabei nicht um Hochglanz, sondern darum, zu verstehen, wie du denkst.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Format: PDF oder Slides
  • Umfang: max. 2–3 Seiten oder 4–8 Slides
  • Bearbeitungszeit: 60 Minuten

Skalierbaren On-brand Instagram-Content mit KI erstellen

Wähle eine unserer Marken – Endo, Vera oder isi – und entwickle mithilfe von KI mehrere CI-konforme Instagram-Assets.

Für uns zählt nicht nur, wie gut ein einzelner Post aussieht. Besonders spannend finden wir, wie du einen KI-gestützten Prozess aufsetzt, mit dem sich hochwertiger und konsistenter Content skalierbar produzieren lässt – und welche Ideen du dabei mitbringst.

Aufgabe

Erstelle mindestens drei fertige Instagram-Assets.

Dabei bist du in der Wahl der Formate flexibel. Zum Beispiel kannst du:

  • drei Carousels erstellen oder
  • unterschiedliche Formate kombinieren, z. B. Carousel, Single Post und Story

Abgabe

Bitte sende uns:

  • mindestens drei fertige Assets als JPG, PDF oder PPT
  • die verwendeten Prompts (keine Sorge: Die müssen nicht hübsch aufbereitet sein – Spracheingabe ist völlig in Ordnung)
  • eine Beschreibung deines technischen Setups und Workflows

Bonus: Du hast für die Aufgabe eine eigene Anwendung oder ein kleines Tool gebaut? Umso besser – dann zeig uns sehr gerne per Link, wie du damit Assets generierst.

Beantworte zudem kurz folgende Fragen:

  • Warum hast du genau diese KI-Tools und Modelle gewählt?
  • An welchen Stellen ist ein Human-in-the-Loop notwendig und warum?
  • Wie würdest du den Prozess auf 40–50 Assets pro Monat und mehrere Marken skalieren?

raw.description:
Senior Key Account Manager

Department:

Commercial Operations & Global Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning

Reports To:

Director, Commercial Operations & Global Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning

Location:

Remote option or onsite in either Marquette, MI or Bethlehem, PA (travel to sites and customers quarterly, approx. 20%)

FLSA Status:

Exempt

MAIN FUNCTION

The Senior Key Account Manager holds primary ownership of Exalta's most strategically significant original equipment manufacturer (OEM) accounts, serving as the senior customer-facing leader within the Commercial Operations team. This role requires substantial prior customer-facing experience within the OEM industry — medical device OEM experience strongly preferred — combined with demonstrated judgment managing complex, multi-site customer relationships at the executive level. The Senior Key Account Manager owns the customer Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) cadence for assigned strategic accounts, serves as the senior escalation point for customer-impacting issues, and partners directly with the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP to translate customer demand into the SIOP process. The role also carries responsibility for mentoring and developing Key Account Managers, strengthening the team's account strategy and execution. This position is designed to build the next generation of commercial leadership within a vertically integrated medical device manufacturing environment.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Account Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end commercial relationship for Exalta's most strategically significant OEM accounts, serving as the senior point of contact across multiple product lines, programs, and sites.
  • Lead the customer S&OP cadence for assigned strategic accounts, driving rollout, phased maturity, and ongoing governance in partnership with the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP.
  • Develop account-level strategic plans that align customer growth expectations with Exalta's capacity and operational constraints.
  • Represent Commercial Operations in executive-level customer business reviews, contract discussions, and new program launch conversations.

SIOP Integration & Demand Ownership

  • Serve as the senior demand data owner for assigned strategic accounts within the SIOP process; validate and reconcile the highest-exposure forecast inputs ahead of the monthly demand review gate.
  • Own forecast accuracy performance for the largest accounts in the portfolio, identify variance drivers, and present trends into the SIOP executive alignment as needed.
  • Partner with the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP to ensure customer demand inputs are reflected accurately in the SIOP demand plan, surfacing capacity risk early.
  • Support new product introduction onboarding for strategic account programs, coordinating across quality, planning, and operations at the program level.

Escalation & Customer Experience Ownership

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for customer-impacting issues across assigned strategic accounts, providing strategic direction rather than case-level handling.
  • Own root-cause resolution for significant service disruptions, partnering with planning, supply chain, and quality to protect delivery commitments.
  • Drive proactive, executive-level communication with customers on constraint impacts, delays, or substitutions.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Mentor and coach Key Account Managers on account strategy, escalation handling, and demand data ownership.
  • Provide the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP with structured input on Key Account Manager performance, account coverage, and development needs.
  • Support onboarding and knowledge transfer for new Key Account Management team members.

Analytics, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Own KPI reporting for the Key Account Management team, consolidating on-time delivery, backorder, and fill rate performance across the portfolio.
  • Identify systemic trends across accounts and lead continuous improvement initiatives in customer operations, demand management, and order fulfillment workflows.
  • Contribute to ERP (Epicor) and Power BI reporting enhancements supporting Commercial Operations and SIOP objectives.
  • Ensure all customer-facing operations comply with FDA, ISO 13485, ISO 9001, and company quality standards.

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Customer Focus — advanced ability to build and sustain executive-level relationships with OEM customers.
  • Leadership and Mentorship — proven ability to guide and develop Key Account Managers.
  • Business Acumen — strong understanding of OEM contract manufacturing economics, capacity constraints, and account profitability drivers.
  • Conflict Resolution and Negotiation — expertise managing complex, high-stakes customer issues to resolution.
  • Analytical and Critical Thinking — ability to translate order, forecast, and fulfillment data into account strategy.
  • Communication — executive-level written and verbal communication skills, able to represent Exalta credibly with customer Director- and Vice President-level stakeholders.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of large, complex OEM accounts simultaneously, balancing strategic priorities with day-to-day delivery commitments.
  • Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent Exalta professionally in high-visibility customer settings.
  • Advanced analytical ability to translate order, forecast, and fulfillment data into account-level strategy and risk mitigation.
  • Proven skill mentoring and developing less experienced team members.
  • Collaborative working style with a demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional follow-through at senior levels.
  • Deep familiarity with demand planning, Sales and Operations Planning processes, and customer order management.
  • Proficiency in enterprise resource planning systems (Epicor preferred), Microsoft Excel (advanced), and Power BI or equivalent reporting tools.

REQUIRED / PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field required; Master's degree a plus.
  • Minimum of five years of direct, customer-facing experience within the OEM industry required; medical device OEM or contract manufacturing experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience owning or supporting a formal Sales and Operations Planning or Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning cadence with strategic accounts.
  • Prior experience mentoring, coaching, or informally leading account management team members preferred.
  • Experience navigating FDA-regulated or ISO 13485 quality environments strongly preferred.
  • Epicor enterprise resource planning experience preferred; exposure to order management or demand planning modules is an advantage.

WORKING CONDITIONS

This position operates in a professional office environment with periodic interaction with manufacturing and warehouse functions. Travel to customer sites and offices may be required (approximately 20%, generally on a quarterly cadence). Must be able to maintain composure and professionalism in high-visibility, executive-level customer escalation scenarios.

Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market.

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.
  • Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.
  • Develop practical sales skills, including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.
  • Train new hires on our product, sales processes, and day-to-day tools, including CRM systems, telephony, WhatsApp-based communication tools, and other digital sales platforms.
  • Run highly interactive training sessions using role plays, mock sales calls, real-life scenarios, demonstrations, practical exercises, and continuous feedback to make sure trainees can apply what they learn in real conversations.
  • Assess each trainee’s progress throughout the two weeks, identify individual gaps, adapt your coaching approach, and provide clear feedback on their readiness before handing them over to their Sales Supervisor.
  • Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.
  • Maintain and improve onboarding materials, including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.
  • Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

  • Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.

  • Experience coaching or developing underperforming salespeople and helping them improve through practice, feedback, and structured follow-up.
  • Experience working in high-volume sales environments, including call centers or similar teams.
  • Experience creating or maintaining training materials, scripts, presentations, onboarding guides, or process documentation.
  • Experience using AI and modern productivity tools to create or improve training content, scripts, exercises, presentations, or documentation.
  • Experience working with LATAM-based sales teams serving the US market.

What we can offer you

  • A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 1000-2000 USD Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.
