raw.description:
Background

The African Climate Foundation (ACF) is the first and only African-led climate change re-granting organisation on the continent. Through a combination of grant making, fellowships, transformational research, technical assistance, coalition building and advocacy the ACF seeks to support interventions at the nexus of climate change, and development that have the greatest potential to deliver long-term socio-economic transformation and inclusive development. ACF also provides Fiscal Hosting (also called Fiscal Sponsorship) services to support emerging and mission aligned organisations and initiatives

All African countries should have the capacities, resources, and tools to shape their own energy transitions. African Energy Futures (AEF), housed within the African Climate Foundation, will fund African institutions to build energy systems knowledge and tools that meet African needs; train the rising generation of African energy system analysts; strengthen local energy policy and decision-making; and ensure Africa plays a greater role in shaping energy research, policy, and investment.

Purpose

The African Climate Foundation (ACF) and African Energy Futures (AEF) are establishing a shared Strategic Data & Intelligence Unit to improve how African energy and development data are gathered, governed, analysed, visualised and used.

The unit will build and maintain an online data visualisation platform, develop compelling evidence-based narratives that can shift public and policy understanding, and provide strategic analytical services to grant-making and regranting organisations. It will work closely with Ember during the platform’s initial development, while progressively building independent African capability in data infrastructure, analysis and storytelling.

The initial four-person team is intentionally multidisciplinary. It combines strategic intelligence and philanthropy engagement, applied artificial intelligence and platform development, rigorous data science and governance, and sustained hands-on data acquisition and cleaning.

Scope of the role

Reporting to the Project Director, the AI & Data Platforms Lead will design and deliver the digital and AI-enabled capabilities of the unit. The role combines product thinking, data engineering, applied AI and practical software development. You will work with Ember and other partners to develop the online data storage and visualisation platform, create efficient data workflows, and identify responsible AI applications that improve research, grant-making, communications and knowledge management across ACF and AEF. This is an applied role: the successful candidate must be able to move from experimentation to reliable tools that colleagues can use.

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

Platform and product development

  • Lead the technical design, development and iterative improvement of the online data platform and visualisation tools.
  • Translate user needs into a prioritised product roadmap, prototypes, specifications and tested releases.
  • Work with Ember to adapt or integrate relevant platform components while building a pathway to independent ACF-AEF capability.
  • Design for accessibility, low-bandwidth use, maintainability, multilingual expansion and responsible open access where appropriate.
  • Implement analytics, usage monitoring and user-feedback processes to improve product relevance.

Data engineering and architecture

  • Design scalable data ingestion, transformation, storage, metadata, versioning and publishing pipelines.
  • Integrate structured and unstructured data from public, partner and internal sources using APIs, automated workflows and documented manual processes.
  • Collaborate with the Junior Data Scientist to implement validation, provenance, reproducibility, access control and release standards.
  • Maintain technical documentation, source-code repositories, testing processes, backups and business-continuity arrangements.

Applied AI and automation

  • Identify, prototype and deploy useful AI applications for data discovery, extraction, classification, cleaning, summarisation, visualisation, research and internal knowledge management.
  • Develop retrieval, search and assisted-analysis tools that connect users to trusted ACF-AEF data and evidence.
  • Evaluate build-versus-buy choices and select appropriate open-source or commercial tools.
  • Create human-in-the-loop evaluation processes to manage hallucination, bias, confidentiality, intellectual-property and security risks.
  • Monitor relevant AI developments and provide practical briefings, demonstrations and guidance to ACF and AEF teams.
  • User enablement and collaboration
  • Work closely with analysts, programme teams, communications colleagues and external users to understand workflows and adoption barriers.
  • Provide training, templates and technical support that help colleagues use AI and data tools safely and effectively.
  • Manage technical vendors and contributors where necessary and conduct appropriate code and security reviews.

Requirements include but are not limited to:

  • Degree or equivalent practical experience in computer science, data engineering, information systems, software engineering, computational science or a related field.
  • At least 6 years of relevant experience in software, data-platform, data-engineering or applied-AI roles, including delivery of user-facing tools.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, experience with APIs and databases, and familiarity with modern web-based data visualisation approaches.
  • Practical experience with cloud infrastructure, deployment, version control, testing and secure data workflows.
  • Hands-on experience applying large language models or machine-learning tools to real organisational use cases.
  • Ability to explain technical choices, risks and trade-offs clearly to non-technical colleagues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with open-data platforms, geospatial data, energy data, development indicators or public-interest technology.
  • Knowledge of data protection, cybersecurity, AI governance and model evaluation in nonprofit or research environments.
  • Experience supporting organisations operating across multiple African countries and variable digital infrastructure.

Business Development & Operations Lead

Remote | Full-time | 40-hours/week
Rate: $7 to $8/hour, with the final rate to be determined during the final interview.

About Pillar Health Solutions ()

Pillar Health Solutions is a growing healthcare company that partners with medical practices to provide insurance-supported dietary and exercise counseling programs for patients.

Our model connects physicians and their patients with dietitians, virtual trainers, and operational support designed to improve patient engagement and continuity of care.

We are entering an important growth stage and are looking for a Business Development & Operations Lead who can help expand our physician partnerships while strengthening the operational systems and client experience supporting that growth.

This is not a traditional back-office Operations Manager position.

We are looking for someone who can operate as a trusted extension of the leadership team: part business developer, part client success leader, part operator, and part strategic problem solver.

What You Will Own

Physician Acquisition & Business Growth

A major priority for this role is helping Pillar Health Solutions grow its network of physician and medical-practice partners.

You will:

  • Develop and execute practical strategies for attracting new physician and clinic partnerships

  • Identify opportunities to reach physicians, practice owners, office managers, and other healthcare decision-makers

  • Support organic marketing and local-market growth initiatives

  • Help develop physician-facing messaging, success stories, testimonials, and other materials that strengthen Pillar's value proposition

  • Research new channels, tools, partnerships, and approaches for increasing qualified opportunities

You do not need to be a career marketer, but you should understand how businesses grow and be able to contribute thoughtful, executable ideas.

Discovery Calls & Client Conversion

You will help convert interested medical practices into active Pillar partners.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting or facilitating discovery calls with prospective physician partners

  • Explaining Pillar's services and patient-support model confidently

  • Communicating fees, billing structure, workflow, and partnership expectations clearly

  • Understanding the prospective practice's needs and identifying how Pillar can support them

  • Following up on opportunities and moving qualified prospects toward partnership

  • Continuously improving the discovery and conversion process based on feedback and results

Success in this position requires someone who is comfortable speaking directly with physicians, business owners, and senior decision-makers.

Physician, Patient & Program Operations

Once partnerships are established, you will help ensure that the experience remains strong for physicians and patients.

You will:

  • Serve as a key operational contact for physician partners

  • Monitor feedback from physicians and patients and take appropriate action

  • Coordinate with dietitians, virtual trainers, administrative staff, and virtual assistants

  • Support thoughtful matching between patients, dietitians, and virtual trainers when appropriate

  • Monitor patient engagement and identify concerns before they become escalations

  • Address service issues, complaints, and operational breakdowns

  • Help establish appropriate check-ins across the patient, dietitian, trainer, and physician relationship

Because patient experience can directly affect program continuation and business performance, this role requires someone who notices problems early and acts on them.

Founder Partnership & Executive Communication

You will work closely with Pillar Health Solutions leadership and should be comfortable communicating directly with a founder.

Initially, this may include a short daily business update meeting.

You will be expected to:

  • Prepare and drive the agenda rather than waiting for leadership to determine what should be discussed

  • Provide concise updates on projects, priorities, wins, risks, and unresolved issues

  • Explain not only what happened, but why it happened

  • Present recommended next steps and anticipated outcomes

  • Bring thoughtful options instead of open-ended problems

  • Negotiate priorities, expectations, and timelines when necessary

  • Provide respectful pushback when an idea may not be practical or when another priority should come first

  • Maintain transparency even when progress is slower than expected

We are looking for someone who can disagree professionally, communicate difficult information tactfully, and remain levelheaded under pressure.

AI & Technology Integration

Pillar wants AI to become a practical part of how the business operates.

You will:

  • Identify opportunities where AI can improve existing workflows

  • Research tools independently when a business problem arises

  • Use AI for research, analysis, documentation, communication, marketing support, and process improvement

We are looking for practical AI literacy, not simply someone who has used ChatGPT occasionally.

Operational Excellence

Although growth is an immediate priority, you will also help strengthen Pillar's operational foundation.

This may include:

  • Monitoring business and client KPIs

  • Improving workflows as operational gaps become visible

  • Maintaining accurate client, physician, patient, billing, and reporting information

  • Supporting consistent naming conventions and documentation

  • Reviewing processes for accuracy and efficiency

  • Creating or improving SOPs when a documented process is genuinely needed

  • Supporting scheduling, invoicing, reporting, and administrative coordination

  • Helping the company prepare operationally as the number of physician partners and patients increases

As Pillar grows, the scope of the position may expand into greater leadership and team-management responsibilities.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of relevant experience across business operations, executive support, business development, customer success, healthcare operations, or a related field

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leaders, founders, executives, physicians, or business owners

  • Strong client-facing communication and relationship-management skills

  • Ability to manage several responsibilities simultaneously in a startup or rapidly changing environment

  • Experience solving problems independently without waiting for detailed instructions

  • Strong written and verbal communication

  • Confidence facilitating meetings and business conversations

  • Ability to organize information and communicate progress clearly

  • Strong judgment when dealing with sensitive or difficult conversations

  • Comfortable learning unfamiliar systems and processes independently

  • Practical experience using AI tools for business or productivity

  • High attention to detail, particularly where client information, billing, reporting, or financial accuracy is involved

Highly Preferred

  • Healthcare practice, healthcare startup, wellness, medical services, or physician-facing experience

  • Experience supporting a startup founder or small-business owner

  • Experience conducting discovery, sales, partnership, or client-conversion calls

  • Exposure to physician acquisition or healthcare business development

  • Experience with local or organic marketing

  • Customer Success Management experience

  • Chief of Staff or senior Executive Assistant experience

  • Experience introducing new technologies or AI-driven workflows into an organization

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LPCC, LIMFT, LISW) in Ohio to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

You think about quality as something you design into the product and process, not a checklist you run before release, effectively shifting quality assurance left.

Our Stack

  • QA Architecture & Mobile Automation: Extensive experience designing scalable testing strategies and hands-on expertise with mobile automation frameworks (Appium, Flutter integration testing) and cloud device farms (BrowserStack)

Location: Fully Remote from India

Employment Type: Long-Term Contract

Shift: 2.00 PM – 11.00 PM IST

About Paralucent
Paralucent brings clarity to complex work, helping organisations move beyond complexity towards clarity through practical, thoughtful technology solutions.

Paralucent Core Values

We’re Driven to deliver real outcomes, and we Take Ownership from first question to final result. We’re Creative Problem Solvers who cut through complexity to bring clarity, and we’re Humbly Confident, with high standards, low ego and a commitment to continuous learning. Above all, we’re Customer Centric: we build with empathy, partner closely, and measure success by the impact we create for the people who rely on what we deliver.

Why This Role Matters
You will enable Agile delivery teams to work predictably, collaboratively and with a clear focus on value. As an experienced Scrum Master, you will facilitate Scrum ceremonies, remove delivery impediments and support continuous improvement in a SAFe environment. You will partner closely with Product Owners, Release Train Engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen team maturity, align delivery to programme objectives and help teams deliver meaningful outcomes.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:

  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews and retrospectives.
  • Coach delivery teams on Scrum, Agile principles and SAFe practices to improve delivery predictability and team maturity.
  • Support Programme Increment planning, including dependency management, risk identification and alignment to programme objectives.
  • Partner with Product Owners to maintain healthy, prioritised product backlogs and clearly defined user stories.
  • Identify, track and remove impediments affecting team performance or delivery timelines.
  • Monitor and communicate delivery health, including sprint progress, velocity, capacity, risks, dependencies and delivery metrics.
  • Drive continuous improvement through actionable retrospectives and measurable process enhancements.
  • Strengthen collaboration across development, QA, product, architecture and business teams.
  • Maintain Agile delivery artefacts in Azure DevOps, including boards, dashboards, reports and work item tracking.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach or in a related Agile delivery role.
  • Strong experience applying Scrum and Agile delivery practices within software or technology teams.
  • Experience working in a SAFe environment, including Programme Increment planning and cross-team dependency management.
  • Hands-on Azure DevOps experience, including backlog management, sprint boards, dashboards, queries, reporting and work item tracking.
  • Demonstrated ability to facilitate meetings, resolve impediments and guide teams through change.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management and conflict resolution skills.
  • Experience partnering with Product Owners and technical teams to improve backlog readiness and sprint execution.

Nice to Have

  • Scrum Master certification, such as PSM, CSM or SAFe Scrum Master.
  • SAFe certification, such as SAFe Agilist or SAFe Scrum Master.
  • Experience supporting multiple Agile teams or Agile Release Trains.
  • Familiarity with Agile metrics, including velocity, burndown or burnup, cycle time, lead time and predictability.
  • Experience supporting enterprise software delivery, DevOps, cloud or digital transformation programmes.

If you want to do work you’re proud of, with people who own the outcome, this is your place.

raw.excerpt: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world.
raw.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We’re building a team with a passion for learning, operating, and creating new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about every customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight, and we strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as a leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success into the digital space, ready to join us?

What’s the position?

We’re looking for a Principal Backend Engineer to own technical direction for backend capabilities within the Promos domain, working within our shared service and cloud ecosystem. You will solve complex distributed systems problems, guide the evolution of APIs, events, data, and services, and raise the engineering bar across teams while remaining close to the code.

Working across Product, Mobile, Web, Data, QA, Platform, Security, Compliance, and Operations, you will turn ambiguous needs into durable strategies and guide critical initiatives from discovery through production. Principal level impact means creating clarity beyond one team, developing other engineers, and being accountable for organizational outcomes, not only implementation.

Your responsibilities will include:

Technical strategy and architecture

  • Own backend technical direction for the assigned product domain, such as Promos, while aligning with shared platform, cloud, data, and service standards.

  • Partner with Principal and Staff Engineers and teams that own shared capabilities such as identity, payments, compliance, messaging, and platform services, integrating those capabilities while maintaining clear ownership boundaries.

  • Guide architecture evolution and modernization, balancing product delivery, technical debt, scalability, and platform investment through pragmatic decisions, clear tradeoffs, and measurable outcomes.

  • Lead major restructuring work through planned iterative delivery: establish the target end state before execution, decompose the initiative into sequenced tickets, surface dependencies and risks, and provide credible delivery dates that are updated as evidence changes.

Promotional and backend capabilities

  • Build scalable and reliable promotion lifecycle capabilities, including configuration, eligibility, activation, state transitions, rewards, expiration, auditability, idempotency, and recovery.

  • Partner with Product, Mobile, Web, Back Office, Data, and Operations to define service boundaries, API and event contracts, experimentation, success measures, and operational controls.

  • Design resilient services for high traffic and transaction volume, using appropriate data consistency, caching, asynchronous processing, rate controls, and graceful degradation strategies.

Execution, quality, and operations

  • Remain hands on with the hardest problems, turning ambiguity into iterative delivery while delegating effectively and correcting work that is off course or not producing value.

  • Model and raise a high bar for code review, using reviews to improve correctness, maintainability, shared understanding, and engineer growth, and advance standards for testing, API design, security, observability, performance, CI/CD, controlled rollout, data migration, and production readiness.

  • Lead diagnosis across services, APIs, databases, caches, queues, and event streams using correlated logs, traces, and metrics, turning incidents into systemic improvements.

AI enabled engineering

  • Drive responsible adoption of AI assisted development across discovery, implementation, testing, documentation, debugging, and review, measuring improvements to quality, speed, learning, and developer experience.

  • Identify valuable product and operational uses for AI, assess feasibility and model risk, and establish guardrails for evaluation, confidential data, human accountability, and production safety.

Organizational impact and culture

  • Act proactively as a trusted technical advisor to Product and Engineering teams, identifying risks and opportunities early and using customer, operational, and market insight to make clear recommendations and drive decisions to closure.

  • Mentor Senior and Staff Engineers through architectural guidance, reviews, pairing, and reusable knowledge, and contribute technical perspective to senior hiring, capability planning, and career development.

  • Resolve systemic risks, ownership gaps, and missing capabilities by bringing the right people together, and lead change with calm ownership, constructive conflict, clear commitments, and learning without blame.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Typically 10+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial experience designing and operating distributed backend systems, plus a degree in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent demonstrated experience.

  • Deep expertise with Java, Spring, and Spring Boot, with a record of establishing patterns and standards adopted by multiple teams.

  • Strong AWS knowledge and experience building scalable, resilient applications across multiple regions and availability zones.

  • Expertise with relational data systems such as PostgreSQL or CockroachDB, including schema design, transactions, migrations, indexing, performance, and consistency tradeoffs.

  • Experience with streaming technologies such as Amazon Kinesis or Kafka and messaging systems such as SQS, RabbitMQ, or ActiveMQ.

  • Experience designing microservice and service oriented architectures and operating containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Strong judgment around high volume systems, concurrency, idempotency, caching, asynchronous workflows, failure recovery, and backward compatible API and event evolution.

  • Strong engineering judgment across testing, observability, CI/CD, secure development, performance, privacy, and production operations for business critical systems.

  • Hands on fluency with AI assisted development and a practical understanding of evaluation, hallucination risk, privacy, security, and responsible human review.

  • A record of shaping technical and product strategy, delivering ambiguous multi team initiatives, communicating clearly with senior stakeholders, and influencing outcomes without relying on formal authority.

Preferred experience:

  • Experience in sportsbook, casino, online gaming, fintech, banking, or another regulated digital industry.

  • Experience building promotion, loyalty, offer, reward, experimentation, or customer engagement platforms.

  • Experience scaling engineering through shared libraries, developer platforms, service templates, internal tooling, or production AI practices.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • Flexible work from home or office hours

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

  • Opportunity to build products enjoyed by millions as part of a passionate team

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and we trust and empower our team to own and improve that experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where, regardless of background or beliefs, you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you. Hard Rock Digital is an equal opportunity employer.

raw.title: Engineering Manager - App Stores
raw.excerpt: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets.
raw.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This is a technical management role to lead a team that develops Python and Golang micro-services that power our global software distribution engine. The world sees it as the Snap Store and marketplaces, behind the scenes it is a unified system that understands key concepts in software distribution - architectures, releases, betas, release candidates, stable releases, branches and more. We are on a journey to transform the experience that people all over the world have with their open source software by significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through this system. If you have a passion for clean APIs, believe that great engineers ship software calmly and regularly against an agile plan, and know that tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in.

This is a great opportunity to take part in engineering a highly scalable SaaS product (think about the load on our systems when one of our largest Ubuntu Desktop snaps is updated by the publisher, for instance). In addition, you will have the opportunity to learn from Canonical's world-class security team as we work collectively to deliver this capability, safely, to our customers around the world.

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, but know that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution. You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team.

This is a great opportunity to really learn how to do engineering of a highly-scalable SaaS product (think about the load on our systems when one of our largest Ubuntu Desktop snaps is updated by the publisher, for instance). In addition, you will have the opportunity to learn from Canonical's world-class security team as we work collectively to deliver this capability, safely, to our customers around the world.

Location: This role may be based remotely in the Americas, Europe, Middle East or Africa time zones.

What your day will look like

  • Lead a remote team of engineers in your time zone
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands-on career development
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • With your team, build clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang).
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open-source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • Good experience in leading modern, agile software development practices
  • Experience in forming a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Demonstrative experience of being a role model for sound engineering principles and directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the timely delivery of high-quality software
  • You value and nurture great team culture and spirit
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • Software development experience in Python (experience in Golang in addition to that would be a big plus)
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with Linux system administration

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

ifeel | Internationaal platform voor mentale gezondheid

ifeel is een wereldwijd platform voor mentale gezondheid, actief in meer dan 90 landen. We werken vanuit een evidence-based klinische aanpak en zetten ons in voor het mentale welzijn van medewerkers.

We zijn op zoek naar Nederlandstalige GZ-psychologen met een geldige BIG-registratie die deel willen uitmaken van ons internationale netwerk en cliënten in Nederland flexibele, vertrouwelijke en hoogwaardige psychologische ondersteuning willen bieden.

Als GZ-psycholoog bij ifeel kun je cliënten ondersteunen via twee complementaire vormen van online therapie:

Videotherapie: online sessies van 40 minuten, die je inplant op basis van je eigen beschikbaarheid.

Teksttherapie: asynchrone schriftelijke communicatie waarmee je cliënten op een flexibele en doorlopende manier kunt ondersteunen.

Je wordt onderdeel van een internationaal netwerk van professionals in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg en krijgt toegang tot evidence-based klinische tools, ondersteuning van ons ervaren Clinical Team en een continue instroom van cliënten die aansluiten bij jouw expertise.

Requirements

Vereisten

  • Een bachelor- en masterdiploma in de psychologie, bij voorkeur met een klinische specialisatie.
  • Een afgeronde postmasteropleiding tot GZ-psycholoog.
  • Een geldige BIG-registratie als GZ-psycholoog in Nederland.
  • Ervaring met psychologische begeleiding, psychotherapie of andere vormen van geestelijke gezondheidszorg.
  • Professionele beheersing van het Nederlands.
  • In staat om zelfstandig te werken in een digitale omgeving.
  • Uitstekende schriftelijke en mondelinge communicatieve vaardigheden.
  • Culturele sensitiviteit en ervaring met internationale of multiculturele cliënten zijn een pré.

Gewenste kwalificaties

  • Ervaring met telehealth, online therapie of digitale zorgplatforms.
  • Ervaring met evidence-based behandelmethoden, zoals Cognitieve Gedragstherapie (CGT), systeemtherapie, humanistische therapie of integratieve therapie.
  • Goede beheersing van het Engels en eventuele andere talen is een pré.

Benefits

Wat bieden wij?

  • Modern online therapieplatform: Werk met geavanceerde digitale tools die zijn ontwikkeld om hoogwaardige psychologische zorg te ondersteunen.
  • Eenvoudig cliëntbeheer: Richt je op je cliënten, terwijl wij zorgen voor de instroom van cliënten en administratieve ondersteuning. Je hoeft geen marketingkosten te maken of een eigen website op te zetten.
  • Concurrerende vergoeding: Ontvang een passende vergoeding voor jouw professionele expertise.
  • Doorlopende training en ondersteuning: Profiteer van regelmatige trainingen, klinische begeleiding en mogelijkheden voor verdere professionele ontwikkeling.
  • Internationale community: Word onderdeel van een internationaal netwerk van professionals in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg en werk samen met collega's van over de hele wereld.
  • Betekenisvol werk: Maak een verschil binnen een groeiende en dynamische organisatie die zich inzet om mentale gezondheidszorg toegankelijker te maken.

We stellen je interesse om je bij ifeel aan te sluiten zeer op prijs.

ifeel is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Wij beoordelen alle gekwalificeerde kandidaten ongeacht ras, huidskleur, religie, geslacht, seksuele geaardheid, genderidentiteit, nationaliteit, beperking of enige andere wettelijk beschermde eigenschap.

Vanwege het grote aantal sollicitaties nemen wij alleen contact op met kandidaten die worden geselecteerd voor de volgende fase van de procedure.

Alle informatie die je met ons deelt, wordt vertrouwelijk behandeld en uitsluitend gebruikt voor werving en selectie. Je cv en eventuele aanvullende documenten worden verwerkt in overeenstemming met de toepasselijke privacywetgeving en maximaal twee (2) jaar na afronding van de sollicitatieprocedure bewaard, tenzij anders overeengekomen. Door je sollicitatie in te dienen, stem je in met de verwerking van je persoonsgegevens ten behoeve van deze sollicitatieprocedure.

The Senior Director Service Coordination and Long-Term Services and Supports (LTSS) leads strategy, program design, and implementation for all LTSS/HCBS requirements and functions of the Community HealthChoices agreement. Community HealthChoices (CHC) is Pennsylvania's managed long-term services and supports (MLTSS) program serving older adults and individuals with physical disabilities who are enrolled in Medicare and Medicaid.

Job Duties:


The individual filling this role must live in Pennsylvania.

Frequent travel required to locations across Pennsylvania including attendance at State meetings.


Master's Degree required: Healthcare, Nursing, Social Work, Public Administration, or related field

The successful candidate has an understanding of long-term care services and supports policies, practices, and regulations.


  • Leads strategy and implementation of Geisinger Health Plan’s CHC program, inclusive of Service Coordination and Service Integration.
  • Develops and oversees implementation of strategic partnerships on behalf of GHP with LTSS providers, community organizations, advocacy groups, associations, vendors, and others.
  • Represents GHP as its CHC leader and LTSS subject matter expert in state (DHS/OLTL) forums (e.g., LTSS Subcommittee).

  • Develops policies and procedures to ensure effective and efficient delivery of LTSS programs and services, while ensuring a participant-centered approach.
  • Conducts regular assessments of program effectiveness and participant experience and implements program improvements.
  • Collaborates with the Geisinger Health Plan Leadership team regarding operational issues, staffing, resources, system, and program needs and presents solution action plan for issues.
  • Facilitates and participates in GHP committees, task forces, work groups and multidisciplinary teams as needed to operationalize all aspects of the CHC contract.
  • Ensures compliance with state and federal regulations and all CHC contractual obligations.
  • Develops and manages budgets, in collaboration with other Leadership team members, to ensure that functions and costs unique to CHC are appropriately funded and reflected.
  • Keeps abreast of industry trends and innovations, as well as changes in healthcare laws and regulations, and adjusts programs and services accordingly.

Work is typically performed in an office environment. Accountable for satisfying all job specific obligations and complying with all organization policies and procedures. The specific statements in this profile are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements considered necessary to successfully perform the job.

Position Details:


This position is established specifically to lead and support activities associated to the program award. Employment is contingent upon the award. In the event Geisinger Health Plan is not awarded the Community HealthChoices agreement employment in this position will be discontinued.

Preferred Skills:

  • Familiarity with person-centered philosophies, concepts of independence, and/or self-determination.
  • Experience working with individuals with disabilities and older adults.
  • Track record of building trust-based relationships.
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Effective problem-solving and change management skills.
  • Able to function well independently in a busy environment.
  • Demonstrates excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrate effective critical thinking and decision-making skills.

Education:

Master's Degree-Related Field of Study (Required), Bachelor's Degree-Nursing (Preferred)

Experience:

Minimum of 8 years-Managerial/Supervisory (Required), Minimum of 5 years-Health Insurance/Managed Care (Required)

Certification(s) and License(s):

Skills:

Acts Decisively, Care Management Knowledge, Communication, Health Insurance, Leadership, Organizing

OUR PURPOSE & VALUES: Everything we do is about caring for our patients, our members, our students, our Geisinger family and our communities.

  • KINDNESS: We strive to treat everyone as we would hope to be treated ourselves.
  • EXCELLENCE: We treasure colleagues who humbly strive for excellence.
  • LEARNING: We share our knowledge with the best and brightest to better prepare the caregivers for tomorrow.
  • INNOVATION: We constantly seek new and better ways to care for our patients, our members, our community, and the nation.
  • SAFETY: We provide a safe environment for our patients and members and the Geisinger family.

We offer healthcare benefits for full time and part time positions from day one, including vision, dental and domestic partners. Perhaps just as important, we encourage an atmosphere of collaboration, cooperation and collegiality.

Strategic Association Solutions is an accounting outsourcing firm dedicated to serving membership-based nonprofits, including trade associations and professional societies. We understand the unique challenges these organizations face and provide tailored solutions to streamline their accounting operations. By partnering with SAS, organizations can focus on their mission while we handle the complexities of budgeting, reporting, compliance, and day-to-day accounting tasks. Our goal is to enhance operational efficiency and financial stability, building a foundation for long-term success for our clients.

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Staff Accountant with a focus on Accounts Receivable and Cash Receipts to join our growing accounting team. This role plays a critical part in ensuring the accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of daily transaction processing, reconciliations, and month-end close activities.

The ideal candidate is proactive, responsive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, client-focused environment. This position offers strong exposure to transactional accounting, ERP systems, and cross-functional collaboration with senior accounting leadership.

Essential Functions

Accounts Receivable & Transaction Processing

  • Record daily cash receipts and AR-related journal entries in the accounting system
  • Process client refunds accurately and timely
  • Manage and respond to client inquiries through a ticketing system (e.g., Jira)
  • Maintain and update client-specific tracking tools and supporting schedules
  • Ensure all client deliverables are completed in accordance with service level agreements (SLAs)

Reconciliations & Month-End Close

  • Reconcile online payment batches to credit card and merchant processing systems
  • Match payments within the ERP system and investigate/resolved discrepancies
  • Perform AR-related reconciliations
  • Review month-end cash receipt entries to ensure accuracy and completeness
  • Support overall close process to ensure timely and accurate financial reporting

Reporting & Communication

  • Ensure all trackers and schedules are updated in real time
  • Proactively maintain system access and submit requests as needed

Vendor & Payment Controls

  • Validate vendor banking information prior to payment processing to ensure accuracy and mitigate risk

Ad Hoc Support

  • Assist with troubleshooting merchant processing issues, GL coding questions, and reconciliation discrepancies
  • Support process improvements and other accounting initiatives as assigned

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance (preferred)
  • 1–3 years of accounting experience, with exposure to cash receipts or AR processing
  • Experience with ERP systems (NetSuite preferred)
  • Strong Excel skills and ability to analyze and manipulate data
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines with minimal supervision
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Client-service mindset with the ability to collaborate across teams

This position operates within a fully remote office environment.

  • Fully remote work environment

Rapid Mortgage Company
Position Title: DE/SAR Mortgage Underwriter
Location: Remote

Join a Fast-Paced, High-Performing Team in Mortgage Lending Excellence

Rapid Mortgage Company is a nationally recognized lender known for speed, service, and integrity. We are actively expanding and seeking an experienced and highly motivated DE/SAR Mortgage Underwriter to join our elite operations team. If you’re a critical thinker with a deep understanding of agency guidelines and a passion for precision, we want to hear from you.

Position Overview

As a Mortgage Underwriter, you will be responsible for thoroughly evaluating residential mortgage loan applications to ensure compliance with company, investor, and regulatory standards. This includes assessing creditworthiness, income stability, asset sufficiency, and collateral value. You’ll work closely with processors, and leadership to deliver timely and accurate underwriting decisions across FHA, VA, USDA, and Conventional programs.

This is a vital, deadline-driven role that demands strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and deep underwriting expertise.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze and underwrite loan files including credit, income, assets, appraisals, title, and supporting documentation.
  • Issue clear, concise approval, suspension, or denial decisions within delegated authority.
  • Underwrite loans to current FHA, VA, USDA, and Conventional guidelines.
  • Perform manual underwrites for loans that do not receive AUS Approve/Eligible findings.
  • Interpret and evaluate complex self-employed income documentation (K-1s, Schedule C, 1120s, 1065s).
  • Review large deposits, verify funds for closing, and ensure adequate reserves.
  • Communicate conditions and rationale for decisions to internal stakeholders clearly and professionally.
  • Ensure all underwritten files meet agency, investor, and federal compliance requirements.
  • Stay informed on changes to underwriting policies, loan products, and regulatory updates.
  • Partner with processing and sales teams to promote a collaborative and efficient pipeline.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 3+ years of current mortgage underwriting experience.
  • Active DE (FHA) or SAR (VA) designation- Having both is strongly preferred.
  • Experience underwriting DPA (Down Payment Assistance) programs.
  • Proficiency with Encompass Loan Origination System.
  • Experience analyzing complex borrower profiles, including self-employed borrowers and layered risk.
  • Strong working knowledge of AUS platforms (DU and LP) and ability to assess manual files when necessary.
  • Deep understanding of current investor, agency, and compliance guidelines.
  • Exceptional analytical skills, attention to detail, and time management.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary (please include requirements with your application)
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance available day 1
  • Company-Paid Life and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) + Paid Holidays
  • Career growth opportunities and continuing education support
  • Supportive, collaborative remote team culture

Must-Have Criteria

  • No more than a 16-month gap in mortgage underwriting experience- if gap applies must have stayed up to date on market trends and newest guidelines.
  • Must have current or recent loan-level underwriting authority (not a trainee or shadowing role).
  • Encompass and AUS experience is required.
  • Please include salary expectations with resume or cover letter to be.

Ready to Apply?

If you're a detail-oriented, deadline-driven DE or SAR Underwriter looking to join a dynamic and respected mortgage company—apply now! Submit your resume with salary requirements included.

raw.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

We are seeking a contract writer to develop and write a Christ-centered book focused on navigating social media and digital spaces wisely. We are open to different conceptual directions for this resource, including, but not limited to:

  • A formational, theology-of-technology book that examines how social media affects our attention, desires, and identity, offering a vision for faithful digital discipleship.
  • A highly practical guide or handbook that addresses specific digital struggles, such as navigating digital distraction, setting healthy boundaries/screen time rhythms, dealing with online conflict and outrage, or curating a life-giving, Christ-honoring online presence.
  • A well-researched, data-backed guide book that bridges the intersection of science and biblical truth. This project would examine the verified psychological, neurological, and sociological impacts of digital media consumption and integrate those scientific insights with Scripture to offer an evidence-based, biblically grounded roadmap for holistic digital health.

The ideal project will combine sharp cultural insight with rich biblical truth to offer genuine gospel hope, wisdom, and freedom for the digital age.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co.’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

AI Use:We strongly discourage the use of generative AI in book proposals, and we will not move forward with a book proposal if we detect that generative AI was used to generate or refine sample chapters.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript
Salary: Determined per project

raw.description:
About World Business Lenders

  • At World Business Lenders (WBL), we provide flexible, short-term commercial loans backed by real estate to help small and medium-sized businesses across the United States — particularly those facing difficulties with traditional financing. We're a fast-moving, results-driven organization that takes security seriously as we continue to grow.

Role Overview

  • Provide executive leadership and legal oversight for the Company’s Asset Resolution Department function, directing nationwide default litigation and other legal recovery strategies, overseeing Asset Resolution counsel, managing outside counsel relationships, and supporting portfolio performance and operational execution for non-performing commercial business loans secured by real estate.

Key Responsibilities & Achievements

  • Lead comprehensive legal recovery strategies across foreclosure (judicial and non-judicial), bankruptcy, lawsuits involving breach of note and guaranty, title claims, receivership, loan workouts, deed-in-lieu transactions, judgment enforcement, and collateral liquidation.
  • Provide executive oversight and direction to the Asset Resolution legal team, currently consisting of 10 Asset Resolution counsel and 6 support staff, while maintaining accountability for legal strategy, workload distribution, performance, and consistency of execution.
  • Oversee the legal management of an active portfolio of approximately 342 Asset Resolution cases, with each Asset Resolution counsel managing an average of approximately 35 active matters.
  • Oversee nationwide outside counsel by setting litigation strategy, managing legal spending, monitoring performance, reviewing legal invoices, coordinating payment of law firm invoices, and ensuring alignment with Company objectives and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage relationships with existing outside law firms and identify, evaluate, retain, and oversee new law firms to represent WBL in foreclosure, bankruptcy, litigation, title, and other Asset Resolution matters.
  • Partner with Executive Leadership, Credit, Servicing, Finance, Compliance, and Operations to assess portfolio risk, prioritize recovery strategies, and maximize returns on distressed assets.
  • Provide legal oversight of preservation, insurance compliance, lien protection, title matters, and disposition strategies for commercial real estate securing business loans.
  • Oversee complex enforcement matters involving deficiency judgments, guarantor collections, fraudulent transfers, bankruptcy proceedings, and contested foreclosure actions without directly managing individual cases.
  • Negotiate and oversee settlements, restructurings, loan modifications, discounted payoffs, and other resolution strategies that balance recovery objectives, litigation risk, and cost discipline.
  • Support submissions to the Asset Resolution Committee and Executive Leadership, including settlement proposals and bidding instructions associated with foreclosure sales, in coordination with designated Asset Resolution Committee representatives.
  • Develop executive reporting and portfolio analytics that deliver actionable insight into recovery performance, legal expenditures, asset aging, recoveries, charge-offs, litigation trends, and portfolio performance.
  • Establish policies, procedures, performance metrics, and accountability standards that strengthen operational consistency, reporting accuracy, portfolio visibility, legal risk management, and outside counsel performance.
  • Advance workflow automation, reporting enhancements, and operational standardization to improve efficiency, strengthen legal oversight, and support continued portfolio growth.

Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 10 Asset Resolution counsels and 6 support staff responsible for the nationwide management and legal resolution of approximately 342 active distressed commercial loan matters.
  • Provide strategic direction and oversight rather than direct case management, ensuring Asset Resolution counsel has clear legal strategy, appropriate resources, consistent standards, and effective external legal support.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, strategic problem-solving, and client-focused decision-making while maintaining strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external legal partners.

Requirements

Legal Qualifications

Education:

  • Candidates must hold a Juris Doctor (J.D.) from an accredited U.S. law school and maintain an active license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction in good standing.

Professional Experience

  • Demonstrated experience managing or overseeing a high-volume litigation portfolio, including the ability to establish priorities, allocate resources, identify risk, monitor deadlines, and maintain consistent quality across hundreds of active matters.
  • 10 + years of substantive legal experience with proven experience overseeing multi-state foreclosure and default litigation, with a strong understanding of varying state foreclosure procedures, court requirements, timelines, lien priority, title issues, and applicable creditor/debtor laws.
  • Substantial experience with bankruptcy proceedings, breach of note and guaranty claims, title disputes, deficiency claims, receiverships, judgment enforcement, contested litigation, and other creditor recovery matters.
  • Experience managing, supervising, and developing attorneys and legal support personnel, including establishing performance expectations, reviewing work, allocating caseloads, and providing strategic legal direction.
  • Demonstrated experience selecting, retaining, managing, and evaluating outside counsel, including monitoring litigation strategy and performance, reviewing legal budgets and invoices, and managing legal spend.
  • Experience developing and implementing litigation, settlement, and recovery strategies consistent with business objectives, risk tolerance, and portfolio economics.
  • Demonstrated ability to review and analyze settlement proposals, foreclosure sale strategies, and bidding instructions and communicate recommendations to executive leadership and/or the Asset Resolution Committee.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze large volumes of case and portfolio data and use legal case-management systems, litigation tracking platforms, Microsoft Office/Excel, reporting tools, and legal research platforms.
  • Experience developing legal department metrics, dashboards, reporting, KPIs, budgets, and portfolio analytics is strongly preferred.
  • Strong judgment and demonstrated ability to identify litigation risk, evaluate recovery alternatives, make commercially sound recommendations, and balance legal risk against recovery objectives and cost.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment while maintaining accuracy, responsiveness, confidentiality, and professional judgment.
  • Experience working directly with C-suite executives, senior business leaders, committees, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience leading a national or multi-state foreclosure/default litigation function.
  • Experience overseeing a portfolio of 300+ active litigation or default matters.
  • Experience managing 10+ attorneys and/or a comparable legal organization.
  • Experience managing a significant outside counsel network and legal spend/invoice review.
  • Experience with commercial real estate lending and distressed commercial loan portfolios.
  • Experience with legal operations, workflow automation, litigation management systems, and data-driven legal reporting.
  • Experience presenting litigation, settlement, recovery, and portfolio recommendations to an Asset Resolution Committee, Investment Committee, executive committee, or C-suite leadership.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Compensation includes a base salary of $150,000.
    • Eligibility for incentive compensation (equity and deferred cash bonus) varies by title and level, in accordance with company policy.
  • Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage; 401(k) with company match; paid holidays and paid time off (PTO).
  • Work Environment: Fully remote work environment, with occasional travel as needed for leadership off-sites and corporate events.

🚲Chez Eco-Compteur, nous accompagnons les villes dans leur transition vers le développement des mobilités douces et aidons à la préservation des plus beaux sites naturels du monde !

L’objectif ? Donner aux gestionnaires d’espaces naturels et aux villes des données de fréquentation terrain fiables pour les aider à prendre des décisions objectives : « Faut-il pérenniser cette piste cyclable temporaire ? Faut-il moduler le nombre de visiteurs pour préserver ce site naturel protégé ? »

Depuis 20 ans, nous proposons des solutions connectées pour le comptage de piétons et cyclistes en environnement urbain et naturel. Solutions qui vont des capteurs installés sur les pistes cyclables et les sentiers de randonnées aux logiciels d’interprétation des données. Parce que compter c’est bien mais donner du sens aux chiffres c’est encore mieux !

Focalisés sur l’innovation et l’international, nous sommes leader mondial d’un métier que nous avons créé ! 💪

Implanté en Bretagne avec des filiales au Canada, en Allemagne et à Shanghai, Eco-Compteur est aussi présent dans plus de 56 pays. C’est aussi et surtout une entreprise de taille humaine où chacun partage une vision et des valeurs : autonomie, confiance & transparence avec beaucoup de passion et de plaisir !

Requirements

Vous aussi vous voulez avoir un impact dans la transformation des villes de demain et participer au développement du tourisme durable ? Rejoignez-nous et devenez acteur dans le développement des villes intelligentes et la préservation des espaces naturels. Nous sommes en recherche perpétuelle de nouveaux talents prêts à relever les défis de demain (Lannion, Rennes, Montreal, Düsseldorf ..) !

Vous êtes passionné.e par la randonnée, le vélo (d’ailleurs vous ne comptez même plus les kilomètres !) et les sports de pleine nature de manière générale, nos valeurs - autonomie, confiance & transparence - vous font écho, alors nous avons plus que hâte d'échanger avec vous ! 🚲

Rejoindre Eco-Compteur c'est :

📈Des marchés en forte croissance, un contexte international, de nouveaux enjeux et défis à relever ensemble chaque jour

🚲Une équipe passionnée et à taille humaine, sur un site regroupant tous les métiers (conception, développement, fabrication, support…) tout est 100% made in France

💪🏻 Autonomie & Responsabilisation : ici vous pourrez tester, rater, réessayer, réaliser

🌊 Des bureaux à 10 minutes de la Côte de Granit Rose : Une baignade entre 12h et 14h, une session paddle ou juste détente sur le sable !

🎉Une entreprise classée Great Place to Work 2022 (12ème au classement!) 2019 et 2017

👏La fierté de reconnaitre nos produits en vacances, sur chaque sentier de randonnée, ou dans les rues des plus belles villes du monde

Highlights

Rejoignez nous pour avoir de l’impact sur le développement des mobilités durables et la protection des espaces naturels !

raw.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Foundry Integration Engineer to lead the development and maturation of our silicon photonic fabrication processes through close partnership with external commercial foundries. In this highly cross‑functional role, you will own integration strategy, accelerate learning through structured experimentation, and help drive our technologies from development into stable, ramped production.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of device physics, materials, and manufacturing—coordinating across internal design, modeling, and systems teams while serving as a key technical interface to our external foundry partners.
As a Senior Foundry Integration Engineer at Photonic you'll directly shape how quickly and reliably we learn, scale, and deliver. You will help establish development priorities, improve reproducibility, and enable scaling of Photonic’s quantum compute systems.
Please include a cover letter with your resume (in one file) describing how you would be a great fit at Photonic and what attributes you could bring to our growing team.

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO DO

  • Own and execute process integration plans across external commercial foundries to mature and stabilize fabrication flows.
  • Define, organize, and drive experiments to accelerate learning and drive product performance.
  • Design experiments, analyze fabrication and measurement results, and synthesize data into clear technical conclusions.
  • Define next step process improvements and development priorities based on experimental outcomes.
  • Lead technical engagement with foundries, including aligning on integration intent, process assumptions, and learning objectives.
  • Translate system level and device level requirements into actionable fabrication strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams across nanofabrication, design, modeling, yield, and systems to produce chips supporting our core technology.
  • Ultimately drive successful production ramp of chips through improved yield, reproducibility, and process robustness.

WHAT YOU BRING TO OUR TEAM

  • Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a closely related field.
  • 3+ years of industry experience in process integration, semiconductor fabrication, or related roles.
  • Hands‑on experience working in or with a commercial semiconductor foundry.
  • Strong understanding of semiconductor process integration, unit processes, and cross‑module interactions in both foundry and university cleanrooms.
  • Experience and intuition in silicon photonics fabrication and design.
  • Demonstrated ability to design experiments, analyze data, and drive data‑informed technical decisions.
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort working across organizational and company boundaries.
An exceptional candidate will bring:
  • Experience supporting semiconductor technologies through development into production ramp.
  • Familiarity with advanced photonic, electronic, or heterogeneous integration platforms.
  • Prior experience serving as a technical interface between internal R&D teams and external manufacturing partners.
  • Track record of accelerating learning cycles in complex fabrication environments.

WHY YOU SHOULD WORK WITH US

  • Work closely with some of the brightest innovators in quantum technologies to drive breakthroughs that redefine computing
  • Enjoy a fast-paced and fun environment where you can try new things while solving innovative challenges every day
  • Inclusive company culture that values collaboration
  • Regular social events and fun activities keep our global team connected
  • Competitive compensation package including base salary, stock options, and relocation assistance for global talent
  • Comprehensive benefits including extended health, dental, life, long term disability, an employee assistance program, parental leave top-ups, and a flexible spending account
The description above is what we think an ideal candidate would look like for this role. At Photonic, we understand that everyone has a different work and life journey. If you feel your experience is close to what we've described, but you might not meet all the requirements, please still apply! All roles listed are for current vacancies. While artificial intelligence (AI) tools may be used to assist in reviewing applicant profiles, they do not determine candidate outcomes. Our hiring decisions are made by people, not algorithms. We are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of equity, diversity, and inclusion. We embrace and encourage our employees’ differences, knowing that these very differences inspire innovation and build better teams. If there are any accommodations our team can make throughout our hiring process, please let us know.

raw.description:
Description

Sentra is the AI Data Readiness platform for enterprises deploying AI at scale. Sentra continuously discovers, classifies, and governs sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, data warehouses, and AI environments - giving security teams complete visibility into what AI systems can access, what they can expose, and where compliance violations exist. Unlike alternatives that copy data to vendor clouds or require customer-managed outpost infrastructure, Sentra provisions ephemeral scanners directly inside the customer's environment, delivering petabyte-scale classification at a fraction of the cost. Trusted by Lyft, SoFi, Munich RE, PennyMac, Glovo, and others.

We’re hiring a Product Marketing Manager who can turn complex technology into clear, differentiated stories that resonate with customers and help our field teams win.

﻿About The Role

We’re hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager who can turn complex technology into clear, differentiated stories that resonate with customers and help our field teams win.

This is a highly visible, hands-on individual contributor role with significant ownership across positioning and messaging, competitive intelligence, product launches, and sales enablement. You’ll work closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and the broader Marketing team to shape how we bring our platform and capabilities to market and how we communicate Sentra’s value throughout the buyer journey.

You’ll be comfortable going deep with technical teams, engaging directly with customers and sellers, and turning what you learn into simple, compelling messaging that differentiates Sentra in the market.

Responsibilities

Positioning & Messaging

Help lead and evolve positioning and messaging across Sentra’s platform, products, and key use cases. Translate complex technical capabilities into clear, differentiated customer value and ensure our messaging resonates with both technical and business audiences.

﻿Competitive Intelligence

Scale our competitive intelligence program, including competitive positioning, battlecards, objection handling, and field guidance. Stay close to the market and our sales organization to understand how competitors are positioning, where we win and lose, and what our field teams need to navigate competitive opportunities.

﻿Product Launches & GTM

Lead product launches and key GTM initiatives, partnering cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to develop messaging, enablement, launch plans, and execution. Ensure teams understand not only what we’re launching, but why it matters to customers and how to take it to market.

﻿Sales Enablement

Create the messaging, tools, and training our field teams need to sell effectively. Partner closely with Sales to understand what resonates with buyers, where deals get stuck, and where additional messaging, competitive intelligence, or enablement can improve execution.

Customer & Market Insights

Stay close to customers, prospects, sellers, and the broader market to understand evolving needs, buying drivers, objections, and trends. Bring those insights back into Product, Marketing, and GTM decisions and help ensure the voice of the customer is reflected in our strategy and messaging.

﻿Content & Thought Leadership

Partner with the broader Marketing team and executives to translate Sentra’s point of view into compelling content, campaigns, customer stories, and thought leadership. Help make complex data security and AI challenges understandable and relevant to our target audiences.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of B2B cybersecurity product marketing experience in data, cloud, or enterprise software
  • Demonstrated ownership of positioning and messaging for complex technical products
  • Strong experience in competitive intelligence, sales enablement, and translating market insights into actionable field guidance
  • Proven experience leading product launches and cross-functional GTM programs
  • Ability to understand complex technology and translate it into simple, compelling customer value
  • Strong customer and market orientation, with experience engaging directly with customers, prospects, and sales teams
  • Excellent writing, storytelling, presentation, and communication skills
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across Product, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and executive stakeholders
  • Comfortable operating independently and taking ownership while collaborating closely across teams
  • Able to think strategically while remaining highly hands-on in a fast-moving startup environment
