This is hands-on engineering position requiring the ability evaluate execution layer code.

Data Engineer IV

Position Summary

The Principal Data Engineer / Architect (Data Engineer IV) is a senior technical leader responsible for defining the enterprise-wide data architecture, platform strategy, and governance standards. This role shapes how data is collected, modeled, processed, secured, and consumed across all applications and business domains, ensuring the long-term scalability, reliability, and performance of the organization’s data ecosystem.

Principal Data Engineers drive large-scale modernization, lakehouse and warehouse architecture, MDM adoption, metadata automation, Delta Lake strategy, multi-cloud integrations, and end-to-end data platform evolution. Operating with full autonomy, this role engages with Directors, senior architects, and cross-functional leaders to guide decisions that impact enterprise systems, analytics, compliance, and technology investments.

This position is both strategic and hands-on when needed—solving the hardest technical problems, creating reusable frameworks, and mentoring senior engineers to elevate overall data engineering maturity across the enterprise.

Essential Functions:

  • Own the long-term design and architecture of the enterprise data ecosystem, including ingestion, storage, modeling, lineage, governance, and analytics layers.
  • Design scalable lakehouse, Delta Lake, and distributed data architectures supporting advanced analytics, operational workflows, and integration across business domains.
  • Lead enterprise-wide modernization projects: warehouse migrations, domain modeling redesigns, governance uplift, streaming adoption, or cross-cloud data integrations.
  • Define and enforce standards for data modeling, lineage, metadata, MDM, quality, security, and compliance across all data teams.
  • Create reusable architectural patterns, frameworks, orchestrations, and platform components adopted across engineering groups.
  • Solve the most complex technical problems, including distributed system bottlenecks, data quality crises, lineage gaps, and multi-domain data reconciliation issues.
  • Guide cost optimization strategy for compute, storage, and orchestration workloads across the data platform.
  • Partner with enterprise architecture, analytics, InfoSec, product, and application engineering to ensure alignment with organizational strategy.·
  • Influence leadership decisions regarding data strategy, platform investments, tooling, and sprint/roadmap priorities.
  • Mentor senior engineers, conduct design reviews, and provide technical leadership across teams to raise the overall engineering bar.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in CS/IT/Data Science or equivalent experience (Master’s preferred).
  • 10+ years experience in data engineering, data architecture, or distributed systems engineering.
  • Proven track record designing and implementing enterprise-scale data platforms with Lakehouse/Delta architectures.
  • Expert-level proficiency with SQL, Spark, Python, Databricks, Delta Lake, Azure Data Factory, and distributed processing.
  • Deep understanding of data modeling (conceptual, logical, physical), governance frameworks, MDM, metadata catalogs, and lineage systems.
  • Experience leading multi-team engineering initiatives and influencing architectural decisions at the leadership level.
  • Strong grounding in security, compliance, data privacy, and regulatory data handling.

About the Company

At BenefitHub, our commitment is to offer employee perks and voluntary benefits that give real value to employees, focusing on enhancing the quality of their daily lives. We continuously strive to add unique and exciting values to the offers available to our members, partnering with a diverse range of global brands to achieve this.

This role provides a unique opportunity to become part of one of the fastest-growing benefits technology companies in the US, with expanding influence globally. Join our mission to improve the daily life of millions by providing access to the world’s largest selection of personally relevant benefits. By contributing to our goal of becoming the most widely used benefits platform, you will be enhancing the lives of millions of people around the globe.

BenefitHub does not currently offer H-1B Sponsorship

Why This Role

BenefitHub is a fast-growing, PE-backed employee benefits and discount marketplace platform trusted by employers and brokers nationwide. We're looking for a Channel Business Development Executive to own and grow relationships with a book of insurance brokers and benefits consultants — turning warm broker relationships into new employer clients and expanding revenue across an existing account portfolio.

This is a high-autonomy, individual-contributor role for someone who thrives on relationship-driven selling. You'll work directly with broker producers to identify and close employer opportunities, and you'll partner closely with Customer Success and Account Management to grow the accounts you help bring in. If you like owning your own pipeline, building trust with brokers over time, and being measured on real revenue outcomes, this role is built for you.

What You'll Do

Grow the Broker Channel

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with assigned national and regional broker firms and individual producers.
  • Educate brokers on BenefitHub's employee engagement, perks, voluntary benefits, and purchasing platform capabilities.
  • Run broker presentations, training sessions, pipeline reviews, and joint account-planning meetings.
  • Represent BenefitHub at broker meetings, industry events, conferences, and client presentations.

Win New Business

  • Own your targets for new client wins, eligible employees added, pipeline creation, and broker-channel revenue.
  • Lead broker-sourced opportunities from qualification through proposal, negotiation, and signed contract.
  • Coordinate demos, pricing discussions, and RFI/RFP responses, partnering with internal subject-matter experts as needed.
  • Keep your pipeline, forecasts, and close plans current and accurate in the CRM.

Grow Existing Accounts

  • Deliver at least 15% year-over-year revenue growth across your assigned book of existing broker-sourced clients.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Account Management to identify cross-sell, upsell, and platform-expansion opportunities.
  • Build relationships with both broker and employer stakeholders on your accounts, and join Executive Business Reviews when growth opportunities arise.

How Success Is Measured

You'll know you're winning in this role when you're consistently hitting:

  • New client wins and eligible-employee growth through broker-sourced opportunities
  • 15%+ year-over-year revenue growth across your existing-account portfolio
  • Healthy, accurately forecasted pipeline coverage against your targets
  • Strong broker producer engagement and opportunity generation
  • Disciplined CRM hygiene and sales-process follow-through

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years in business development, channel sales, broker sales, enterprise sales, or strategic account growth.
  • A track record of generating business through insurance brokers, benefits consultants, channel partners, or similar referral relationships.
  • Experience managing a full sales pipeline and consistently hitting new-business and growth targets.
  • Background selling employee benefits, HR technology, SaaS, employee engagement, voluntary benefits, or related B2B solutions.
  • Strong relationship-building, presentation, negotiation, and consultative-selling skills.
  • Comfort working across broker producers, employer decision-makers, and senior internal stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Ability to travel as required for the role.

Nice to Have

  • Existing relationships within national, regional employee benefits brokerage firms.
  • Experience selling to HR, Benefits, Total Rewards, or Procurement leaders.
  • A history of driving both new-logo acquisition and expansion growth in the same book of business.
  • Familiarity with employee perks, voluntary benefits, loyalty, or workplace engagement platforms.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $120,000–$140,000, plus $30,000–$40,000 in variable compensation, with uncapped upside on new business generated.

BenefitHub is proud to offer highly competitive salaries along with a very generous perks & benefits package for full-time Team Members:

About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LPC, LMFT, LCSW) in Colorado to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week
    • Attend a world-class training program developed by industry leaders.
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Have 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time for Member Sessions
    • Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding
    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • Colorado: Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Professional Counselor, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Clinical Social Worker
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A commitment to clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and proven & visible clinical outcomes.
  • Gain world-class training from experienced OCD providers to become a specialized Therapist in treating OCD and related disorders through evidence-based care.
  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback
  • Investment in new technology built to improve the NOCD Therapist experience and allow our Therapists to continue to focus on Member care.
  • Centralized scheduling
  • An investment in your personal growth through a clear career path
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members
  • One-on-one mentorship to discuss complex cases
  • Ability to work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
    • Base Salary Comp Range in Colorado = $62,000 - $92,500
    • Bonus Program = $12,400 per year earned on average by those eligible
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, and 401(k) match for qualifying employees
  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere
  • Generous PTO
  • NOCD provides 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for the primary caregiver, and 6 weeks of fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver, for qualifying full-time employees.

About us

At SPD Technology, we bring together a team of like-minded people who are driven by the desire to bring value through their work, united in their commitment to high performance and delivering custom, cutting-edge tech solutions that drive clients' growth. We empower our people with a culture of excellence, and enable them with the opportunity to uphold their accountability to contribute on each level. We value humanity and collaboration, encourage professional and personal growth, and foster a supportive and flexible work environment where everyone's contribution is welcomed.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Business Operations & Client Success to join us as part of our team.

About the role

As a Senior Manager, Business Operations & Client Success, you will maintain an integrated view of Business Unit (BU) health and ensure operational, client, people, financial, and delivery signals are translated into clear priorities and actionable plans. Acting as the coordination and insight layer across the Business Unit, you will connect Delivery and Engineering leadership, Client stakeholders, HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and People Operations. This role reports directly to the Business Unit Managing Director / VP Delivery and focuses on high-value business insight, independent client sensing, and cross-functional execution.

As a qualified expert You will

  • Own and continuously develop the Business Unit performance management framework, consolidating financial, delivery, people, hiring, quality, client, and operational indicators into an integrated view of BU health.
  • Investigate underlying causes, trends, and business implications beyond reporting metrics, translating observations into recommendations, corrective actions, and tracked resolutions.
  • Own the BU-level Client Success and client health framework, developing mechanisms to measure sentiment (including NPS and qualitative/quantitative signals) through direct stakeholder conversations and interviews.

raw.excerpt: As Director of Product, your mission is to build the premier product organization in supply chain: disciplined about what you build, iterative in how you build it, obsessed with the customer, and driven by data at every decision.
raw.description:
As Director of Product, your mission is to build the premier product organization in supply chain: disciplined about what you build, iterative in how you build it, obsessed with the customer, and driven by data at every decision.

About Bobtail

Bobtail is dedicated to increasing happiness by eliminating inefficiencies in the supply chain. We envision a supply chain without friction, fraud, waste, and abuse where companies succeed based on the value they create.

We work in a unique way at Bobtail, where we value teams over individuals and encourage experimentation and iteration to constantly improve. Teams are given flexibility in working towards a shared purpose and given the freedom to decide how they will accomplish their goals.

If you are an out of the box thinker that takes a proactive approach in collaborating with others to solve problems and achieve your goals - we would love to talk to you.

The things we value:

  1. Mission
  2. Teams over individuals
  3. Collaboration
  4. Communication
  5. Iteration
  6. Experimentation and failing fast
  7. Initiative and solutions oriented approach
  8. Documentation
  9. Data
  10. Mental health and work life balance
  11. Diversity
  12. Transparency

We're hiring a Director of Product to lead product strategy, development, and innovation at Bobtail. This is a first-of-its-kind seat built around three priorities: deciding what Bobtail builds, deciding what it deliberately does not build, and executing at a high level in lockstep with engineering and the rest of the senior management team to ship it. You'll work directly with the CEO to turn a wide set of strategic options, into a sequenced, evidence-backed roadmap.

The ideal candidate has led product at a company of comparable size and complexity, with a track record of setting strategy from ambiguity rather than just running an existing roadmap, and the discipline to say no as often as yes. This individual will be highly data-driven and analytical, with the judgment to move on conviction when the data is inherently thin. We are looking for a strong product leader who can build the product management function at Bobtail from the ground up, hire and develop a team, and partner closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market leadership to turn decisions into shipped product. This includes identifying new products, services, platform capabilities, and revenue opportunities that solve meaningful problems for our customers and strengthen our competitive position. The right person will not wait for someone to hand them a list of features to build. They will spend time understanding how our customers operate, where they struggle, what they currently pay others to do, and what problems remain unsolved.

You should apply if you have:

  • 8+ years of experience in product management and strategy, including experience leading product at a company of comparable size and complexity.
  • A track record of setting product strategy from ambiguity and defending sequencing decisions with both data and judgment.
  • Experience in fintech, financial services, payments, lending, factoring, transportation technology, or another transaction-heavy financial environment strongly preferred.
  • Experience conducting product discovery, customer research, and market analysis. Strong commercial instincts and the ability to evaluate product opportunities based on customer value and business economics.
  • Comfort with compliance and risk constraints (KYC/KYB, lending, payments) is a plus.
  • Experience building and leading a product team, including hiring the first few members of a function.
  • Strong technical fluency - you don't need to write code, but you should be able to work closely with engineering on architecture trade-offs and technical feasibility.
  • Highly analytical and data-driven, with strong pattern-recognition and problem-solving skills.
  • A bias toward shipping and iterating over long planning cycles.
  • Comfort operating at a founder-led, profitable company rather than a venture-subsidized one.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional leadership skills, including the ability to clearly communicate product strategy and trade-offs to senior leadership. The discipline to say no - comfortable deferring or killing ideas that don't earn their place on the roadmap, even when they're compelling in isolation or popular internally. Demonstrated ability to influence across functions and challenge senior stakeholders constructively.
  • Financial fluency - comfortable modeling and defending the revenue potential, development cost, and opportunity cost of a roadmap bet directly to the CFO and other finance stakeholders. A track record of measuring product success based on customer and business outcomes.
  • An obsession with the customer and the product - you can't walk past something broken without wanting to fix it, and you know the product as well as the people using it, not just the roadmap slide.

You will be responsible for:

  • Decide What to Build: Develop and maintain a product strategy that clearly connects product investment to the company's broader strategic and financial objectives. Look beyond incremental feature improvements to identify opportunities for meaningful product innovation.
  • Process around decision making: Create a disciplined process for gathering and evaluating ideas without allowing the product roadmap to become a collection of stakeholder requests. Ensure completed functionality solves the underlying customer or business problem rather than simply meeting documented requirements.
  • Decide What Not to Build: Exercise real judgment about scope. Establish clear criteria for when to build, continue investing in a new product, change direction, or discontinue an initiative.
  • Execute at a High Level: Partner closely with engineering - and with design, go-to-market, and senior leadership - to turn the roadmap into shipped product on a predictable cadence, not just a plan.
  • Defend the Business Case: Build and defend the revenue potential, development cost, and opportunity cost of each major roadmap bet to the CFO, so product decisions hold up under financial scrutiny, not just strategic conviction.
  • Own the outcome: Ensure new products have clearly understood operational, financial, regulatory, and risk requirements before launch. Measure product success based on business outcomes - not simply whether features were delivered.
  • Own the Product: Take full, unbounded ownership of Bobtail's product. There are no lanes here; if it touches the customer or the platform, it's yours to shape.
  • Obsess Over the Customer and the Product: Establish a disciplined process for identifying and evaluating new product opportunities. Spend meaningful time talking directly with customers rather than relying exclusively on feedback filtered through Sales or Operations. Develop a strong understanding of competitors and adjacent providers within transportation finance and fintech. Live inside the carrier's day-to-day and inside the product itself. We want someone who can't walk past something broken without wanting to fix it, and who knows the product as well as the people using it.
  • Evidence-Driven Decision Making: Build the muscle - data, customer research, experimentation - to validate bets before committing engineering resources, while being willing to move on conviction when the data is inherently thin.
  • Team Building: Hire and develop the product management function at Bobtail, defining process and hiring bar as the first dedicated product leader.
  • Market & Competitive Judgment: Track how freight-tech and fintech infrastructure are evolving, including AI-driven disruption and industry consolidation, and stress-test Bobtail's roadmap against it.

Benefits

  • Generous PTO
  • Monthly Mental Break Day
  • Parental leave
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage
  • Life insurance
  • 401k with company match
  • Work from home (or wherever)

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is Bobtail’s nucleus. We are an equal opportunity employer and embrace people of different backgrounds, cultures, religions, national origins, races, colors, genders, gender expressions, sexual orientations, ages, marital status, veteran status, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences — and we're happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process if you need them. raw.excerpt: Location: RemotePosition OverviewWe are seeking a contract writer to develop and write a Christ-centered parenting book designed to encourage and equip parents to faithfully point their children to Jesus.
raw.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

We are seeking a contract writer to develop and write a Christ-centered parenting book designed to encourage and equip parents to faithfully point their children to Jesus. We are open to different conceptual directions for this resource, including, but not limited to:

  • A foundational book exploring the basic principles of gospel-centered parenting, focusing on the theological infrastructure of the home, shifting the paradigm from mere behavior modification to heart transformation, and grounding parental identity securely in Christ.
  • An book specific to discipling kids of a certain age that tackles how to introduce biblical truths and adapt family discipleship in a particular stage—from building simple foundations with toddlers to navigating complex faith questions with preteens and teenagers.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co.’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

AI Use:We strongly discourage the use of generative AI in book proposals, and we will not move forward with a book proposal if we detect that generative AI was used to generate or refine sample chapters.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript
Salary: Determined per project

raw.excerpt: We're looking for a Senior Technical Support Engineer to become a technical extension of our Engineering team.
raw.description:
We're looking for a Senior Technical Support Engineer to become a technical extension of our Engineering team.

This is not a traditional customer support role.

You'll investigate complex API and infrastructure issues, help engineers reproduce difficult bugs, improve developer experience, build automation, and continuously raise the quality and efficiency of our technical support function.

We have a strong preference for engineers who naturally integrate AI into their daily workflow—not simply as a writing assistant, but as a practical engineering tool for investigation, automation, documentation, analysis, and operational improvement.

Beyond solving customer issues, you'll help build a modern, AI-native support function that scales alongside the company.


What this person will do

Deep technical investigation

  • Investigate complex platform, infrastructure, and API issues using logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and debugging tools.
  • Troubleshoot REST APIs, HTTP requests, authentication, JSON payloads, SDKs, webhooks, and distributed systems.
  • Reproduce difficult production issues and work closely with Engineering to identify root causes and validate fixes.
  • Support customers during complex technical investigations, escalations, and production incidents.

Improve developer experience

  • Identify recurring issues and proactively improve tooling, monitoring, documentation, and customer self-service.
  • Create and continuously improve troubleshooting guides, internal playbooks, developer documentation, and knowledge base content.
  • Help identify opportunities to simplify developer workflows and reduce customer friction.

Build scalable support operations

  • Design and improve internal tooling, automations, and operational workflows.
  • Drive adoption of AI-assisted workflows that improve investigation speed, documentation quality, operational efficiency, and overall developer support.
  • Continuously improve support processes in close partnership with Engineering as the company scales.

Requirements

Technical expertise

  • 5+ years of experience in Technical Support Engineering, Developer Support, Solutions Engineering, SRE, or another highly technical customer-facing engineering role.
  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills across REST APIs, HTTP, authentication, JSON, SDKs, webhooks, and distributed systems.
  • Experience investigating production issues using logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and modern observability platforms.
  • Comfortable reading application code and understanding backend systems (Python, Go, Node.js, Java, PHP, or similar).
  • Strong analytical thinking and a structured engineering approach to debugging complex systems.

AI-native working style

  • Active, practical use of AI-assisted tools to improve troubleshooting, documentation, analysis, investigation, and day-to-day engineering productivity.
  • Experience building automations, scripts, integrations, or AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.
  • Demonstrated habit of continuously improving personal and team productivity through automation, AI, and process optimisation.
  • Curiosity to evaluate emerging AI tools and incorporate those that create measurable value.

Collaboration & ownership

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with developers and technical stakeholders.
  • High level of ownership with a track record of improving technical processes rather than simply executing existing ones.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where processes are continuously evolving.

Strong differentiators

Domain expertise

  • Experience supporting AI/ML platforms, developer tools, APIs, cloud infrastructure, or technically complex B2B SaaS products.
  • Experience supporting infrastructure products where customers are software engineers rather than end users.

Building & scaling

  • Experience building or scaling technical support functions, operational processes, or internal tooling.
  • Experience working closely with Platform, Infrastructure, or Product Engineering teams.
  • Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar.
  • Comfortable discussing technical trade-offs around performance, reliability, scalability, and developer experience.

AI & automation

  • Experience designing or implementing AI agents, LLM-powered workflows, internal AI tools, or support automations.
  • Experience integrating AI into operational workflows, documentation systems, developer tooling, or customer support platforms.

Tools & systems exposure:

  • Support platforms: Zendesk, Intercom, Jira, Linear, GitHub Issues, or similar
  • Monitoring & debugging: Datadog, Grafana, Logs, Metrics, Traces, Dashboards
  • Documentation: Notion, Confluence, GitHub Docs
  • Developer tools: Postman, REST APIs, HTTP debugging, JSON, Webhooks, SDK troubleshooting

Benefits

We’re a remote-first collective, meeting in person twice a year to plan, brainstorm, celebrate wins, and enjoy some face-to-face time. We have core hours for cooperative working and calls, but outside of that your calendar is yours. Work the hours that let you perform at your peak while also building a healthy life.

Our release cycles are fast and intense, but they’re followed by real downtime. After big pushes we expect the team to unplug, recharge, and come back ready & stronger than ever for the next leap.

  • Generous paid time off – vacation, sick days, public holidays
  • Meaningful stock options – share in the upside you create
  • Flexible hours – own your schedule outside core collaboration blocks
  • Family leave – paid maternity, paternity, and caregiver time
  • Company retreats – twice-yearly gatherings in inspiring locations

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Cloud Solutions Architect to design and govern cloud-native solutions across compute, networking, data, identity, and security domains on a major cloud platform. The role partners closely with business stakeholders, security architects, and engineering teams to translate strategic objectives into pragmatic, scalable, and cost-effective cloud architectures aligned with enterprise standards. The ideal candidate brings strong breadth across modern cloud capabilities, depth in at least one major provider, and the architectural judgment to balance time-to-market, cost, security, and long-term maintainability.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design end-to-end cloud solutions covering compute, networking, storage, identity, data, and observability layers.
  • Lead solution architecture reviews and approval processes for major cloud initiatives.
  • Define cloud landing zone, account structure, and tagging strategies for new and existing workloads.
  • Establish reference architectures, blueprints, and reusable patterns adopted across engineering teams.
  • Architect security, identity, and compliance controls embedded into the cloud foundation.
  • Design networking topologies including VPC/VNet design, transit hubs, hybrid connectivity, and private endpoints.
  • Lead cloud migration, modernization, and re-platforming initiatives across application portfolios.
  • Drive cost optimization, capacity planning, and FinOps practices across the cloud estate, partnering with finance and engineering teams to make cloud spend transparent, predictable, and tied to delivered business value.
  • Partner with security architects to embed identity, data protection, and compliance controls from the outset.
  • Produce architecture artifacts including context diagrams, sequence diagrams, and decision records.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams during solution delivery.
  • Engage with cloud providers and platform partners to evaluate roadmap fit.
  • Track emerging cloud capabilities and ecosystem developments, assessing relevance to current and planned workloads, and recommend strategic adoption based on demonstrated value and operational maturity.
  • Maintain alignment with enterprise architecture standards, security policies, and regulatory obligations, ensuring that cloud designs satisfy both engineering goals and the broader compliance posture of the organization.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in software engineering or solution architecture roles.
  • Deep expertise designing cloud-native solutions on at least one major cloud platform.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security primitives.
  • Experience with cloud migration, modernization, and platform consolidation programs.
  • Strong understanding of containerization, serverless, and managed data services.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience producing formal architecture artifacts and presenting them to senior leadership.
  • Track record of leading architecture reviews and influencing engineering direction.
  • Cloud architecture certification (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Preferred Qualifications
  • Multiple cloud architecture certifications.
  • Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid cloud architectures.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF.
  • Exposure to regulated industries with strict cloud compliance requirements.
  • Experience driving FinOps and cost transparency initiatives

Company Background:Solon Capital Partners (“Solon”) creates, partners and invests to deliver financial returns and transformative impact. Building on a 14-year track record, Solon employs a differentiated model based on business creation, partnership and patience to maximize impact scale and financial returns while mitigating risk. Solon has a portfolio of innovative businesses now operating across three impact verticals and nine countries in Africa and beyond.

Terra Nova Solutions ("TNS") is a Solon portfolio company that acts as the shared services provider for Solon. TNS is a professional services firm empowering clients in Africa’s frontier and challenging markets. TNS provides a range of finance, compliance, consulting, and advisory services across multiple sectors and geographies in Sub-Saharan Africa.

The Opportunity: Solon is seeking to build a football player development and marketing system across West Africa – breaking down the structural barriers to empower the continent’s ascendant talent. Launched in Ghana in April 2024, we are implementing the first phase of this project: a free grassroots training program for boys and girls from the age of 6, layered across primary schools in each target market in West Africa. Liberia is our next target market.

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Program Manager to support Solon's intention to implement this initial phase of our player development program in Liberia. The role will involve working with a close-knit team to evaluate and develop opportunities for implementing the program. You will be joining a team that is collegial, collaborative, and curious.

Responsibilities:

The ideal candidate will take a hands-on approach to successfully manage various workstreams to assess Liberia as a new market for establishing a football player development program. It will mean working closely with communities, government, and other partners to solve problems and advance the project initiatives. It will also mean being ready to respond with enthusiasm to a fast-paced and wide-ranging set of requests and challenges.

Examples of responsibilities include:

  • Opportunity Assessment. Identify and evaluate potential partnership opportunities with school providers in Liberia in order to establish the first phase of our football player development program – a grassroots training program for boys and girls from age 6, layered across existing primary schools.
  • Program Implementation: in coordination with Solon team, implement and grow grassroots training program with identified school providers in Liberia; providing effective oversight to ensure program meets Solon standards and objectives.
  • Stakeholder Engagement. Building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders, including service providers, government officials, donor partners, consultants, and community members. Engage with potential local partners, industry experts, and other stakeholders to gather insights and promote Solon's business interests.
  • Reporting and Assessment. Prepare detailed reports and presentations for senior management to aid in decision-making processes.
  • Project Management. Manage timelines, resources, and deliverables for designated project. Ensure all project activities adhere to Solon standards and objectives, delivering results within established timelines and budgets.

Qualifications: Basic qualifications for the engagement include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, International Relations, or related field.
  • Proven experience in business development, or a similar role, preferably within Liberia or similar markets.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including preparing detailed project reports and presenting to diverse audiences.
  • Superb attention to detail and diligence.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, multicultural team environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and problem-solving abilities.
  • In-depth knowledge of Liberia's culture, customs, and business practices.
  • Fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Integrity, sound judgement, and business acumen.
  • Professional presence and demeanour.
  • Ability to legally reside and work in Liberia.
  • Passion for or interest in football

Experience and knowledge in any of the football, education, or carbon markets/project development initiatives is desirable.

Nature of Engagement: An initial 6-month contract engagement with the potential to extend the term or transition to a full-time role with the company.

Work Hours: Meetings and deadlines based on standard business hours in the GMT time zone will need to be accommodated.

Location: The engagement requires the candidate to reside in West Africa, preferably in Liberia. The engagement will be remote in nature. Travel throughout West Africa may be required, along with occasional global travel.

Salary: Solon strives to be an organization of choice and offers competitive compensation packages, including performance-based incentives.

raw.description:
Customer Success Manager DACH (m/w/d) – Teilzeit / Contractor

Wir suchen eine strukturierte und serviceorientierte Persönlichkeit, die unsere Kunden in der DACH-Region unterstützt und ihnen hilft, das volle Potenzial von Abler zu nutzen.

Die Rolle startet in Teilzeit (ca. 10–20 Stunden pro Woche) und bietet die Möglichkeit, mit unserem Wachstum in der Region weiter zu wachsen.

Abler wird bereits von Organisationen im Umfeld von Clubs wie Chelsea F.C., Newcastle United oder Barcelona genutzt. In England arbeiten wir mit rund 40% der Clubs aus den Top 4 Ligen zusammen. Auch in Deutschland haben wir bereits erste Kunden und bauen unsere Präsenz weiter aus.

Wir sind überzeugt, dass wir eine sehr starke Value Proposition haben und echten Mehrwert für Sportorganisationen schaffen. Unser Ziel ist es, diese Qualität und Struktur auch im Breitensport verfügbar zu machen.

Wenn du die richtige Einstellung und Motivation mitbringst, unterstützen wir dich mit allem, was du brauchst, um in der Rolle erfolgreich zu sein.

Die Rolle

  • Du arbeitest eng mit neuen und bestehenden Kunden zusammen und stellst sicher, dass sie Abler erfolgreich einsetzen.
  • Dazu gehören das Onboarding neuer Vereine, die Unterstützung im täglichen Umgang mit der Plattform sowie die Beantwortung von Fragen.
  • Du bist Teil unseres Customer Success und Support Teams und arbeitest mit klaren Prozessen. Gleichzeitig hilfst du aktiv dabei, unseren Ansatz für Kundenbetreuung und Implementierung im DACH-Markt weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du sammelst Feedback aus dem Markt und bringst es in unser Produktteam ein, um sowohl das Produkt als auch unsere Arbeitsweise kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • Je nach Interesse kann die Rolle auch Aufgaben im Bereich Go-to-Market und Marktentwicklung umfassen, z. B. bei der Identifikation potenzieller Kunden oder erster Business-Development-Aktivitäten.
  • Gelegentlich können auch persönliche Besuche bei Kunden Teil der Rolle sein.

Arbeitsweise

  • Remote-first Rolle (Arbeiten von zu Hause)
  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung im Rahmen der Teilzeit
  • Möglichkeit zur Unterstützung von Co-Working-Spaces je nach Bedarf
  • Gelegentliche Vor-Ort-Termine bei Kunden

Deine Aufgaben

  • Onboarding neuer Vereine und Begleitung beim Setup
  • Unterstützung von Kunden im täglichen Einsatz von Abler
  • Beantwortung von Fragen und Sicherstellung einer positiven Nutzungserfahrung
  • Sammeln und Weitergeben von Kundenfeedback an das Produktteam
  • Mitgestaltung unserer Prozesse für Customer Success und Implementierung in DACH
  • Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Hilfsmaterialien und Guides
  • Unterstützung bei Go-to-Market und Marktentwicklung bei Bedarf

Das bringst du mit

  • Freude daran, Menschen zu helfen und Probleme zu lösen
  • Bezug zum Sport (z. B. als Spieler, Trainer oder im Verein)
  • Sicher im Umgang mit gängigen digitalen Tools (Du musst nicht hoch technisch sein, solltest aber offen sein, neue Systeme zu lernen (wir schulen dich auf Abler)
  • Strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Wohnsitz in der DACH-Region
  • Erfahrung mit Abler ist ein Plus
  • Spanischkenntnisse sind ein großes Plus (Unterstützung in anderen Märkten möglich)

Das erwartet dich

  • Flexible Teilzeitrolle mit Entwicklungsperspektive
  • Remote-Arbeitsumfeld mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • Unterstützung bei Co-Working-Space möglich
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem erfahrenen Team
  • Klare Prozesse, Einarbeitung und Unterstützung
  • Möglichkeit, aktiv Einfluss auf Produkt und Arbeitsweise zu nehmen

Über Abler

Abler entwickelt das Betriebssystem für Sportorganisationen.

Unsere Plattform wurde in Island entwickelt, einem Land mit einem der stärksten organisierten Sportsysteme weltweit. Island gilt international als Vorzeigemodell für erfolgreiche Sportentwicklung. Heute nutzen rund 75 % der gesamten Isländishen Bevölkerung Abler im Kontext von Sport - alles vom Breitensport bis hin zu professionellen Strukturen.

Unser Ziel ist es, Sportorganisationen besser zu machen und dadurch die Entwicklung von Menschen und Gemeinschaften durch Sport zu fördern.

Sport matters.

Bewerbung

Wenn dich die Rolle anspricht, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Bei Fragen kannst du dich direkt an den Hiring Manager wenden:
. Alle Bewerbungen werden vertraulich behandelt.

--English below--

Part-Time Customer Success & Implementation Manager (DACH)

We are looking for someone to support our customers in the DACH region and help them get the most out of Abler.

This is a part-time contractor role (around 10-20 hours per week to start), with the opportunity to grow over time as we expand in the region.

The Role

You will work closely with new and existing customers, helping them get set up and making sure they are successful using Abler.

This includes onboarding new clubs, answering questions, supporting them in their day-to-day use, and making sure they feel confident using the platform.

You will be part of our wider Customer Success and Support team, so you will not be alone. We will train you and support you closely, and you will have clear processes to follow. This role is not only about support. You will also play an important role in shaping how we work with customers in the DACH region. That includes collecting feedback, sharing insights with our product team, and helping us improve both the product and how we support our customers.

In addition, depending on your interest and capacity, the role can expand into supporting our go-to-market efforts in the DACH region. This may include helping identify potential customers, mapping the market, or supporting early business development activities.

From time to time, the role may also include visiting customers in person.

What You'll Do

  • Help onboard new clubs and guide them through setup
  • Answer customer questions and support them in using the platform
  • Work closely with clubs to make sure they are getting value from Abler
  • Collect customer feedback and bring it back to our product and development team
  • Support the development of how we approach customer success and implementation in DACH
  • Create and improve help materials, guides, and simple support content for customers
  • Support go-to-market and market development activities where needed, such as identifying potential customers or stakeholders
  • Occasionally visit customers in person

What We're Looking For

  • Someone who enjoys helping people and solving problems
  • A strong connection to sport, through playing, coaching, or working in a club
  • Comfortable using everyday digital tools and systems
  • You do not need to be highly technical, but you should be confident working with common software and willing to learn. We will train you on Abler
  • Organised and reliable, with good communication skills
  • Comfortable speaking and writing in German and English
  • Based in the DACH region
  • Experience with Abler is definitely a plus
  • Spanish language skills are a big plus, as there may be opportunities to support customers or activities in that region as well

What We Value

We look for people who have the Winner Mindset, Passion and Ownership.
Read here about our DNA

About Abler

Abler is building the operating system for sports organisations.

We help clubs run their programmes, manage their members, and communicate better, all in one place. Our goal is simple: help sport organisations run better and reach more people.

We are already used at scale in our home market and are growing internationally. We work with leading organisations connected to clubs like Chelsea, Newcastle, and Barcelona, and bring those same tools and standards to grassroots sport.

How to apply

If you are excited about the opportunity, join our talented team and make a significant impact on the future of our next generation through sport. We look forward to hearing from you soon!

Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and why you are the ideal candidate for this position.

All applications will be reviewed and treated with full confidentiality. If you have any questions about the application process or before you apply, please feel free to reach out to the hiring manager directly at

Role Summary:

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to lead the development of scalable, reliable, and efficient data solutions in a cloud-first environment. This role requires a deep understanding of ETL/ELT processes, AWS data services, and pipeline orchestration to support enterprise-grade analytics and decision-making systems.

You will work closely with data, analysts, and engineers to transform raw data into actionable insights and support the infrastructure that powers data-driven products.

This is a unique opportunity to join a high-growth startup on a 100% equity-based compensation model, aligning your success directly with the company's. You'll be part of the foundational team and directly participating in long-term value creation.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that process large-scale data efficiently and reliably.

  • Develop and manage cloud-native data pipelines using AWS Glue, Python, and SQL.

  • Orchestrate data workflows and stateful jobs using AWS Step Functions for robust process management and automation.

  • Store and manage large datasets in Amazon S3 with efficient partitioning, data formats (e.g., Parquet), and access control strategies.

  • Design and optimize relational data structures in PostgreSQL, ensuring data accuracy and performance.

  • Implement data quality monitoring, logging, and alerting within all pipeline processes.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define data requirements and ensure consistency, availability, and accessibility.

  • Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and continuous improvement of engineering best practices.

  • Ensure adherence to data security, privacy, and governance standards.

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar data-focused engineering role.

  • Strong experience building and managing ETL/ELT pipelines in production environments.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS Glue and Step Functions.

  • Deep understanding of Amazon S3 and data lake best practices.

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, particularly with PostgreSQL, including performance tuning and complex queries.

  • Solid programming skills in Python (or similar languages) for data processing.

  • Experience designing scalable data architectures and workflow orchestration solutions.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools, version control (e.g., Git), and DevOps principles.

Bonus Skills:

  • Experience with other AWS data services (e.g., Athena, Lambda).

  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration alternatives (e.g., AWS Step Functions).

  • Exposure to modern data modeling concepts

  • Knowledge of data security and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR).

What we Offer

  • Equity: Participation in VendueTech Ltd ESOP Trust, with share allocation based on hours worked and achievements.

  • Opportunity to work on innovative, data & AI-driven projects transforming the real estate auction market.

  • Flexible remote work environment with global collaboration.

  • Direct contribution to the success and growth of a mission-driven, forward-thinking company.

VendueTech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristics. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage applications from all qualified individuals.

Lieu : Montréal – télétravail possible depuis le Québec ou l’Ontario
Durée : Jusqu’au 31 janvier 2027, renouvelable

Heures : 35 h/semaine

Langue : Anglais requis – profil bilingue accepté

À propos du poste

Nous recherchons un Chef de projet SAP S/4HANA senior pour piloter un projet de mise à niveau de la plateforme SAP S/4HANA vers une version plus récente. La personne sera responsable de la planification, de la coordination et de l’exécution complète de l’upgrade, de la préparation initiale jusqu’à la mise en production et à la stabilisation post-déploiement.

Le mandat évolue dans une grande organisation de plus de 10 000 employés, au sein d’un environnement complexe et fortement réglementé. Le Chef de projet travaillera avec plusieurs équipes internes et externes, notamment SAP, BASIS, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, équipes d’affaires, partenaires et fournisseurs.

Exigences principales

  • 10+ années d’expérience en gestion de projets SAP.
  • Expérience concrète dans la gestion de mises à niveau SAP S/4HANA, idéalement d’une version 2020/2021 vers 2023 ou plus récente.
  • Excellente maîtrise de la méthodologie SAP Activate.
  • Expérience importante dans les domaines Supply Chain et Manufacturing.
  • Expérience dans une organisation de plus de 10 000 employés.
  • Expérience de projets SAP globaux impliquant plusieurs équipes, fournisseurs et parties prenantes.
  • Expérience en environnement hautement réglementé.
  • Capacité à coordonner plusieurs fournisseurs et partenaires simultanément.
  • Expérience importante dans la planification et le pilotage des tests, cutover et mises en production.
  • Excellente maîtrise de la gouvernance de projet, notamment échéanciers, budgets, jalons, dépendances et registres RAID.
  • Capacité à communiquer efficacement avec les équipes techniques, les responsables d’affaires et la haute direction.

Atouts

Une expérience en custom code remediation lors d’un upgrade S/4HANA est particulièrement pertinente. Une bonne compréhension de SAP BASIS et de l’architecture SAP, ainsi qu’une expérience de tests à grande échelle et de périodes d’hypercare/stabilisation post-go-live, constituent également des atouts.

Les certifications PMP, PRINCE2 ou SAP sont appréciées.

Responsabilités principales

Le Chef de projet prendra en charge le plan détaillé de la mise à niveau SAP, incluant les échéanciers, ressources, jalons, risques, enjeux et dépendances. Il pilotera les différentes phases du projet selon SAP Activate, notamment la préparation, le Sandbox, le développement, l’assurance qualité, les tests et la mise en production.

Il coordonnera les campagnes de tests intégrés, de régression et de performance, ainsi que la stratégie et l’exécution du cutover. Il sera également responsable de la coordination entre les équipes SAP/BASIS, les responsables des processus d’affaires, les équipes Supply Chain et Manufacturing ainsi que les différents fournisseurs.

La personne assurera la gouvernance du projet, le contrôle des changements, le suivi des risques et la production des rapports destinés à la haute direction. Elle contribuera également à la gestion du changement, à la formation, à la documentation et à la période de stabilisation suivant la mise en production.

Roger setzt hier an, um die Dentalbranche zu revolutionieren. Unterstützt von führenden Investor:innen aus Europa und den USA wächst unser Startup rasant. Daher suchen wir eine_n_ Technical Onboarding Specialist, der_die_ eine Schlüsselrolle in der reibungslosen Einführung unserer Software bei unseren Kund:innen übernimmt. In dieser Position koordinierst du die Installation einer lokalen Softwarekomponente per Fernzugriff und übernimmst die Konfiguration von Kommunikationskanälen wie WhatsApp.

Diese Position ist remote, daher kannst du flexibel von deinem bevorzugten Standort aus arbeiten. Die interne Kommunikation im Unternehmen erfolgt auf Englisch, daher sind gute Englischkenntnisse erforderlich, um effektiv mit unseren internationalen Teams zu kommunizieren – Perfektion ist jedoch nicht notwendig. Da du eng mit Zahnarztpraxen in Deutschland arbeitest, setzen wir muttersprachliches Deutsch voraus.

Diese Rolle ist kundenorientiert und erfordert eine proaktive, eigenverantwortliche Persönlichkeit mit hervorragenden Organisationsfähigkeiten und Freude am Kund:innenkontakt. In einem dynamischen Startup-Umfeld übernimmst du Verantwortung und bringst eigenständig technische Lösungen auf den Weg. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren IT-, Engineering- und Sales-Teams zusammen, um Roger zu einem unverzichtbaren Werkzeug für Dentalprofis zu machen.

Aufgaben

  1. Koordination der Software-Installation: Organisiere und koordiniere die Remote-Installation einer lokalen Komponente in Zahnarztpraxen über TeamViewer. Arbeite dabei eng mit der IT der Praxis und unserem internen IT-Team zusammen.

  4. Unterstützung im Onboarding-Prozess: Stelle sicher, dass die Software optimal auf die Bedürfnisse der Praxis abgestimmt ist und unterstütze das Praxisteam bei Fragen und der Einarbeitung.
  5. Kund:innenbetreuung und -kommunikation: Pflege eine enge und professionelle Kommunikation mit den Praxen, sei erste:r Ansprechpartner:in für technische Fragen und begleite die Kund:innen während der gesamten Implementierungsphase.
  6. Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams: Arbeite eng mit den Sales-, Support- und Engineering-Teams zusammen, um technische Lösungen zu liefern und die Implementierung optimal abzustimmen.
  7. Management der internen IT: Unterstütze das interne IT-Management und stelle sicher, dass alle IT-Ressourcen effektiv genutzt werden.

Bonus-Aufgaben

  • Technische Fehlerbehebung und Datenbankverständnis: Falls möglich, unterstütze bei der technischen Fehlerbehebung, indem du das Datenbanksystem und die dahinterliegende Logik verstehst, um technische Herausforderungen schnell zu lösen.

Qualifikation

  • Technische Affinität und erste Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Software-Installationen oder IT-Systemen.
  • Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Freude am Kund:innenkontakt.

raw.title: Senior Database Administrator
raw.excerpt: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world.
raw.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a team that resonates with passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer's interactions, experiences, behavior, and insights, and we strive to ensure we always act authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, the new Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space. Ready to join us?

What's the position?

Every bet and payout at Hard Rock Digital is a database transaction that has to be fast and accurate. A casino game resolves in milliseconds; settling a big sporting event moves millions of balances at once, and none can be wrong.

We're hiring a Senior Database Administrator to own production reliability for our CockroachDB and PostgreSQL fleet. You'll diagnose contention, range hotspots, retry storms, plan regressions, and cross-region latency in systems that move money at scale. You'll read execution plans and reason about the optimizer that produced them, inspect database internals when behavior doesn't match the docs, write Go and Python tooling that makes the next incident faster to solve, and set standards that application engineers rely on under pressure.

Claude Code, Codex, and similar AI harnesses are part of how this team works. You'll use them to investigate incidents, generate probes, summarize evidence, and turn one-off debugging into durable tooling. The goal is to spend less time on toil and more on the work that compounds: better defaults, safer migrations, and tooling that makes the next incident shorter than the last.

What You'll Do

Reliability & Performance

  • Operate and evolve multi-region CockroachDB clusters and PostgreSQL instances across production, staging, and development.

  • Investigate contention, serialization retries (SQLSTATE 40001), and range hotspots in the transaction paths behind bets, wagers, settlements, and payouts.

  • Diagnose leaseholder placement, monotonic-key write pressure, and cross-region latency that turn one query into several network round trips.

  • Trace a slow query to its execution plan, the plan to optimizer behavior, and the behavior to the schema or application call path that caused it.

  • Catch plan regressions after statistics changes, schema changes, data growth, or releases, then turn the fix into a safer rollout pattern.

  • Assess schema-change and backfill risk before it reaches large tables: lock behavior, retry pressure, capacity impact, and rollback path.

  • Plan capacity, scaling events, and version upgrades that customers don't feel.

Observability & Incident Response

  • Build database observability with Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir, Loki, and Snowflake: dashboards backed by real queries, alerting on leading indicators, and SLO tracking.

  • Connect database symptoms to application behavior and business events so alerts point at causes.

  • Join the on-call rota for the data layer, lead incident analysis when the database is part of the failure, and drive blameless postmortems toward durable fixes.

  • Instrument the system to surface degradation before it becomes an incident.

Automation & Tooling

  • Build Go and Python tools that make incidents easier to understand: log collectors, explain-plan analyzers, migration checks, capacity models, and runbook generators.

  • Automate provisioning, configuration, backup, and recovery with Terraform and other infrastructure-as-code tools.

  • Work with platform engineering on CI/CD, deployment safety, and change management for database-touching services.

AI-Augmented Engineering

  • Use Claude Code, Codex, and similar harnesses in daily work to investigate incidents, generate probes, draft runbooks, and write tooling.

  • Keep the harness grounded in logs, traces, metrics, and source code, and verify its output against production facts before you ship it.

  • Evaluate AI-assisted observability and anomaly detection, and share what works with the team.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement and audit access controls, authentication, authorization, and encryption in transit and at rest.

  • Support data-protection, audit-logging, and retention requirements for a regulated gaming platform.

Standards & Mentorship

  • Build a database center of excellence: documentation, standards, and reusable patterns that other teams build against.

  • Mentor engineers on database fundamentals, distributed-systems behavior, and operational discipline.

  • Read CockroachDB and PostgreSQL internals when a problem needs a code-level answer, and bring what you learn back to the team.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

  • 5+ years operating production relational databases as a DBA, Database Reliability Engineer, or Data Platform Engineer.

  • Deep production experience with PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, or another relational database management system, with fluency in the tradeoffs behind isolation, consensus, locality, and query planning.

  • You understand how a SQL engine works under the hood: MVCC, the Volcano iterator execution model, and cost-based optimizer frameworks such as Cascades. You apply that knowledge to indexing strategy and to execution plan analysis.

  • Working knowledge of distributed-systems fundamentals: consensus (Raft and Paxos), distributed transactions, consistency models, and failure modes.

  • You write tools and automation in Python or Go, and you can debug and suggest fixes to line-of-business code in Java or a similar language.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and a monitoring and observability stack such as Grafana or Datadog.

  • UNIX/Linux administration with shell scripting, comfort on a cloud platform (AWS preferred, Azure, or GCP welcome), and willingness to join an on-call rota.

  • Clear technical writing and speech. You'll work across teams.

What You've Done

The strongest candidates show evidence here, not a checklist.

  • Shipped Go or Python tooling for database operations, performance analysis, migration safety, or incident response that other engineers then used.

  • Investigated production incidents end-to-end using metrics, logs, query fingerprints, execution plans, and source-level reasoning.

  • Owned a database platform through on-call, post-incident repair, standards, and cross-team adoption.

  • Used AI coding agents in real engineering work, with review habits that keep generated output tied to evidence.

  • Run CockroachDB in production.

  • Contributed to an open-source database such as PostgreSQL.

  • Worked with streaming infrastructure such as Kafka and Materialize.

  • Worked with a modern data warehouse or analytics platform such as ClickHouse Cloud or Snowflake.

  • Practiced SRE along the lines of the Google SRE books.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • A hybrid / remote working environment

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

  • Opportunity to build products enjoyed by millions as part of a passionate team

  • Team gatherings around the US and Europe

  • Employer-sponsored training and conference attendance

  • Opportunity to work in an AI-first environment with access to the tools you need to excel at your job

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists(LP, CPC, MFT, LCSW) in Nevada to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD

raw.title: Scholarship Program
raw.excerpt: The Court Reporting Academy (“TCRA”) in partnership with court reporting industry partners has established a scholarship and professional career development program for qualified individuals who wish to become professional digital court reporters.
raw.description:
The Court Reporting Academy (“TCRA”) in partnership with court reporting industry partners has established a scholarship and professional career development program for qualified individuals who wish to become professional digital court reporters. One of the major objectives for the program is to ensure that scholarship recipients are prepared to successfully pass the AAERT CER (Certified Electronic Reporter) certification exam.

The TCRA Scholarship Program also includes career placement services for individuals who have successfully completed the digital court reporting courses. Career placement is not guaranteed by TCRA; however, the court reporting industry has a growing need for qualified court reporters. Successful and motivated TCRA graduates will find there are significant opportunities for both full and part-time employment positions as well as independent contractor career opportunities.

The Digital Court Reporter (DCR) Scholarship Program Includes:

  • DCR 101 & DCR 102 courses
  • Practical and hands-on professional development and career guidance
  • No cost court reporter software during the course
  • Job placement services (for full-time and independent contractor opportunities)

Description of the Digital Court Reporting Courses:

Digital Court Reporter (DCR-101): A 4-to-6-week self-paced online course with extensive live coaching and instructor interaction. The course is designed to prepare You to be a professional digital court reporter and to successfully pass the AAERT certification exam. Several live course review and annotation sessions are held each week and scholarship students must attend at least one session per week. Successful completion of the DCR-101 course will provide You with the required knowledge of the legal system, terminology, recording equipment, reporter software and annotations, etiquette, ethics, digital court reporter best practices and other critical knowledge required to become a successful digital court reporter.

Digital Reporter Mentorship (DCR-102): An intense 3-to-4-week program that matches You up with experienced court reporters and court reporting agency sponsors as part of our unique mentoring program. The program includes shadowing experienced working court reporters in live proceedings, while also practicing Your skills in mock and actual recorded proceedings. You will receive direct feedback and coaching from TCRA mentors and instructors. To complete this course, You will need to successfully lead and complete a live mock deposition conducted with instructors and mentors.

Scholarship Selection Criteria:

Space is limited, and only qualified and motivated individuals will be considered. Individuals desiring both full and part-time employment opportunities may apply for available scholarships. Scholarship availability is based on the current market demand for court reporters and decision criteria may include a student’s state or regional location and employment objectives (i.e., full vs. part-time). TCRA in its sole determination may select a candidate for scholarship which we feel will be most successful in the DCR professional development program and best matches the reporter staffing requirements and reporter demand of our court reporting agency sponsors and clients.

Scholarship Candidate Qualifications and Requirements Include:

  • Skills: 40 to 60 WPM typing, excellent English grammar & punctuation proficiency, experience/proficiency with Window-based computers and Outlook applications. Candidates will be asked to take a skills entrance exam.
  • Successfully interview with TCRA instructors and TCRA Placement Services team.
  • Time commitment/availability: Candidates must be able to devote a minimum of 15 to 20 hours per week in order to successfully meet the DCR 101 &102 study and practice requirements.
  • Equipment: Students must have access to a PC (Windows 10 or greater) and (approved USB microphone, USB speaker and headphones or earbuds)
  • Career employment objectives: Candidates must be planning to seek full-time employment opportunities as a court reporter or a minimum of 20 working hours per week if part-time or as an independent contractor).
  • Notary – Candidates must be able to apply and qualify for a notary license in their state of domicile and have no criminal record or convictions.
  • Candidates must be US citizens or a green card holder and have a high school diploma or GED to qualify for a scholarship.
  • Candidates must agree to limited background checks, similar to those conducted by potential employers.

If you're interested, please Apply ASAP - we're eager to hear from you!

Descrição do trabalho

Atua no desenvolvimento e evolução dos componentes web do SDK unificado, garantindo a captura, validação e transmissão segura de dados provenientes de diferentes fontes, como imagens, documentos e sensores, preservando sua integridade durante toda a jornada até os serviços de backend.

É responsável pela implementação de mecanismos avançados de proteção contra fraudes digitais, incluindo detecção de injeção de conteúdo, adulteração de sessões, automação maliciosa e execução em ambientes virtualizados ou navegadores não confiáveis. Trabalha diretamente na camada cliente, considerada uma das superfícies mais críticas de exposição a ataques.

Colabora com equipes de Arquitetura, Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de Plataforma e Produto para transformar requisitos de segurança, confiabilidade e conformidade em soluções escaláveis e prontas para produção. Atua continuamente na otimização de performance, compatibilidade entre navegadores e dispositivos, observabilidade e telemetria, contribuindo para aumentar os níveis de confiança e assertividade dos motores de decisão de risco e fraude.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter componentes web críticos do SDK unificado utilizando JavaScript e TypeScript.
  • Projetar e implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques digitais, automação e manipulação de ambientes de execução.
  • Criar soluções de detecção de navegadores headless, ambientes virtualizados, emuladores e ferramentas de fraude digital.
