raw.description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

What you will be doing:

In this exciting and challenging role as a Technical Product Manager, you will drive the definition and execution of next-generation medical devices that meet user needs, clinical requirements, business objectives, and regulatory expectations. You will be part of the Device Team, reporting to the Director of Device Engineering and working closely with systems, hardware, firmware, software, algorithm, manufacturing, quality, and clinical teams. You will own product requirements, user needs, product roadmaps, usability activities, and design control deliverables while ensuring alignment between customer needs and engineering execution.

Your goal as a Technical Product Manager is to deliver innovative, reliable, and user-centered medical devices by translating customer and clinical insights into clear product requirements and development priorities. You will lead cross-functional product planning from concept through commercialization, balancing user experience, technical feasibility, manufacturing readiness, regulatory requirements, cost, and schedule. You will coordinate product development activities, facilitate technical tradeoff discussions, and ensure stakeholders remain aligned throughout the product lifecycle.

This is a fully remote role from anywhere in the U.S. Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, while also providing in-person office hubs located in Paris, Boston, New York, and the San Francisco Bay Area.

What success looks like:

  • Own product requirements, user needs, intended use, and system-level product definition for a major device product line.
  • Translate customer needs, clinical requirements, technical constraints, and business objectives into actionable product requirements and development roadmaps.
  • Partner closely with Systems, Hardware, Firmware, Software, Algorithms, Clinical, Quality, Regulatory, Business Development, Operations, and Manufacturing teams to drive successful product development and commercialization.
  • Lead cross-functional tradeoff discussions involving functionality, usability, technical risk, manufacturability, regulatory requirements, cost, and schedule.
  • Drive product development through concept, feasibility, verification, validation, manufacturing transfer, and sustaining engineering.
  • Coordinate usability studies, customer evaluations, clinical feedback activities, and product validation efforts.
  • Support design control activities, including user needs, requirements traceability, risk management, design reviews, and regulatory documentation.
  • Drive day-to-day Agile product development practices across multiple initiatives and product portfolios within a product line.
  • Collaborate with suppliers, contract manufacturers, and external partners to support product development, manufacturing readiness, and product launches.
  • Communicate product status, key decisions, risks, and roadmap updates to stakeholders and leadership.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Business, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 5–8 years of experience in product management, systems engineering, device development, or related technical leadership roles.
  • At least 3 years of experience supporting the development and commercialization of hardware, medical devices, wearables, or other multidisciplinary products.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate customer, clinical, and business needs into product requirements, roadmaps, and development priorities.
  • Experience working closely with hardware, firmware, software, systems, manufacturing, and quality teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Experience supporting products through design controls, verification and validation, manufacturing transfer, and commercialization activities.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand engineering tradeoffs involving functionality, usability, reliability, manufacturability, cost, and schedule.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive alignment across cross-functional teams.
  • Experience working in regulated industries, including medical devices, healthcare technology, or other safety-critical products preferred.
  • Experience with modern product development and collaboration tools such as Ketryx, Jira, Figma, GitHub, Asana, or similar tools preferred.

The salary range for this role is $160,000 – $183,000. Salary ranges are determined using current market compensation data for this role and adjusted based on experience, skills, and location. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those who lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

Not just setting industry standards, but redefining them entirely. We are bold in our thinking and creative in our approach. The Global Director, General Ledger leads the global Record-to-Report process and is responsible for the monthly close and year end close, journal entry governance, balance sheet reconciliations, consolidation support, intercompany accounting, fixed asset accounting, account structure governance, close controls, and GL integration for acquired companies. This role ensures that the company’s books are complete, accurate, timely, and consistently maintained across all legal entities and countries.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the global Record-to-Report process, including close calendar management, journal entry standards, account reconciliations, accruals, allocations, intercompany accounting, fixed assets, and consolidation support.
  • Establish global GL policies, procedures, account ownership standards, reconciliation templates, close checklists, certification requirements, and quality review routines.
  • Provide technical accounting expertise on the interpretation and application of accounting standards, monitor changes in accounting standards and reporting requirements, and ensure relevant changes are appropriately implemented across the organization
  • Lead monthly and annual close execution across countries, shared services, and local finance teams, ensuring deadlines, review standards, issue escalation, and reporting dependencies are met.
  • Maintain governance over the chart of accounts, legal entity structure, department and practice coding, cost centers, intercompany accounts, and reporting attributes.
  • Partner with FP&A to ensure actual results are reported in ways that support management reporting, KPI analysis, profitability views, and decision support.
  • Partner with the Tax & Audit to support compliance requirements and audit activities by ensuring accurate and timely financial information, reconciliations and supporting schedules are available
  • Support acquisition integration by mapping acquired company ledgers, converting chart of accounts, opening balance sheet support, standardizing close processes, and aligning accounting policies.
  • Strengthen controls over manual journals, reconciliations, account ownership, recurring entries, intercompany settlements, fixed assets, accruals, and close certifications.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance required; CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, CMA, or equivalent preferred.
  • 8+ years of accounting, general ledger, controllership, consolidation, or record-to-report experience, including leadership in a multi-entity or multi-country environment.
  • Strong technical accounting knowledge and experience applying accounting standards to complex or non-routine transactions is preferred.
  • Experience with ERP systems, close management tools, multi-currency accounting, intercompany processes, acquisition integration, and internal controls is preferred.
We are an equal opportunity employer; we are proud to employ veterans and promote diversity and inclusion in our workplace. Diversity is a strength for our global company. We pledge that CAI will be operated in a way that is fair and equitable to all – our employees, our customers, and the broader society.

raw.description:
Join the GTM Revolution at SalesCaptain — Where B2B Growth Happens

Since our beginnings in 2021, SalesCaptain has grown into a global force, working with fast-growing B2B brands, YC & Techstars startups, and Series B/C companies, helping them go to market through predictable, scalable outbound systems.

We're looking for a Senior GTM Engineer to own and evolve our outbound revenue infrastructure across client accounts.

This is a hands-on senior role sitting at the intersection of data, automation, AI, deliverability, intent signals, and outbound strategy. Beyond building systems yourself, you’ll help set technical standards, introduce new GTM technologies, and mentor other team members.

This is a full-time, remote role, working EU hours.

About the role

You’ll work closely with GTM Strategists, Campaign Managers, and other GTM Engineers to architect scalable outbound systems from ICP definition through campaign execution and reporting.

You’ll own complex Clay workflows, data infrastructure, intent and signal-based targeting, automation, and deliverability, while continuously testing new AI and GTM tools that can improve our results.

We’re looking for someone who can not only build great systems, but also lead technically, challenge existing processes, and help raise the standard of the wider team.

What you’ll do ✨

  • Architect end-to-end outbound systems, from ICP and TAM definition through enrichment, sequencing, CRM sync, and performance reporting
  • Build and optimize advanced Clay workflows, including enrichment waterfalls, Claygent, AI columns, conditional logic, and custom API integrations
  • Own and improve email deliverability infrastructure, including domains, inbox health, sending infrastructure, authentication, reputation, and scaling best practices
  • Design intent and signal-based outbound systems using signals such as job changes, funding, hiring activity, website intent, technology adoption, social activity, and other buying signals
  • Build automation workflows with n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs, and webhooks
  • Use AI and LLMs to improve prospect research, qualification, personalization, data processing, and campaign workflows
  • Continuously explore and test new AI and GTM technologies, identifying tools and approaches that can give SalesCaptain and our clients an advantage
  • Write lightweight Python or JavaScript and work directly with APIs when no-code tools aren’t enough
  • Partner with GTM Strategists to improve targeting, campaign architecture, and outbound performance
  • Establish best practices and documentation for GTM engineering workflows
  • Mentor junior and mid-level GTM Engineers, review workflows, troubleshoot complex problems, and help the team develop technically
  • Proactively identify inefficient processes and design better, more scalable solutions

Requirements

Who you are ❤️‍🔥

You should have:

  • 3+ years of experience in GTM Engineering, RevOps, outbound operations, growth engineering, or a closely related role
  • Strong hands-on experience building outbound systems in a B2B SaaS, GTM agency, consultancy, or fast-moving technology environment
  • Advanced experience with Clay, including complex enrichment workflows, Claygent, AI columns, waterfalls, and APIs
  • Strong understanding of email deliverability, sending infrastructure, domain reputation, authentication, and inbox health
  • Experience designing campaigns around intent data and buying signals, rather than relying only on static prospect lists
  • Strong knowledge of the modern GTM tooling ecosystem and genuine curiosity around emerging AI and automation tools
  • Comfort working with APIs, webhooks, JSON, automation platforms, and basic Python or JavaScript
  • A strong commercial mindset — you understand ICPs, messaging, outbound performance, pipeline, and why targeting decisions matter
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to design systems rather than simply execute predefined tasks
  • Experience mentoring, supporting, or reviewing the work of other team members
  • Excellent English communication skills (C1–C2), with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working with Tech, SaaS, or B2B software companies

We’re also open to candidates coming from RevOps, growth engineering, Clay consulting, outbound operations, or highly technical SDR/BDR backgrounds who have transitioned into systems building.

What good looks like

You are successful in this role if:

  • GTM Strategists trust the systems and data you build without needing to recheck everything
  • Our outbound infrastructure remains scalable, reliable, and deliverability-safe
  • Intent signals help us identify better prospects and improve campaign timing
  • Clay and automation workflows are clean, efficient, documented, and cost-effective
  • You regularly introduce new AI, automation, and GTM approaches that improve how the team works
  • You identify problems before they become bottlenecks
  • Other GTM Engineers improve through your mentoring and technical guidance
  • You help the team move faster while maintaining a high standard of data and execution quality

This role is not for you if

  • You have never used Clay or similar GTM automation tools
  • Your outbound experience is limited to basic LinkedIn scraping or list building
  • You have little understanding of email deliverability
  • You prefer executing instructions rather than designing systems and proposing improvements
  • You are not interested in experimenting with new AI and GTM technologies
  • You are uncomfortable taking ownership of complex technical problems
  • You do not enjoy mentoring or sharing knowledge with other team members

Benefits

In addition to joining a fast-growing GTM team, we offer:

  • Remote work
  • Collaborative, friendly, and ambitious team
  • Paid vacation, days off, and sick leave
  • Team-building activities
  • Free books and Kindles to support your development
  • Specialized training and access to leading GTM tools
  • Opportunity to work with international B2B brands, startups, and scaleups
  • Hands-on exposure to emerging AI, automation, data, and GTM technologies
  • Significant autonomy to experiment, introduce new tools, and influence how our GTM infrastructure evolves
  • Opportunity to mentor others and play a key role in developing the GTM Engineering function

Job description:

Why Apply to New Frontier Immigration Law

Join the New Frontier Immigration Law team and help change the lives of 1 million undocumented immigrants in the USA. Our fast-growing law firm in Phoenix, AZ is committed to humanitarian-based immigration and finding innovative solutions for seemingly impossible problems.

Are you ready to join one of the fastest-growing law firms in the US, where incredible opportunities await? Here, we don't just offer a job: we provide an environment that challenges you to become the best version of yourself and helps others do the same.

This is an opportunity as a people developer, coaching, guiding, and empowering legal support teams to do their best work while attorneys focus entirely on legal strategy. You'll build the culture, accountability, and systems that make operational excellence possible.

Removal Defense Paralegal Supervisor

Role Objective

The Removal Defense Paralegal Supervisor leads and develops the removal defense legal support team, ensuring the coaching, resources, and accountability needed to deliver exceptional client service in high-stakes immigration proceedings. This is a people management role; you will manage the paralegals who support removal defense cases, freeing our attorneys to focus on trial preparation and legal strategy.

Responsibilities / Duties

  • Conduct weekly 1-on-1 meetings, providing ongoing coaching, feedback, and performance management.
  • Identify training needs specific to removal defense workflows and coordinate skill development.
  • Conduct performance reviews, contribute to compensation recommendations, and address team matters in coordination with firm leadership.
  • Ensure team members follow strict checklists for EOIR/ICE filings, hearing preparation, and calendar workflows.
  • Audit work quality, track KPIs, and identify process bottlenecks, recommending improvements to leadership.
  • Take escalated client calls with empathy and de-escalation, and provide real-time guidance to team members on difficult client interactions.
  • Resolve operational and client service issues at the supervisor level, preventing unnecessary attorney involvement.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years managing teams of 5–10 people in high-volume, deadline-driven environments.
  • 3-5 years of immigration law experience, EOIR, or removal defense.
  • Proven track record of coaching, developing, and holding direct reports accountable through 1-on-1s, performance reviews, and difficult conversations.
  • Strong understanding of how to enforce checklists, SOPs, and quality control systems in a compliance-critical environment.
  • High emotional intelligence, resilience, and conflict resolution ability.
  • Mission-driven mindset aligned with serving immigrant communities.
  • Bilingual (Spanish/English) required, native or professional fluency.
  • Must work Arizona business hours (8 AM – 5 PM MST); reliable high-speed internet and dedicated home office required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing bilingual or remote teams.
  • Experience with legal case management systems such as Filevine or similar platforms.

Offer

  • Compensation: $27,000 - $32,000 MXN pesos monthly.
  • 8:00am to 5:00pm AZ Time.
  • Remote Work.
Salary: $27,000 - $32,000 MXN

raw.title: Risk & Trading Associate - Evenings & Weekends
raw.excerpt: PENN Entertainment, Inc.  is North America’s leading provider of integrated entertainment, sports content, and casino gaming experiences.
raw.description:
PENN Entertainment, Inc. is North America’s leading provider of integrated entertainment, sports content, and casino gaming experiences. From casinos and racetracks to online gaming, sports betting and entertainment content, we deliver the experiences people want, how and where they want them.

We’re always on the lookout for those who are passionate about creating and delivering cutting-edge online gaming and sports media products. Whether it’s through Hollywood Casino, theScore Bet Sportsbook, or theScore media app, we’re excited to push the boundaries of what’s possible. These state-of-the-art platforms are powered by proprietary in-house technology, a key component of PENN’s omnichannel gaming and entertainment strategy.

When you join PENN Entertainment’s digital team, you’ll not only work on these cutting-edge platforms through theScore and PENN Interactive, but you’ll also be part of a company that truly cares about your career growth. We’re committed to supporting you as you expand your skills and explore new opportunities.

With locations throughout North America, you can build a future at PENN Entertainment wherever you are. If you want to challenge conventions in gaming, media and entertainment, we want to talk to you.

About the Role & TeamThe Risk and Trading Team is responsible for all Sports Betting products, prices, risk management, Boosts, Specials, Promotions and Player Props in a fast-paced, 24/7 North American facing operator. You will be part of the team looking after the above duties as the global Sports calendar requires. We are currently looking for highly motivated and suitably qualified team players. This role requires a highly professional, organized, and enthusiastic individual who is data driven, is obsessed by sports and sports betting and willing to push the boundaries to continuously improve the product.

This role is not for narrow risk management, this role is for taking risk management on the full 360 of the Sportsbook product, performance, promotion, presentation, and pricing. If you want to put the fan and the fan experience at the centre of the Sportsbook read on.

About the Work

  • Manage live betting markets in real time across assigned sports/events
  • Adjust odds proactively based on: Game state (score, time, momentum),Injuries, cards, or key events and Market movement and betting activity
  • Execute liability-aware decisions including: Price moves, Market suspension and Stake/limit considerations
  • Ensure pricing is competitive vs key operators (e.g., Bet365, Pinnacle)
  • Operate within event templates and market tiers, adjusting when required
  • Monitor and react to sharp or arbitrage activity
  • Use internal tools to track exposure and performance
  • Contribute to live trading improvements and process optimization

About You

  • Post-secondary degree in a relevant field, such as mathematics, business or other fields within analytical disciplines
  • Must be able to work weekends, evenings and holidays
  • 1 to 2 years’ experience in a trading environment or assessing and calculating risk within the areas of insurance or finance advantageous
  • Good all round sports betting knowledge and a strong interest in betting and odds required
  • Data obsessed, not just data driven. Excellent mathematical skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
  • Flexibility is a must as working hours will be dictated by business needs. Must be able to work flexible schedules including nights, weekends, and public holidays
  • Able to multitask and work under pressure
  • Ability to work in fast paced environment and make decisions quickly
  • Must have exceptional time management skills
  • High attention to detail and precision in delivery
  • Ability to learn quickly, work independently and in a team setting
  • Strong initiative and outstanding work ethic

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Comprehensive Benefits package
  • Fun, relaxed work environment
  • Education and conference reimbursements
Salary Range
$50,000—$55,000 USD

Penn Interactive is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Penn Interactive provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Penn Interactive provides best-in-class benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality – to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life.

raw.description:
SUPPORT SPECIALIST (With Emphasis on Engineering Analysis)

Department: Support

Reports to: EA Lead/VP of Support and Training

Division: Remote

Classification: Salary/Exempt/Full-time

JOB SUMMARY

An EA Support Technician is responsible for providing frontline technical support services to Milsoft customers, including installation, troubleshooting, problem resolution, and maintenance in a 24/7 support environment. Phone, email, and remote connection software are utilized to resolve customer

issues and achieve customer satisfaction. The position will require some travel and after-hours on-call

support time.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  1. Directly resolves technical support inquiries through remote troubleshooting and diagnostics to ensure that all EA products and services function properly
  2. Advises customers on system settings and configurations that favorably impact software performance and user experience
  3. Must be able to turn customer concerns and requests into detailed tickets, including reproduction steps, for action by the Development team
  4. Translate complex operational and system processes into clear instructions and/or explanations as knowledge articles
  5. Document all customer interactions in a support ticketing system
  6. Adapt to new technologies and changes in software functionality through continuous product release cycles
  7. Upholds, safeguards, and promotes Milsoft’s values and philosophy relating particularly to ethics, integrity, and corporate responsibility
  8. Any other duties that may be necessary or assigned from time to time. Such additional duties will not normally change the scope of the job

QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent work experience
  2. Prior experience in the electric utility field is preferred
  3. Knowledge of Microsoft server/client operating systems, network architecture, and components
  4. Experience with Lua scripting is a plus
  5. Must be able to effectively communicate with customers, both verbally and in writing
  6. Able to adapt and learn new technologies and retain knowledge for future applications

raw.excerpt: Role OverviewWe are seeking an experienced US Tax Compliance Manager to join our growing firm.
raw.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced US Tax Compliance Manager to join our growing firm. This role is designed for a technically strong U.S. tax professional with 5–8 years of public accounting experience and significant experience preparing and reviewing U.S. federal and state tax filings.

The US Tax Compliance Manager will be responsible for overseeing the timely and accurate completion of U.S. tax compliance engagements for individuals, corporations, partnerships, trusts and estates. The role will provide technical review and guidance to the tax team, research complex compliance matters, monitor changes in U.S. tax legislation and help ensure consistent, high-quality delivery across the U.S. tax practice.

Canadian tax knowledge is considered an asset, but is not required. The primary focus of this position is U.S. tax compliance and technical expertise.

Responsibilities (Tasks Associated with the Role)

  • Manage and review U.S. federal and state tax compliance engagements for individuals, corporations, partnerships, trusts and estates.
  • Prepare and review U.S. tax returns and related information reporting, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1065, 1041, 5471, 5472, 8858, 8865 and other applicable filings.
  • Review complex tax returns and supporting workpapers for accuracy, completeness and technical compliance.
  • Provide technical guidance to staff and assist with the resolution of complex U.S. tax compliance matters.
  • Research U.S. federal and state tax legislation and communicate relevant changes and requirements to the team.
  • Manage client compliance deadlines, workflow and engagement priorities.
  • Identify compliance issues and opportunities for process improvements.
  • Respond to client questions and provide practical guidance relating to U.S. tax compliance requirements.
  • Work collaboratively with Canadian tax professionals where U.S. and Canadian tax matters intersect.
  • Mentor and develop junior tax professionals, including providing technical review and feedback.
  • Assist with the development of standardized processes, checklists, templates and technical resources for the U.S. tax practice.

Qualifications/Skills & Experience

  • U.S. CPA or IRS Enrolled Agent designation would be an asset.
  • 5–8 years of public accounting experience focused on U.S. taxation.
  • Strong experience preparing and reviewing U.S. federal tax returns.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. federal tax compliance requirements, with U.S. state tax experience considered an asset.
  • Experience with U.S. international information reporting is an asset.
  • Strong technical research and problem-solving abilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple compliance engagements and deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Proven ability to mentor and support junior tax professionals.
  • Canadian tax or cross-border experience is an asset, but not required.

We have Five Core Values at Our Firm:

  1. All In(passion for what you do and a commitment to excellence)
  2. Own It(solutions oriented, owning outcomes)
  3. Choose Opportunity (willingness to innovate)
  4. Relentless Excellence(redefining expectations)
  5. Better Together(teamwork drives the best results)

Work Location: Remote, hybrid or in-person in the GTA.

Compensation:This position offers a starting salary range of $110,000 to $140,000 per year. Final compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate’s education, relevant experience, and skills.

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI):Applicants are advised that AI may be used to support aspects of the recruitment process, such as application screening or scheduling

Learn more about us here: and in this video:

Do our core values resonate with you?

Does your skillset align with this role?

If so, we want to hear from you!

Salary: 110,000-140,000

raw.title: Senior Commercial Counsel
raw.excerpt: Redox is on a mission to accelerate healthcare’s transformation with useful data.
raw.description:
Redox is on a mission to accelerate healthcare’s transformation with useful data. Redox Engine, a flexible interoperability platform, connects and powers real-time healthcare data exchange. With just one connection, data can be orchestrated across a growing network of 12,000+ systems and organizations, including 100+ electronic health record systems (EHRs). Redox processes over 1.2 billion messages per month across our health tech vendor, provider, payer, EHR, and life sciences customers.

Opportunity & Impact

The Commercial Counsel will play an integral role in supporting the legal function across Redox and becoming a trusted partner and advisor to all business segments. While this role will primarily be partnering with Redox's sales team to negotiate and close deals at pace with acceptable risk, it will also be responsible for supporting all teams in engaging with outside vendors. Reporting directly to the General Counsel, this role will provide the right candidate with the opportunity to grow and expand their expertise across all corporate legal functions.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts (including customer facing and vendors).

  • Document learnings to create a long term knowledge management system for future Redoxers.

  • Participate in or manage the process to create efficiency in contracting, including self serve options for sales and other parts of Redox.

  • Support the legal functions in other business areas as required, including compliance, customer success and employment matters.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience independently drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex commercial contracts

  • Excellent legal writing skills, with the judgment to communicate complex terms clearly and concisely

  • Sound judgment operating in ambiguity, comfortable making calls without a clear precedent

  • Demonstrated ability to work and make decisions autonomously, operating within parameters set in partnership with leadership

  • Strong ability to prioritize and focus effort on the highest impact work across a demanding caseload

  • Confidence to ask questions and seek input, balanced with the self awareness to push your own limits

  • Proven business acumen and commercial judgment

  • Track record of building trusted relationships cross functionally and directly with customers

  • Intellectual curiosity that drives you to solve problems, not just find answers

  • Comfortable operating with urgency and pace in a fast moving environment

  • Team oriented mindset, ready to pitch in wherever needed

  • Fluency with AI tools (e.g., Claude) to drive efficiency in contract drafting, review, and knowledge management, as Redox is an AI forward company

Who you'll be engaging with:

  • Redox's sales team, as the primary partner for negotiating and closing deals

  • The General Counsel, as this role's direct manager

  • Compliance, customer success, and employment teams, for legal support across the business

Nice to have in your background:

  • Experience working directly with a sales team highly preferred

  • SaaS background a plus, but not a requirement

  • Working knowledge of the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) is a serious plus, but not a requirement

raw.description:
Graphite Financial is a growing boutique finance, accounting, tax, and strategy firm (www.graphitefinancial.com) built to help startup and high-growth companies scale efficiently and sustainably. Graphite Financial is redefining the “finance department” for early-stage companies and VC-backed startups. We deliver high-caliber accounting and finance leadership and support to entrepreneurs and management teams building scalable, high-growth companies. Our clients are actively managing cash burn, measuring performance, reporting to investors, making capital allocation decisions, and preparing for fundraising. All of that takes expertise and time that founders don’t have and can’t afford to hire for. Graphite bridges the gap with flexible, fixed-fee support packages that provide fractional leadership and operational support from CFOs, Controllers, FP&A Managers, and Tax leaders.

ROLE PURPOSE

Ensure high-quality, consistent client delivery across an assigned team of CPG-focused Client Leads and staff by enabling, coaching, and coordinating their work. The Accounting Senior Manager — CPG Team Lead is accountable for team effectiveness across a portfolio of consumer packaged goods clients — not just individual client outcomes. This role requires both delivery leadership and people leadership, and carries formal responsibilities for performance reviews, career coaching, and development planning.

CPG is a demanding vertical. Clients in this space deal with trade promotion complexity, multi-channel revenue structures, inventory and landed cost challenges, and margin pressure that requires precision at every level. The Team Lead must be fluent enough in CPG accounting to coach Client Leads through these challenges credibly — and to recognize quality work product when they review it.

WHAT IT TAKES TO SUCCEED HERE

This is a fully remote leadership role within a client-facing professional services firm. You lead a team of Accounting Managers (Client Leads), Senior Associates, and Associates serving CPG clients who expect Graphite-quality accounting every month. The following qualities define what high performance looks like at this level.

•CPG Accounting Fluency: You understand CPG accounting at a practitioner level — trade spend, deductions, landed cost, inventory reconciliation, gross-to-net revenue across channels. You do not need to prepare every reconciliation yourself, but you need to review one and know immediately whether it is right.

•Leadership Without Proximity: You set clear expectations, provide consistent coaching, and hold your team accountable — entirely through remote communication and structured operating rhythms. Your presence is felt through the quality of what your team produces.

•Client Credibility: You maintain the technical depth and professional presence to engage senior CPG client contacts directly when needed. Your team’s standards reflect yours — invest in both.

•Coaching Over Fixing: Your job is to make Client Leads better — not to do their work for them. When something goes wrong on a CPG engagement, your first instinct is to coach, not to take over.

•Responsiveness at Scale: You model the responsiveness you expect from your team. Delayed decisions and slow escalations create client risk in a fast-moving industry. Move fast, communicate clearly, and resolve things.

•Accountability for Team Outcomes: You own what your team delivers across the CPG portfolio. You do not deflect to process or capacity. You identify problems early and solve them.

•Professional Standards Enforcement: You hold Client Leads and Associates to a high bar for written communication, client interaction, and deliverable quality. This is not optional in a remote, client-facing environment.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Team Enablement & Oversight

•Coach Client Leads on solution design, client management, delivery approach, and professional judgment across CPG engagements

•Review CPG client engagement approaches for technical risk, complexity — particularly around trade promotion accounting, inventory, and multi-channel revenue — or inconsistency with firm standards

•Serve as the first escalation point for delivery challenges, CPG-specific technical questions, and team capacity problems

•Ensure all work produced by the team meets Graphite’s quality standards before it reaches clients

People Leadership

•Conduct formal performance reviews and ongoing career development conversations with direct reports

•Identify CPG accounting capability gaps within the team and address them through coaching, targeted training, or resourcing decisions

•Build a team environment where Client Leads operate with confidence and accountability, not dependency

Capacity & Quality Management

•Balance workload across Client Leads and adjust resourcing to manage close peaks, seasonal CPG demand cycles, and coverage risks

•Drive execution consistency across the CPG client portfolio without creating bureaucratic overhead

•Ensure no CPG client engagement is a single point of failure — cross-training and documentation are standing expectations

Client Execution (Selective)

•Maintain a purposefully limited personal CPG - focused client book

•Use direct client execution to stay current on CPG accounting complexity, model the standards you set for your team, and remain credible as a coach and escalation resource

Cross-Team Coordination

•Partner with Standards and Technology teams to translate firm-wide standards into practical, CPG-ready execution within your team

•Surface recurring CPG delivery issues, client patterns, and improvement opportunities to the Director proactively

CLIENT INTERACTION

•Not a primary client contact in the standard operating model

•Engages directly with CPG clients during escalations, complex onboarding, or when providing real-time coaching to Client Leads on high-stakes situations

•Maintains the professional presence, CPG industry fluency, and technical credibility to represent Graphite confidently in any senior client conversation

QUALIFICATIONS

•Bachelor’s degree in Accounting required; CPA required

•7–10 years of accounting experience including at least 2 years in a client lead, manager, or team leadership role; public accounting (Manager level) or outsourced accounting leadership experience strongly preferred

•Demonstrated CPG accounting experience — this is a firm requirement. Candidates must be able to speak specifically to trade promotion accounting, inventory reconciliation, landed cost, and multi-channel COGS in a CPG context

•Familiarity with CPG-specific platforms and operational systems including QuickBooks Online, NetSuite, Cin7, Shopify, and 3PL management systems preferred

•Deep working knowledge of GAAP with direct experience navigating startup-specific accounting complexity: SAFEs, convertible instruments, ASC 606, equity compensation, and more

•Demonstrated ability to manage a team and a client portfolio simultaneously without sacrificing quality on either

•Strong coaching and feedback skills — you have developed junior accounting professionals before and take that responsibility seriously

•Excellent written and verbal communication skills; executive presence in client-facing situations

•Experience working in a remote professional services environment is strongly preferred

Comprehensive Benefits & Perks:

  • Health & Wellness: Competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage. 100% of the employee's health insurance premium is covered by the company.
  • Financial Security: Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability insurance.
  • Work/Life Balance To Include: Generous Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO), 11 Paid Company Holidays, and comprehensive Paid Parental Leave.
  • Remote Work Setup: Fully remote position with company-provided technology equipment and a $250 technology stipend to support your ideal home office setup.
  • 401k: With a company match

Position requires long hours of sitting in front of desktop computer, requires flexibility in navigating schedules with patients, multitasking multiple virtual platforms, and ability to work with an interdisciplinary team. The position also requires candidates to initiate the licensure application process for South Carolina and Georgia within 90 days of hire if licensure is not already acquired.


Essential Functions

  • Develops, implements and evaluates patient care according to identified needs.
  • Manages clients in crisis utilizing appropriate therapeutic skills and assessment techniques.
  • Writes appropriate treatment plans according to patient diagnosis, age and clinical presentation. Writes appropriate discharge plans based on individual needs of client and follows through with termination process.
  • Collaborates with appropriate guardians and community agencies to insure effective service delivery.
  • Completes patient care assignments with attention to detail and accuracy. Provides accurate and consistent documentation of patient care/response in the medical record. Completes accurate and timely billing information.
  • Designs, plans, implements effective patient education.
  • Maintains open lines of communication, collaborates with healthcare team for patient outcome.

Physical Requirements
Works in patient care areas including hospital units, emergency room, individual offices and conference areas with exposure to potentially combative and hostile patients. Work requires frequent moving from one area to another, answering pages, and coordinating and communicating with other staff persons in various disciplines and agencies.

Education, Experience and Certifications

Master's degree in a relevant human services field such as Social Work, Counseling, Psychology, or Marriage and Family Therapy from an accredited school of graduate education required. Full licensure in applicable state required. 2 years clinical experience required. CPI and CPR training required for psychotherapist working in inpatient psychiatric setting.

Our Commitment to You:

Advocate Health offers a comprehensive suite of Total Rewards: benefits and well-being programs, competitive compensation, generous retirement offerings, programs that invest in your career development and so much more – so you can live fully at and away from work, including:

Compensation

  • Base compensation listed within the listed pay range based on factors such as qualifications, skills, relevant experience, and/or training

  • Premium pay such as shift, on call, and more based on a teammate's job

  • Incentive pay for select positions

  • Opportunity for annual increases based on performance

Benefits and more

  • Paid Time Off programs

  • Health and welfare benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life, and Short- and Long-Term Disability

  • Flexible Spending Accounts for eligible health care and dependent care expenses

  • Family benefits such as adoption assistance and paid parental leave

  • Defined contribution retirement plans with employer match and other financial wellness programs

  • Educational Assistance Program

Note: Eligibility for programs listed above may depend on your FTE or status (e.g., full-time, part-time, per diem, temporary, etc.); please ask a Recruiter for more information during an interview.

About Advocate Health

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. It is nationally recognized for its expertise in cardiology, neurosciences, oncology, pediatrics and rehabilitation, as well as organ transplants, burn treatments and specialized musculoskeletal programs. Advocate Health employs 155,000 teammates across 69 hospitals and over 1,000 care locations, and offers one of the nation’s largest graduate medical education programs with over 2,000 residents and fellows across more than 200 programs. Committed to providing equitable care for all, Advocate Health provides more than $6 billion in annual community benefits.

Rocket Doctor is a digital health marketplace transforming the way comprehensive care is delivered bringing the most advanced doctor’s office into homes across North America. We are a passionate group of medical doctors, technical experts, and patient care professionals who believe every person deserves access to high quality healthcare.

We are seeking a team member who is motivated to learn, grow, and innovate while making a meaningful impact. Rocket Doctor is one of the fastest growing digital health companies in Canada, with over 300 physicians nationwide and a rapidly expanding presence.

ROLE DESCRIPTION:

The Provincial Medical Lead (Nova Scotia) plays a key leadership role within the Atlantic Canada MD Leadership Team, working alongside the existing Leads to strengthen, expand, and optimize Rocket Doctor’s presence in the province.

This role focuses heavily on growing the Nova Scotia provider community, establishing clinical operations within the province, and supporting physicians as they enter practice on the platform. The Provincial Medical Lead will support recruitment efforts, build physician engagement, help shape provincial workflows, and ensure a high-quality experience for both patients and providers in Nova Scotia.

In addition to Nova Scotia-focused leadership, the Provincial Medical Lead participates in broader MD Lead initiatives to support cross-provincial alignment and company-wide growth

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES (NOVA SCOTIA-FOCUSED)

Grow and Strengthen Nova Scotia’s Physician Presence

  • Rocket Doctor is growing in Nova Scotia, and we're looking for a physician to lead it. As a Provincial Medical Lead, you will help build the province's physician community on our platform: recruiting and onboarding NS physicians, shaping clinical workflows that fit how medicine works in Nova Scotia, and making sure both patients and providers have a high-quality experience.
  • Nova Scotia’s primary care gap is well known, and thousands of residents are waiting for a regular provider. Virtual care is part of how the province closes that gap, and this role puts you in a position to shape it. You will be the clinical voice for Nova Scotia inside a national platform, with direct input into product, workflows, and how care gets delivered in the province.
  • Help build a strong provincial physician community and encourage ongoing clinical engagement.

Support Provincial Operations & Quality

  • Investigate and respond to patient, provider, or PCC-raised concerns related to Nova Scotia care.
  • Review and refine clinical workflows specific to Nova Scotia to improve efficiency, compliance, and physician ease of practice.
  • Maintain close communication with practicing Nova Scotia physicians, including active presence on Slack and participation in local meetings.

Strategic Specialty Leadership

  • Serve as a clinical leader supporting the growth of Nova Scotia’s virtual care presence.
  • Liaise with Nova Scotia health authorities, organizations, and partners as appropriate.
  • Provide input on Nova Scotia-specific product needs, regulatory considerations, and physician experience improvements.

MD LEAD RESPONSIBILITIES (CROSS-PROVINCIAL)

While the role is Nova Scotia-focused, the Provincial Medical Lead also participates in the MD Leads team:

  • Attend and contribute to MD Roundtable meetings.
  • Support initial onboarding of new physicians across provinces as needed.
  • Partner with the product and operations teams on improvement initiatives.
  • Provide troubleshooting support on emerging physician issues across all provinces.
  • Assist with communications and strategic updates for physicians and Rocket Doctor staff.
  • Help coordinate physician meetings and engagement events across Canada.

EXPECTATIONS:

  • Serve as a positive, solutions-focused representative of Rocket Doctor’s Nova Scotia medical leadership.
  • Maintain professionalism as outlined by the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Nova Scotia.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of the Nova Scotia medical landscape and virtual care environment.
  • Maintain clear records of recommendations and decisions.
  • Knowledge of Rocket Doctor’s EMR, platform extensions, and applicable privacy regulations in Canada and the United States (HIPAA, PHIPA, PIPEDA) is considered an asset.
  • Handle all confidential company and patient information with discretion.

COMPENSATION:

  • The position is estimated to be an average of 4 hours per week (negotiable) paid at $150 / hour. The dollar value of work will be paid via equity in the publicly traded parent company, which can be awarded to you personally or your corp, and deposited and traded within your investment / trading account.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Licensed to practise medicine in Nova Scotia;
  • Strong familiarity with the Nova Scotia healthcare system, workflows, and physician community.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving digital health environment.
  • Experience in medical leadership, administration, or business is an asset.

WORK / TRAVEL:

  • Fully remote within Canada.
  • Occasional travel may be required.

Equity Statement

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and accessible environment, where everyone feels valued, respected and supported, with a workforce and group of suppliers that reflect the diversity of our community. We particularly encourage women, black people, indigenous peoples, people of colour, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community to apply.

raw.title: Principal Identity Engineer
raw.excerpt: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world.
raw.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We’re building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

What's the Position?

Identity is the control plane of modern security. In a Zero Trust world, every access decision — for every employee, every administrator, and every machine — flows through the identity systems you will own. We're looking for a Principal Identity Engineer to be the technical authority on how Hard Rock Digital decides who (and what) can access which systems, when, and under what conditions.

This is a deliberately senior, high-trust role — one of three Principal openings reporting directly to our VP Security / CISO — because identity is not a slice of our security program; it is the backbone the rest of it is built on.

You'll be our first dedicated identity hire, inside a 16-person security organization spanning Security Operations, Risk Management, and Architecture & Engineering. Day-to-day provisioning and helpdesk sit with our IT team; your job is architecture, automation, and governance that make access safe.

If you think in terms of blast radius, least privilege, and phishing-resistant authentication — and you like owning a domain end to end rather than a corner of it — you'll feel at home here.

What You'll Do

Identity & Access Architecture

  • Own the security architecture, standards, authentication methods, and roadmap for Microsoft Entra ID, our primary identity provider — partnering with IT on tenant operations

  • Design and continuously refine Conditional Access policies that balance strong protection with a smooth experience for a globally distributed workforce

  • Advance our rollout of phishing-resistant, passwordless authentication (passkeys, certificate-based, FIDO2)

  • Own federation and single sign-on across our SaaS estate (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM provisioning)

Privileged & Just-in-Time Access

  • Own our privileged access model using Microsoft Entra PIM — separate admin identities, just-in-time elevation, and approval workflows

  • Design and maintain break-glass procedures and safeguards for our most sensitive administrative paths

  • Reduce standing privilege across the environment and make "least privilege, just in time" the default

Identity Lifecycle & Access Governance

  • Automate the joiner-mover-leaver lifecycle so access is granted, changed, and revoked accurately and promptly

  • Build and run access reviews and entitlement governance, partnering with our GRC team on audit evidence (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, GLI-19/GLI-33)

  • Make access decisions auditable, explainable, and continuously right sized

Non-Human & Workload Identity

  • Govern service principles, managed identities, and workload/federated credentials across AWS, Azure, and GCP

  • Partner on secrets governance across our secrets management platforms to shrink the number of long-lived, standing secrets

  • Partner with our Principal Cloud & Network Security Engineer, who owns service-to-service authentication (mTLS, service mesh)

Zero Trust Strategy

  • Serve as the identity authority for our Zero Trust program, aligned to NIST SP 800-207 and the CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model (Identity pillar)

  • Partner with our cloud and network security function on identity-aware access through Cloudflare Access

  • Partner with Security Operations to make identity signals (risky sign-ins, privileged elevation, MFA anomalies) first-class inputs to detection and response

  • Advise on customer identity (CIAM) and account-security architecture — partnering with our Principal Product Security Engineer, who owns the application security of player-facing account flows, and with product engineering

  • This is a big charter by design — year one is about sequencing. You'll set the identity roadmap with the CISO, with leadership backing to execute against it. Our 24/7 Security Operations team owns monitoring; you'll be the escalation point for identity-related incidents.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in identity and access management, security engineering, or a closely related field — or equivalent practical experience

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with a modern enterprise identity platform — Conditional Access, PIM/PAM, authentication methods, and identity governance (we run Microsoft Entra ID)

  • Strong command of identity protocols and patterns: SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and modern MFA

  • Experience automating the identity lifecycle and integrating identity across a large SaaS and multi-cloud estate

  • Scripting and automation skills (PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, Python) and comfort with Infrastructure as Code

  • A track record of designing least privilege, just-in-time access in a real production environment

  • Excellent written and verbal communication — you can explain an access decision to an engineer and a risk to an executive

  • Fluency with AI — you lead with it, reaching for AI tools daily to work faster and sharper; hands-on experience applying AI to security or engineering work is a must.

  • You don't need to tick every box. If you're deep in workforce identity but still growing into workload identity — or the reverse — we want to hear from you.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in a regulated industry (gaming, financial services, healthcare)

  • Exposure to customer/player identity (CIAM) and KYC providers

  • Passwordless or phishing-resistant MFA rollouts at scale

  • Familiarity with Identity Threat Detection & Response (ITDR)

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Identity & Access Administrator, CISSP)

Who You Are

  • Strategic and hands-on — you set direction and you build the thing

  • Fiercely focused - zero in on the control that matters most and finishes strong

  • Deeply curious — you test assumptions and keep learning as the identity landscape shifts

  • Customer obsessed about access — you treat login friction as a security outcome and design controls people don't have to fight

  • A clear communicator who builds trust across security, IT, engineering, and leadership

Why This Role Is Different

At most companies, identity is a queue of tickets buried inside an infrastructure team. Here it’s the backbone of our Zero Trust program: you set the strategy, you build the controls, and you answer directly to the CISO. If you've been waiting for identity to be treated as the strategic function it deserves to be, this is that role.

This is one of three Principal openings reporting to our VP Security / CISO: Identity (who and what gets access), Cloud & Network Security (where workloads run and how traffic moves), and Product Security (the code and its vulnerabilities). Apply to the one that sounds like your Tuesday.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • A hybrid / remote working environment

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

raw.title: Technical Operations Engineer (Voice & Integrations)
raw.excerpt: Vozy es el sistema para resoluciones de cliente — la plataforma donde los agentes de IA y los equipos humanos comparten memoria, gobernanza y resuelven como uno.
raw.description:
Vozy es el sistema para resoluciones de cliente — la plataforma donde los agentes de IA y los equipos humanos comparten memoria, gobernanza y resuelven como uno. Diseñado para transformar la experiencia al cliente con agentes de IA.

Somos un equipo diverso y talentoso distribuido en varios países, y estamos buscando un Technical Operations Engineerpara sumarse al area Customer & Product Success (CPS), el dominio donde la tecnología se encuentra con el cliente y donde Lili y el equipo humano resuelven como uno.

Misión del Rol

Garantizar que la infraestructura técnica del lado del cliente funcione (telefonía, conectividad, integraciones, activaciones) y ser el puente de resolución técnica entre CPS y Platform.
Este rol resuelve los problemas que no son del agente conversacional ni de la plataforma core, sino de la capa intermedia que conecta a Vozy con el cliente. Sin este trabajo, los agentes que despliegan los FDEs simplemente no llegan al usuario final.

Lo que harás en:

1. Telefonía y conectividad

  • Configurar, migrar y sostener troncales SIP de clientes y de Vozy: esquemas de carrier global, carrier por cuenta, troncales por Internet y por VPN.
  • Diagnosticar fallas de marcación y de audio con trazas SIP y capturas de paquetes: rechazos por código 480, congestión de circuito, timeouts de timbrado, transferencias sin respuesta, invites duplicados sobre una misma llamada, audio que llega degradado desde el carrier.
  • Gestionar DIDs, prefijos, enmascaramiento y matrices de enrutamiento por país, y validar por qué ruta entra el tráfico antes de configurar.
  • Interlocutor directamente con carriers y con los equipos de telefonía de los clientes hasta el cierre del caso, con evidencia técnica en la mano.
  • Sostener pruebas de telefonía en ventanas acordadas con cliente, incluyendo pruebas por país, numeración local y reversión de troncal al terminar.

2. Activaciones e integraciones

  • Ejecutar la activación técnica de clientes nuevos: troncal SIP, conectividad, VPN, listas de IP, webhooks, SFTP y buckets de almacenamiento.
  • Provisionar y migrar canales de mensajería: creación de cuenta con el proveedor de WhatsApp Business API, conexión con el Business Manager del cliente, onboarding de números y validación de saldo y estado de cuenta.
  • Validar integraciones con las centrales telefónicas y contact centers del cliente, y armar la lista de chequeo de requisitos técnicos antes de cada integración.

3. Soporte y escalamiento

  • Ser el primer punto de escalación técnica para FDEs y clientes en temas de telefonía e integraciones.
  • Triage de tickets: exigir la información mínima (identificador de sesión, cuenta, agente, campaña, fecha y hora, evidencia) antes de investigar, y devolver lo que llegue incompleto.
  • Escalar a Platform e infraestructura con contexto y propuesta, nunca con un "algo no funciona": qué falla, en qué cuenta, qué se descartó y cuál es la hipótesis.
  • Sostener la operación durante incidentes que afectan a varias cuentas a la vez, coordinando comunicación con FDEs y liderazgo.

4. Monitoreo y prevención

  • Construir y operar monitoreo proactivo de la capa técnica: tableros de llamadas rechazadas por cuenta, estado de troncales, saldo de canales, salud de los flujos.
  • Anticipar problemas recurrentes y proponer solución preventiva. Hoy varios incidentes se detectan porque el cliente los reporta, no por alerta propia. Cerrar esa brecha es parte del rol.
  • Automatizar detección y respuesta a degradación, no solo alertar.

5. Documentación y formación

  • Mantener runbooks de soporte técnico y activaciones para los escenarios más comunes.
  • Entrenar a FDEs en troubleshooting básico de telefonía e integraciones, con sesiones prácticas sobre casos reales.
  • Documentar patrones de problema y solución reutilizables, incluyendo el inventario de carriers y rutas como fuente única.

Qué se espera en los primeros meses

  • 30 días. Accesos completos y autonomía en diagnóstico de primer nivel: leer una traza SIP, identificar en qué tramo se rompe la llamada y decir si es de Vozy, del carrier o del cliente. Conocer el mapa de escalamiento y los canales internos.
  • 60 días. Atender tickets de telefonía e integraciones de punta a punta sin acompañamiento, ejecutar activaciones de clientes nuevos y sostener turnos de cobertura alternos.
  • 90 días. Tomar propiedad de al menos un frente completo (por ejemplo monitoreo proactivo o metodología de activaciones), con runbook publicado y adoptado por los FDEs.

Perfil requerido:

1. Obligatorio

  • Dos a cuatro años en operación de voz sobre IP, telecomunicaciones o soporte técnico de plataformas de comunicaciones.
  • SIP a nivel de protocolo: códigos de respuesta, negociación de medios, RTP, y lectura de trazas y capturas de paquetes.
  • Experiencia operando softswitches o plataformas de conmutación de voz en producción.
  • Conectividad y redes: VPN sitio a sitio, listas de IP, firewalls, NAT, DNS.
  • Integraciones de aplicación: APIs REST, webhooks, SFTP, clientes de prueba de API, lectura de logs.
  • Manejo de herramienta de tickets y disciplina de documentación.
  • Español nativo e inglés de lectura técnica.
  • Relación directa con clientes corporativos y con proveedores de telefonía: capacidad de sostener una conversación técnica firme y amable, sin culpar al cliente y sin aceptar diagnósticos sin evidencia.

2. Deseable

  • Experiencia en contact center, CPaaS, CCaaS o proveedores de telefonía en LATAM.
  • Canales de mensajería: WhatsApp Business API y administración de Business Manager.
  • Observabilidad: tableros de métricas y consultas sobre logs.
  • Scripting en Python o Bash para automatizar validaciones y capturas.
  • Exposición a agentes conversacionales o IA de voz: entender latencia, transcripción, detección de buzón y calidad de audio como variables del negocio, no como caja negra.

3. Madurez en IA (requisito bloqueante)

Nivel esperado: AI Integrated. La persona debe entender la capa de IA lo suficiente para diagnosticar en producción, distinguir un problema de infraestructura de uno del modelo o del diseño del agente, y usar IA para construir y automatizar parte de su propia carga de trabajo.

Competencias que definen el buen desempeño

  • Diagnóstico con evidencia. Nada se afirma sin traza, captura o tablero que lo sostenga. En los casos más ruidosos el valor está en demostrar con datos cuándo el corte viene de la infraestructura del propio cliente.
  • Proactividad sobre reactividad. Revisar todos los escenarios posibles y descartar causas antes de escalar.
  • No asumir lo que el cliente quiere. Aterrizar el requerimiento real antes de ejecutar.
  • Servicio al equipo de al lado. El FDE que atiende la cuenta debe quedar con contexto suficiente para hablar con su cliente.
  • Operación en paralelo. Sostener varias activaciones e incidentes simultáneos sin degradar tiempos de respuesta.
  • Criterio de escalamiento. Saber cuándo el caso ya no avanza y hay que subirlo, con el contexto completo.

Indicadores del rol

  • Tiempo de resolución de tickets técnicos de telefonía e integraciones.
  • Porcentaje de casos resueltos sin escalar a Platform.
  • Tiempo de activación técnica de un cliente nuevo, desde el acuerdo hasta la primera llamada en producción.
  • Porcentaje de incidentes detectados por monitoreo propio antes del reporte del cliente.
  • Disponibilidad efectiva de troncales e integraciones de las cuentas activas.
  • Cobertura: días al mes en que la operación técnica puede sostenerse sin la persona titular del frente.

Contexto de la operación

  • CPS opera con modelo de Forward Deployed Engineers, con tres FDE Leaders y cerca de 55 a 60 cuentas enterprise activas en LATAM.
  • El frente técnico atiende cuentas de banca, seguros, telecomunicaciones, retail, utilities y cooperativas de crédito en México, Centroamérica, Colombia, Perú y Bolivia.
  • Interlocutores internos frecuentes: Platform e infraestructura, FDE Leaders y el equipo de soporte.
  • Rituales donde participa el rol: Planning semanal de CPS, All Hands CPS, Daily CPS, war rooms de salud de cuentas y sesiones técnicas con clientes.

Cultura Vozy

En Vozy, la transparencia no es solo una palabra de moda — es nuestra forma de hacer las cosas. Mantenemos la información fluyendo de manera abierta y honesta, para que todos estemos en la misma página. Somos un equipo 100% remoto; nuestras herramientas async te permiten gestionar tu tiempo de la mejor manera para ti, mientras que nuestras reuniones en vivo son para conectar, decidir y avanzar juntos. Nos movemos con nuestros valores: Compromiso , Compasión , Innovación y Amor .

Lo que ofrecemos

  • Trabajo 100% remoto.
  • Día libre de cumpleaños.
  • Vacaciones Ilimitadas
  • La oportunidad de tener impacto real en clientes desde el primer día, en un entorno técnico y colaborativo, con una ruta de crecimiento clara hacia la banda Driver.

¿Crees que no cumples con todos los requisitos? En Vozy valoramos el potencial tanto como la experiencia. Si te apasiona lo que haces y tienes ganas de crecer, postúlate de todos modos — ¡podrías ser justo lo que buscamos!

SPECJALISTA DS. UMAWIANIA SPOTKAŃ SPRZEDAŻOWYCH

100% zdalnie | Freelance | Rynek polski

RealAdvisor to jedna z wiodących platform cyfrowych w europejskim sektorze nieruchomości. Firma została założona w Szwajcarii i obecnie współpracuje z ponad 5 000 agencji nieruchomości, docierając każdego roku do ponad 10 milionów użytkowników w całej Europie.

Dynamicznie się rozwijamy, realizując jasną misję: pomagamy profesjonalistom z branży nieruchomości rozwijać ich biznes dzięki danym, przejrzystości i inteligentnym rozwiązaniom technologicznym.

Obecnie poszukujemy Specjalistów ds. Umawiania Spotkań Sprzedażowych, którzy dołączą do naszego międzynarodowego zespołu Sales i będą rozwijać rynek nieruchomości w Polsce.

NOWO OTWARTY RYNEK – DUŻY POTENCJAŁ ZAROBKOWY

Rynek polski został otwarty dopiero niedawno, dlatego jest to doskonały moment, aby dołączyć do projektu na jego wczesnym etapie.

Oznacza to dużą przestrzeń do pozyskiwania nowych klientów, budowania własnego pipeline'u i generowania wartościowych szans sprzedażowych.

Dla osób nastawionych na wyniki jest to szczególnie interesująca możliwość, ponieważ wynagrodzenie jest bezpośrednio powiązane z osiąganymi rezultatami, a system prowizyjny nie posiada górnego limitu.

Dołączając teraz, będziesz mieć możliwość współtworzenia i rozwijania rynku polskiego od samego początku oraz bezpośredniego korzystania z potencjału biznesowego, który wygenerujesz.

NA CZYM POLEGA TA ROLA?

Jako Specjalista ds. Umawiania Spotkań Sprzedażowych będziesz odpowiedzialny za wyszukiwanie i kontaktowanie się z potencjalnymi klientami z branży nieruchomości w Polsce.

Twoim głównym celem będzie nawiązywanie kontaktu z agencjami nieruchomości, rozpoznawanie ich potrzeb, kwalifikowanie potencjalnych klientów oraz umawianie wartościowych prezentacji/demo dla zespołu Sales.

Jest to w 100% zdalna współpraca freelance, zapewniająca dużą elastyczność i samodzielność w organizacji pracy.

TWOJE ZADANIA

  • Aktywne pozyskiwanie potencjalnych klientów poprzez outbound i cold calling
  • Kontakt telefoniczny z agencjami nieruchomości na rynku polskim
  • Identyfikowanie i kwalifikowanie potencjalnych szans sprzedażowych
  • Kontakt z właścicielami agencji oraz osobami decyzyjnymi
  • Rozpoznawanie potrzeb i wyzwań potencjalnych klientów
  • Profesjonalne przedstawianie wartości oferowanych rozwiązań
  • Umawianie prezentacji/demo z zakwalifikowanymi potencjalnymi klientami
  • Kontakt follow-up przed umówionymi spotkaniami
  • Maksymalizowanie frekwencji na umówionych spotkaniach
  • Aktualizowanie i prowadzenie pipeline'u w systemie CRM
  • Dokumentowanie kontaktów i aktywności sprzedażowej
  • Codzienna współpraca z międzynarodowym zespołem Sales
  • Realizacja ustalonych celów oraz KPI

JAK WYGLĄDA SUKCES NA TYM STANOWISKU?

Jest to stanowisko dla osób, które lubią pracować na konkretnych wynikach.

Osoba osiągająca dobre rezultaty powinna być w stanie:

  • Wykonywać około 100 aktywności outbound dziennie
  • Umawiać 60+ prezentacji/demo miesięcznie
  • Utrzymywać wysoki poziom frekwencji na umówionych spotkaniach
  • Systematycznie budować i kwalifikować pipeline
  • Generować regularnie wysokiej jakości szanse sprzedażowe
  • Swobodnie i profesjonalnie komunikować się z polskimi agencjami nieruchomości
  • Skutecznie radzić sobie z obiekcjami
  • Samodzielnie organizować swoją pracę i realizować ustalone KPI

KOGO SZUKAMY?

Szukamy osób ambitnych, odpornych na odmowę, komunikatywnych, proaktywnych i silnie zorientowanych na wyniki.

Idealny kandydat:

  • Posługuje się językiem polskim na poziomie ojczystym lub biegłym
  • Zna język angielski na poziomie umożliwiającym pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku
  • Posiada bardzo dobre umiejętności komunikacyjne
  • Czuje się swobodnie podczas rozmów telefonicznych
  • Potrafi przekonywać i profesjonalnie reagować na obiekcje
  • Jest samodzielny i dobrze organizuje swoją pracę
  • Jest nastawiony na realizację celów i KPI
  • Zna podstawy pracy z CRM i narzędziami automatyzacji sprzedaży
  • Posiada stabilne połączenie internetowe
  • Doświadczenie w sprzedaży, appointment setting, SDR, telemarketingu, lead generation lub branży nieruchomości będzie dodatkowym atutem

Szczególnie mile widziane jest doświadczenie w pracy z polskim rynkiem oraz klientami B2B.

FORMA WSPÓŁPRACY

Oferujemy współpracę w modelu freelance.

Wymagane jest posiadanie włoskiego numeru VAT (Partita IVA) lub gotowość do jego założenia.

Jeżeli obecnie nie posiadasz Partita IVA, zapewniamy pomoc w procesie jej założenia.

Praca jest w 100% zdalna, dzięki czemu możesz pracować z dowolnego miejsca na świecie, pod warunkiem możliwości skutecznej obsługi rynku polskiego.

WYNAGRODZENIE I POTENCJAŁ ZAROBKOWY

Wynagrodzenie jest bezpośrednio uzależnione od wyników i liczby zrealizowanych prezentacji/demo.

Dodatkowo oferujemy nieograniczone prowizje od sprzedaży wygenerowanej dzięki szansom sprzedażowym pozyskanym przez Ciebie.

Orientacyjny potencjał miesięcznych zarobków:

  • 60 zrealizowanych demo: około 2 500–5 000 € miesięcznie
  • 80 zrealizowanych demo: około 4 000–7 000 € miesięcznie
  • 100+ zrealizowanych demo: ponad 5 500 € miesięcznie

Podane kwoty są orientacyjnymi możliwościami zarobkowymi i zależą od indywidualnych wyników oraz wygenerowanej aktywności sprzedażowej.

PROWIZJE BEZ GÓRNEGO LIMITU

To jeden z najważniejszych elementów tej współpracy.

Poza wynagrodzeniem związanym ze zrealizowanymi prezentacjami/demo, możesz otrzymywać dodatkowe prowizje za szanse sprzedażowe, które dzięki Twojej pracy zostaną przekształcone w klientów przez zespół Sales.

Nie ma górnego limitu prowizji.

Im więcej wartościowych możliwości sprzedażowych wygenerujesz i im więcej z nich zakończy się sprzedażą, tym większy będzie Twój potencjał zarobkowy.

CO OFERUJEMY?

  • Długoterminową współpracę freelance
  • Pracę 100% zdalną
  • Dużą elastyczność i samodzielność
  • Wynagrodzenie oparte na wynikach
  • Prowizje bez górnego limitu
  • Możliwość rozwoju nowo otwartego rynku polskiego
  • Dostęp do CRM i narzędzi automatyzacji sprzedaży
  • Stałe wsparcie międzynarodowego zespołu Sales
  • Sprawdzone procesy sprzedażowe
  • Określoną grupę docelową i rynek
  • Możliwości rozwoju zawodowego
  • Międzynarodowe i wielokulturowe środowisko pracy

DLACZEGO WARTO DOŁĄCZYĆ TERAZ?

Rynek polski został otwarty dopiero niedawno, dlatego osoby dołączające na tym etapie mają możliwość rozwijania rynku od samego początku.

To moment, w którym można skoncentrować się na pozyskiwaniu nowych agencji nieruchomości, budowaniu własnego pipeline'u i generowaniu dużej liczby nowych szans sprzedażowych.

Dla osoby, która dobrze radzi sobie z cold callingiem i pracą na wynikach, oznacza to możliwość szybkiego rozwinięcia aktywności sprzedażowej oraz wykorzystania wysokiego potencjału zarobkowego wynikającego z modelu prowizyjnego bez limitu.

DOŁĄCZ DO REALADVISOR

Dołączysz do szybko rozwijającej się, międzynarodowej firmy działającej w sektorze technologii dla branży nieruchomości.

Jako Specjalista ds. Umawiania Spotkań Sprzedażowych będziesz rozwijać swoje umiejętności w zakresie sprzedaży B2B, cold callingu, lead generation, kwalifikacji klientów i umawiania spotkań, jednocześnie pomagając rozwijać nowo otwarty rynek polski.

Jeśli jesteś ambitny, komunikatywny, odporny na odmowę i motywują Cię konkretne wyniki oraz możliwość wysokich zarobków, chcemy Cię poznać.

Aplikuj teraz i dołącz do naszego międzynarodowego zespołu Sales rozwijającego rynek polski.
